reviews.author: Dimitri Sakaliuk
reviews.text: It's Friday April 10th 2026, 12:30 am and me and my family are trying to have some rest on our vacation and  the crowd using all the advantages of all inclusive bars screaming its lungs out to the abnormally loud dancing music . This is not Paradisus’s  hotel only disadvantage , there are more now than in the past . And it’s our third and last time. Good bye once a great place!

reviews.author: Jiaying Yu
reviews.text: I was very excited for my trip to Cancun, this hotel experience ruined my impression. The food is terrible at this hotel. You have to go in person to make reservations at a certain time rather than booking online (they don't offer online booking). So by the time I go make my reservation for the restaurants, it was all full. The only time available was 9pm or after, which is stupid. I went to Royal Solaris Cancun before and they made life easier to make reservation at the website. They had good food and drinks, customer service was great too! This hotel do not have a good customer service, they are not friendly either welcoming. Me and my mom waited so long for our food to arrive to our table, no waiter came to check on us while we're waiting. We were mad because we been eating at the buffet for 3 days straight but couldn't do nothing because all reservations were full. The other hotel I been to before had much better experience than this one, every staff there were very welcoming and happy. This hotel also don't have much activities like the other hotel do, which is making it boring. By 9pm everyone is gone and back to their rooms. Do not recommend and will not return.

reviews.author: Noélly Mercer
reviews.text:
Hello,
I experienced a serious issue during my check-in related to room access, but fortunately, everything was resolved promptly and with great care.

I would like to highlight the outstanding service provided by Francisco. He was extremely professional, kind, and attentive throughout the entire situation. His empathy and commitment to resolving the issue, always emphasizing the team spirit of Paradisus, made all the difference.

Thank you, Paradisus, for turning around my initial impression and making my stay truly enjoyable.

I definitely plan to return to Cancún, and it would be a pleasure to stay at Paradisus again.

The restaurants are excellent, and the service at the pool, breakfast, and all dining venues was impeccable. The food quality was truly exceptional in every detail.

Thank you once again!

reviews.author: Kate Babusciac
reviews.text:
First of all, I want to mention that I’m not a picky vacationer. For me and my 3-year-old daughter, the most important things were the ability to relax on the beach and to have timely access to quality food. Unfortunately, our experience at this resort was extremely disappointing and stressful.

1. Beach Access:
Despite being at an all-inclusive resort, I was told I needed to pay $250 for a cabana because all the beach lounges were “reserved” — even though many were unoccupied. A staff member told me guests start claiming lounges as early as 4 a.m. I was not willing to wake up my toddler that early to compete for a place to relax. That same staff member then offered to reserve a spot for me — for cash — which felt inappropriate and unprofessional.

2. Dining Issues:
The buffet experience was chaotic and unsanitary. The food selection was poor, and the conditions were far from clean. We waited 40 minutes in line just to be seated — again, not ideal when trying to keep a young child fed on a schedule.

3. Dinner Reservations:
To have dinner at one of the restaurants, you had to reserve a table — which is a normal policy for all-inclusive resorts. However, I stood in line for one full hour trying to make a reservation, only to be told everything was fully booked for that evening. The only option offered was to pay out-of-pocket at a non-inclusive restaurant. Out of desperation, I went to the steakhouse to avoid another long buffet line and ended up spending $300.

4. Poor Customer Service & Disrespect:
The next day, I went to the front desk to express my concerns and to inform them that I would be leaving the resort. I was shocked at their response. They openly told me they didn’t care because the resort would be closing in a month for remodeling and rebranding. The staff was extremely rude — in front of my child — and made no effort to help or even apologize. Another family standing behind me also tried to cancel their stay and witnessed the entire exchange, including the disrespect and humiliation I experienced.

In the end, I had to book another hotel and leave, losing two days of my vacation — not to mention the emotional distress and migraine caused by this experience. I’ve never encountered such terrible treatment, especially as a single mother traveling with a child in a foreign country. I felt completely unprotected and unsupported.

reviews.author: Andrew Orr
reviews.text: Dj Bryan is amazing the karaoke is so fun

reviews.author: kwangmi kim
reviews.text:
This hotel was the worst experience ever.

When checking in, they couldn’t find my reservation, and it took two hours to sort it out. Then, when I finally got to my room, it was infested with cockroaches. Within just a few minutes, I caught nine cockroaches, and there were even more that I couldn’t catch.

I went to the lobby to request a room change, but at first, the staff refused. They only agreed after realizing that other guests were watching. I originally paid extra for an ocean view room, but the new room they gave me had nothing but a rooftop view.

It’s unbelievable that a hotel in this day and age would have such a severe cockroach problem. The way the staff handled the situation was also extremely frustrating. On top of that, every single dish at the hotel restaurant was terrible.

I will never stay at this hotel again.

reviews.author: Марта Грицевич
reviews.text: The hotel  location , beach, restaurants is pretty good. But the receptionists do not behave with dignity. Due to an error in my child's name, we were not checked into the hotel which paid for in advance, and this is after a 12-hour flight. That is, we spent the paid night at the reception, and also did not allow us to go to the restaurant. I want to note Mr. Enrique that he did this vile thing. And then. I checked into a room with mould, although I paid for a completely different type of room. After that, the long-awaited vacation was ruined. She also witnessed problems at the reception in other people with colonisation. Therefore, my review is 1. Take note of Enrique’s behaviour.

reviews.author: Amanda Refearo
reviews.text:
March 2025

Our family trip was incredibly meaningful, marking multiple celebrations: my parents' 40th wedding anniversary, our 7th anniversary, and both my son's and my birthdays. It was extra special as our first family trip together ever.

Upon arrival, our excitement dwindled when we were assigned our rooms. Despite our requests, nothing was accommodated or acknowledged. Romina at the front desk informed us that nothing could be changed due to a big group arriving the next day, making us feel like we didn’t matter. Not to mention, there was nothing special setup in our rooms for our special occasions like we've experienced at other resorts.

Our initial rooms felt like a hole in the wall on the basement-like bottom floor—claustrophobic, and the balcony faced a wall. Displeased, I returned to the front desk. Thankfully, Enrique was helpful. He changed my parents’ room to a higher floor and provided us with a room with the king-size bed we prioritized, though still on the bottom floor.

Enrique promised room changes could occur in 3 days, as they would be available by the 15th. We accepted this and was asked to return in 20 mins for our room, only to encounter Romina again. She told us the earlier promise couldn’t be fulfilled due to the large group arriving the next day, displaying a very bad attitude unwilling to help and seeming intent to block Enrique's solution.To prevent further distress, I accepted the situation with the new room, which faced only half a wall this time, resolving to not let these issues ruin our hard-earned trip.

At first glance, the room seemed acceptable, but as we settled in, it became clear how worn out everything was. Two lights were out, making the room very dim. The bathroom was filthy and appeared improperly cleaned; the tub looked like it needed replacing. This was the worst cleanliness I've encountered at an all-inclusive. Over our 7-nights stay, the cleaning person showed up only 2 times, our fridge was never stocked, until we complained and even then it only got stocked on the last day. Midway through the trip, we discovered 2 mid-sized roaches in the room and later encountered many tiny baby roaches in the bathroom.

The food was below average. Despite a wide array of options, the dishes didn't taste great and were often overly salty.

During our stay the large group ended up being a corporate conference who were not being serviced privately resulting in huge lines everywhere and multiple nights of large private dinners by the main pool where the entertainment would typically be being blocked off and only accessible to the conference goers changing the atmosphere for people who are there on vacation.

The beach was the highlight, even during a windy week when the water was too rough to swim in. The service from Eduardo at the beach club with the Kanna Bali beds was excellent, though not included, costing an additional $250 USD or available as a gift if you endure a sales pitch for Club Melia membership. I strongly advise against joining Club Melia. The brand lacks integrity and consistently fails to address issues promptly, missing multiple opportunities to make things right. why join a club when they can't do things right the first time? Second or third..

Activities for kids were well-managed by Nestor, who ran the workshops admirably and beach activities. The kiddie pool section was great for young children, with knee-high water, though it wasn't cleaned daily and seating was limited.

The 9-hole golf course, was neglected, with broken bottles and very rough greens.

The main area in building 3 is dreamy with all the vines coming down, but that's where it ends.. everything else shows its age. The resort is closing in May for a year-long renovation, and it seems many staff have lost motivation or aren't performing at full potential during this time and it shows.

Would we return? No, because our business didn’t feel valued at all. I highly recommend saving your money, time, and energy by booking elsewhere.. somewhere where they actually care about your experience.

reviews.author: Dan Yockey
reviews.text:
One word: Horrible.

Checked in around 7pm, there was a line out the door. No sense of urgency by the front desk checking people in, the were processing one family about every 10-15 minutes, only two people working. That was my first introduction to the notion that everything at the hotel, and I mean everything, prepare to wait in line for  5-10 minutes minimum. That includes getting a coffee at the coffee bar, a drink at the pool bar, waiting in bread lines at the buffet and food stations, etc.  They simply can not or are unwilling to handle the proper throughput of a crowded resort.

The resort itself looks nice, but that's about all it has going for it. The pools have limited seating and chairs, so better get up at sunrise to reserve your spot.

The absolute worst part about this hotel is the dining. The servers come by about once to fill your glass. We tipped nicely the first couple days which had no affect on the service. I asked for a coffee in the morning one day and it never even showed up after asking three times. There was one server working the entire outdoor dining area. The buffet has limited food options, unappetizing, and unsanitary. Many plates sat there all night untouched because it looked like pig slop. Food was always lukewarm which is a major red flag for harboring foodborne bacteria. One night, a sewer line broke in the dining area and the staff were mopping it up and squeeging it away into a corner. The smell was unbearable, so we ate at a nearby restaurant. Absolutely appalling they even kept the dining room open, what a serious hazard to food safety. After witnessing that, to little surprise, our second to last day my entire family contracted a norovirus. All four of us vomited the entire last night we were there as well as all day the next day during the flight home. We asked housekeeping at midnight for fresh sheets, towels, and cleanup materials and it took over an hour for them to deliver. I went down to the front desk to getting to the bottom of the delay and they could not have shown any less concern about my sick family. It's not like they were even busy, the hallways were empty.

They obviously have bot accounts posting 5 star reviews. If you look closely most of the reviewers are new accounts with only one or two reviews, and they post little substance. This happens multiple times per day. It's pretty clear if you sort out the 1 star reviews that are being buried, they are all right on the mark with our experience.

Along with the 3+ hour wait in customs on arrival, my family and I are done with Cancun for a while.

reviews.author: Mehul Awasthi
reviews.text:
The room we stayed in was average with poor air conditioning.
This property needs to look up the meaning of the word "hospitality".
The concierge and guest services teams are slow, clueless, unhelpful and incompetent. The staff in general are indifferent and straight up rude on occasions.
They call themselves "all inclusive" but constantly try to get you to spend your hard earned $$$ at every conceivable opportunity. For example there are restaurants in the hotel that you need to pay extra for??? Oh and you need to make reservations for the majority of the restaurants. The food is below average as well. Pool beds and cabanas are up for rental even though there aren't enough "free" ones to accommodate all guests.
Seriously? If you're going to up-charge your guests at every opportunity at least have the decency to make it abundantly clear that your property isn't exactly all inclusive.
The property is sleepy at night and the entertainment is forgettable.
Spend a little more money to stay at a brand name resort like Hyatt because you actually get an all inclusive experience. It's a real shame because the beach itself is stunning.

reviews.author: Shoaib Iqbal
reviews.text:
I’m perplexed by all the good reviews. The property is nice looking. But it ends there. I believe they’re closing down in March for a year for a full renovation so it’s basically like a review reset for them. They don’t really have any interest in providing good service, and it shows. Absolutely horrendous service from the front desk to the waiters at the restaurant. It seems like the direction to provide mediocre or average service at best is given from the top down. They would routinely lie to our group or tell us fake wait times. Once we ordered room service- which is not good at all by all accounts- and waited 1.5 hours. Called 4x. It never came. Each time they said it was coming and eventually we were priority. It seems like everyone is in on it at the property, except the guests. I have 10 other stories that are equal or worse than this, but the review would be too long then.

MOST IMPORTANTLY: do not stay in tower 3. There is a lot of noise from a nearby club that will keep you awake. Not just noise. Bass. That you feel in your heart. From 1-4am. I asked them weeks out to not put us there, 8 rooms. I think as a result of my request they put us as close to the club as possible. In tower 3.

As for the rooms themselves- think of a motel room in the 90s in the USA. Same thing. Worst condition. My room literally flooded. A large amount of water came into my room from the balcony. Do you think the hotels not aware of this or that this is the first time that’s happened? They just let it be. Probably until March.

Please just do yourself a favor and stay elsewhere.  Before March and probably after their renovation. You will thank me.

reviews.author: Shyna Kashi
reviews.text:
The service of this place is horrendous. The one time the hotel staff was on time with something was when they came by our room early with the luggage cart to rush us out of our rooms and get us to check out as soon as possible. Every single restaurant we had a reservation at did not seat us for at least 30 to 45 minutes after our allotted time. The staff don't pay attention to you until you wave a crisp $10 or $20 bill in the air to show them you are going to leave a hefty tip. I even once asked for some ice at around 11:30 pm one night and they did not bring it until 1am after waking me up with their knocks on the door. The front desk also never answer. Staying in their "exclusive" Reserve section of the hotel, I had called the Reserve front desk at least once or twice a day with a question and was left listening to a ringing phone for at 10 minutes before hanging up.

Not to mention the food itself is disgusting. The quality is so bad and I recommend you eat out every night. Even their "amazing steakhouse," Sal, is mediocre at best. I will admit, it was the only food I could swallow without cringing but it was nothing special. Additionally, most restaurants tend to have one or two decent menu options, but they are never included in the hotel's All Inclusive special, you have to pay another $50-100 for the edible food. The all inclusive package is useless unless you are there to take advantage of a bar.

The property is beautiful and it is such a shame that it had to be overshadowed by the terrible service and inedible food.

If you are used to the Ritz Carlton, Four Seasons, and other 5 star hotels during your travels, run far far away from this establishment. Even if you are used to Hilton and best western and other 3 or 4 star hotels, you should run away as well, this place is not the place to be.

reviews.author: Ryan Garcia
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying that we got a great deal at this hotel due to my sister-in-law's previous employment with this hotel chain. We also chose to visit during the slowest part of the year to get the best deal possible. However, because we used a coupon code and visited during the off-season, the hotel seemed to believe it had the right to treat my family and me as if we were not paying customers.

While the service outside of the front desk and upper management was great, and the hotel is located in a beautiful spot right on the water, the experience was blemished by an issue. My 3-year-old son and I both got food poisoning. Since this is an all-inclusive resort, everything you eat and drink is included. Unfortunately, this led to a very unpleasant stay, not just because of the food poisoning, but also because of the front desk and upper management’s refusal to accept any responsibility.

Conveniently for the hotel, there is a doctor on-site who is contracted, meaning that if something goes wrong (like food poisoning), they refuse to cover any expenses related to the doctor’s services. They essentially absolve themselves of any fault, using the excuse that my son and I could of gotten food poisoning from eating something that wasn't from the hotel. Again, it is an all inclusive hotel. I got sick on the third day and my son on the fourth day. To make matters worse, they falsely accused me of requesting free massages, daily discounts, and a free stay - claims that were entirely untrue. Never once did my group request anything besides them covering the medical bills. This speaks a lot to the character of your business and the way you teach your employees. Specifically, a front desk rep by the name of Ishmael claimed I requested these accommodations.

While parts of the trip were enjoyable, I hope that you don’t get food poisoning. If you do, you’ll be told to kick rocks, because your money was already collected. Be cautious when considering a stay here.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus was deeply disappointing and fell far below expectations. Here’s a breakdown of the issues we encountered:

Rooms: The room we were assigned was unclean, outdated, and completely different from what we had booked. It did not match the photos or description provided.

Customer Service: The service was frustrating and unhelpful. When my wife lost a personal item at the restaurant, the guest services staff dismissed the issue and shifted blame onto other guests, suggesting the item might have been taken. The staff member we spoke to was unprofessional, rolling her eyes and making excuses instead of taking steps to address the situation, such as checking with their team or offering to investigate.

Lost Items: One of my wife’s shoes went missing during our stay. We checked the room thoroughly before leaving and didn’t leave anything behind. The room had been serviced the night before, so the missing shoe was puzzling. Unfortunately, based on the dismissive attitude we experienced, we doubt the staff would have been helpful even if we had reported it before leaving.

Food and Dining: The dining experience was chaotic and poorly managed. Long lines for the buffet were common, and dietary restrictions were not properly accommodated. When we tried to reserve a table, the staff made an error, refused to seat us, and handled the situation poorly. We also witnessed them giving preferential treatment to other guests who raised their voices.

Towels and Amenities: Towels were scarce, and amenities were not up to the standard of a 5-star hotel.

Overall Management: The lack of oversight and accountability from management was apparent throughout our stay. It was clear that systems to ensure cleanliness, customer service, and guest satisfaction were not in place.

This experience was far from what we expected for the price and reputation of this property. I would not recommend Paradisus to others. Management needs to address these issues urgently to meet even basic expectations.

reviews.author: Serena Evans
reviews.text: Rooms smell of mold. They have oil diffusers plugged in everywhere to mask it. Asked to change my room because the smell was so bad and David the Supervisor on duty (11/27/24) said no. I shared it’s because of health issues and he said there is nothing he could do. Very poor service. Rooms are dated and the food is meh at best. Would not recommend this place to a friend much less a family member. Not sure how it’s getting away with calling itself a 5 star hotel.

reviews.author: nadeen al
reviews.text:
The food is awful—bland, tasteless, and not fit for a 5-star resort. The customer service was beyond terrible. Upon check-in, they told us they gave our rooms away and separated mine and my parents’ rooms despite booking side-by-side with sea views. With a newborn in tow, they said there were no available rooms and made us wait two hours, only to give us a terrible, outdated room.

The room was so old, the bed frames were ripped, the drawers didn’t even open, and the floors were filthy. The shower head was shaking when turned on, feeling like it was about to break. Absolutely horrific. I can’t believe this place is considered a 5-star resort—it’s more like 0 stars.

To top it off, the next day, our other family had a leak in their bathroom from the room above, causing it to flood. My aunt fell and hurt her leg. The hotel just wanted to "fix" the issue but didn’t offer to relocate .

I also requested a kettle to boil water for my newborn, and they said they don’t have one. When I asked for hot water instead, they brought me water that smelled like coffee, making it impossible to use for my baby.

I honestly have no idea how I’m going to spend the next 5 days here. This place has been nothing but stress and disappointment. Don’t waste your time or money here. Terrible management all around. Don’t waste your time or money here.

reviews.author: Marty Boeckman
reviews.text:
Relative to other all inclusives, the service was very poor. The food was never hot, it was always room temperature. The facilities were definitely showing their age.
We booked an "ocean view" room, check out the view we had.

reviews.author: Priscilla tran
reviews.text:
I wish I could give this resort zero stars. I feel compelled to warn others about what we went through.
Rooms: The rooms were extremely outdated, poorly maintained, and downright dirty. Basic amenities like outlets stopped working halfway through our trip, leaving us frustrated and unable to charge essential devices. Despite paying for what was supposed to be a relaxing vacation, we were greeted with conditions that felt more like a budget motel than a resort.
Cockroaches: Things took an even worse turn when one of the rooms found cockroaches. Understandably, they asked to be moved to another room, only to find another cockroach in the new room. When we reported this to staff, their reaction was appalling—they were completely unapologetic and unsympathetic, acting annoyed and even sighing as if we were inconveniencing them by pointing out this serious issue. No guest should ever feel dismissed when raising such a legitimate concern.
Food Safety: As if the room issues weren’t enough, five of us ended up with food poisoning from the resort's food. This ruined several days of our trip, leaving us miserable and unable to enjoy any of the activities we had planned. The lack of hygiene and food safety is deeply concerning, and it’s clear they don’t prioritize the health or well-being of their guests.
Service: The staff, especially at the front desk, were among the worst I’ve ever encountered. They seemed indifferent to our complaints and acted like they didn’t want to be there. Anytime we tried to bring up an issue, we were met with sighs, eye rolls, and an overall attitude that made us feel unwelcome.
The lack of care and professionalism across all aspects of this resort is astounding. From the poor room conditions and pest issues to the food poisoning and unhelpful staff, it’s hard to believe this place is even operational.
Do yourself a favor and avoid this resort at all costs. Cancun has plenty of other options that will offer better value for your money, along with the basic cleanliness, safety, and service you’d expect from a resort. Don’t make the same mistake we did. This place is an absolute disaster.

reviews.author: Ashley N
reviews.text:
Wouldn't recommend this resort, here's why:

Cockroachs:
There were cockroaches in our room in building 1 by the mini fridge. So we asked to move rooms.  The staff member we talked to literally sighed on the phone at our request so they know it's an issue. He wasn't even apologetic or the least bit sympathetic to the situation. They moved us to a room in building 3, where we ended up seeing another cockroach in the bathroom.

Rooms:
Our room was outdated and didn't look like the pictures. Our shower would literally leaked water everywhere. The bed wasn't soft and had stained sheets. There were not enough outlets, and some didn't even work to begin with. Honestly, the room felt like a cheap motel, not an all-inclusive resort.

Food:
The food at the buffet was bland, dry, or cold. It gave multiple of my friends food poisoning. Room service food tasted even worse, so I wouldn't recommend it.  It always came cold and felt like a middle schooler made it.  The restaurant food was decent but you have to book a table in advance.

Lack of activities:
For an all-inclusive, there wasn't much to do at the resort. Because of the poor food and lack of activities, I consistently wanted to leave and go out to find something to do/eat. Which really defeats the point in staying at an all-inclusive to begin with.

This resort was so lack luster, save yourself the trouble of risking taking home a roach infestation and book somewhere else.

reviews.author: Jim Rzad
reviews.text: Resort is very nice.  However that’s where it ends.  Food is average at best.  The couple restaurants we could get in were good.  But every day you have to go to a desk at 10am and either full or a 930 or 10pm available at same couple restaurants you’ve been to.  So didn’t get to all of them.  Service around the pools is ok some of the time.  One day had cabanas and someone came first hour or so but then didn’t see a server for hours and had to get a round of drinks for the 10-12 of us each time.  Seems odd when you spend so much to rent these.  Then theres the upgrade that was rescinded because of a leak in the room we were going to move to for the family concierge package we had.  So then we had to backtrack on the evening cruise with the other 20 we traveled with.  Then there was the broken door in the  bathroom that had we stuck for 30 minutes plus while they called people in the crowbar the door open.  Which was just left busted up and broken for the last few days of our trip.  Overall it was quite the experience at the paradisus and we were able to cross it off the list for future reference.  No surprise they are closing soon for renovations.  We filled the last couple days with excursions and stayed off property during the day.  Overall not being able to get in restaurants and service overall was poor and we wouldn’t go back.  Lesson learned about Melia and how they handle things.  Just hadn’t seen service that poor at a highly rated resort.

reviews.author: Anas Alghbari
reviews.text:
Our stay at this resort was a huge disappointment, and it should be rated as a 3-star hotel at best, not the “premium” destination it claims to be.

Upon arrival, we were told to wait hours to check in. Despite having a scheduled 3 pm check-in time, we didn’t get our room until 11 pm. The excuse was that rooms needed cleaning, but it’s hard to believe a resort of this size has no rooms ready for guests, especially when check-in is a standard time. The entire process was disorganized and unprofessional.

The room itself was filthy and outdated. The furniture was worn out and broken, and the bathroom was barely functional. The sink batley has any water let alone hot water, and the showerhead was on the verge of falling off. To make matters worse, we found ants inside the room, which added to the already unpleasant environment. Cleanliness was a major issue throughout the resort, and it was hard to relax knowing the place was so neglected.

The staff had an attitude, and the customer service was non-existent. After my wife wrote a review, we were promised by management that they would “make things right,” but when we spoke to customer relations, no action was taken. They offered empty reassurances but didn’t follow through on any solutions.

Expect to waste an hour every day just to make dinner reservations. Even when we were first in line on one day, we were denied our preferred restaurant because others had already booked. Only when we asked did they explain that reservations could be made for multiple days in advance—something they should’ve communicated clearly. The food was bland, and the main buffet restaurant, Malva, was dirty, with long lines to get in. The overall dining experience was disappointing, and the options were limited.

Despite being an “all-inclusive” resort, basic services were sorely lacking. No beach services were offered, not even something as simple as access to cold and clean water. There were no lifeguards at the pool or beach, and finding a sunbed was nearly impossible. When we asked, we were told to rent a cabana for $250 a day or just put our towel on the ground.

We traveled with a newborn and requested a kettle to prepare bottles. Instead, they brought us dirty water in a thermos, which was completely unacceptable.

Overall, this resort is outdated, poorly managed, and provides subpar service. It doesn’t live up to its claims and definitely isn’t worth the price. Save your money and book elsewhere.

reviews.author: Rebeca Oliver
reviews.text:
I cannot recall ever having to write a bad review for a hotel before. I stayed at Meliá Paradisius Cancun recently, and it was a complete disaster. The hotel was overcrowded, making it nearly impossible to enjoy anything. Worse yet, there were never any staff available to help. When I asked for assistance, I was either ignored or told there was nothing they could do.

I have severe vegan and gluten-free restrictions, and the hotel failed miserably to accommodate them. Room service repeatedly sent meals I couldn’t eat—vegan chia pudding with yogurt, and gluten-free bread that contained eggs. Staff at the restaurants didn’t know the ingredients and couldn’t be bothered to find out. They offered no solutions, leaving me frustrated and hungry.

The room itself was awful—old, poorly maintained, and without hot water for three days. One day, there wasn’t even running water. It felt like the hotel didn’t care at all.

This disaster ruined my birthday. I was forced to check out early and pay extra for another hotel, when they were about the same price to begin with. Although the hotel promised to refund my unused days, I still haven’t received my money.  I'd prefer to never deal with this chain again.

This was one of the worst travel experiences I’ve ever had. Save yourself the stress—don’t stay here.  The glowing reviews must be fake.

reviews.author: Deev P
reviews.text:
If you found my review, you just WON a jackpot, because Google is being biased and showing all positive reviews for resorts or what they call is most helpful, I wonder to whom. My low reviews and others like mine are berried/filtered out.

We just came back from this resort after staying 7 nights, and let me share you my experience as vegetarians.  If you're vegetarian, DO NOT GO HERE. GET THE HELL AWAY. Please don't take this lightly.

We had our hopes very high before booking and going to this resort based reviews that I read and we felt very good about it, but it was anything but that.

Starting with positives
- Resort and rooms are nice, but don't be fooled by it
- We had a Ocean view room and it was breath taking
- Alcoholic beverages were good. Some known brands

Negative reviews...where do I begin?
- Customer service 1/5, people were nice, but they were not accommodating, not sure if it was because of hotel's policy or what, but staff wouldn't bend
- We were there to celebrate our 25th anniversary, we requested one King bed with Ocean view upon booking, what we got was ocean view with 2 double beds. We requested to change, but we were told all sold out and we had booked 2mth in advanced
- We advised them of our anniversary date and we were told they would do something special, NOTHING...just another day
- ALL Restaurants on this Resort SUCK 1/5, Italian had to be the WORST one. As a vegetarians, Italian/Mexican food is always a go to for us, but not here. Any item that they had without meat, was HORRIBLE...horrible, the waiter at the Italian was so rude when I asked if they had pizza. He asked me is it in the menu, I said no, then he replied rudely and said then NO.  They WILL NOT / WOULD NOT do any modifications in your order.
- Nachos, OMG, horrible horrible, Chips tasted burnt all time and served by them selves, No melted Cheese.
- My wife and I got sick 3 days after getting there. We ate junk everyday. Everyday we would try different restaurants and go back to Malia (buffet)
- Buffet at Malia, OMG, who manages this? Everything is allover. if Bread is in one corner, then butter is in completely opposite corner from where bread is
- Salt / Pepper is put out in a open bowl, not in a shaker, you have to use your bare finger to pick salt, nothing on tables
- No ketchup to be found anywhere (found one place during the lunch, at Pizza place of all places)
- Pizza is prepared from ready made pizza shell
- NIGHT ENTERTAINTMENT SUCKS, It is so boring, and no, this is not our first all inclusive resort that we've been to. I would give this part 1/5
- Also everything is a UPSELL. To use any of the Cabanas on the property, $210 USD + 16% Tax / day
- Upon checking in, paid additional $30 USD for some sort of government fees

reviews.author: Marina Malachi
reviews.text:
Staying here now and it’s the worst customer service experience we’ve ever had in all inclusive Mexico hotels. I’ve never seen such arrogant Mexican “hospitality” before. Rooms are super old and outdated, there’s not much you can choose from buffet, fruits or juices are so bad which is surprising. You can not make reservations in the restaurant unless you have an upgraded room - crazy. And btw, you stil pay a loooot of money for the room, which is not worth even half of it.

Don’t waste your money for this hotel, there’s plenty around which are way better.

reviews.author: Kris Gaming YT
reviews.text:
The checked in service was not friendly.  We asked if we could have the rooms in the same building and the same floor.  Their answer was oh the rooms are preselected and they don't even pretend to help and accommodate.  When I told them it was my birthday and if there's something special they can do and the guy doesn't bother to look at me and told me flatly to talk to the bell boys.

The Buffett area is very small for such a big resort.  Be prepared for a long lineup if you wished to eat there.  The food selection is not good at all and it's just meh.  Fruit selection is also terrible especially for a tropical country.  Their juices are not freshly pressed as opposed to many others I have been to.

They do not have many lounge chairs and if you wished to get one, you need to make sure you're there by 7.  Their night activities is either boring or none at all.  We pretty much end up going back to our rooms early.

The only positive thing is the beautiful beach.

I'll definitely not come back here nor will I recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Sydni Worley
reviews.text:
I am going to start by saying I have literally never written a review before. Usually if it is a positive experience, I unfortunately forget. If it is a bad experience, I try to just brush it off.

But months later, I am still thinking about how absolutely horrible our experience was at this resort. It was my husband and I’s honeymoon. When we first walked in, the experience was nothing short of magical. They offered us a drink right when we walked in, the resort was beautiful, and the customer service was great (other than the fact that we had to wait 45 minutes for them to check everyone who had just entered in, but we both had a drink in hand and were in such a dreamland, we didn’t mind!)

The first two days were great. My husband and I restaurant hopped, drank espresso martinis, and truly just had a blast. The lady in charge of entertainment was just amazing. My husband and I did water pilates, and it is still one of our favorite memories to this day!

Unfortunately, that is where the magic came to an end. We had excursions planned for our 4th and 5th day, and we were so excited. That is, until my husband woke up violently throwing up. I went to the front desk requesting a doctor, and they made light of the situation by asking if it was just alcohol poisoning. Listen, I get it. It is a private all-inclusive resort, they most likely have several customers who over indulge in beverages. This was simply not the case for us. It was clearly food poisoning. I went back to our room after this, praying he would start to feel better in the next few hours. But when 4pm rolled around, and he was still gagging (at this point blood), I decided we needed a doctor. The doctor came to our room after telling me that at minimum it would be a $500 charge, which was a huge number as a young newly wed couple, but we had to stomach it. The doctor did help, but I will say, at one point I saw him looking on safari to see if certain medicines could mix and he couldn’t really explain to me what he was giving my husband. He then told me that if he didn’t stop throwing up in the next hour, we would need to get a ride to the nearest emergency room which was an HOUR away. I felt completely alone, and considering he was suffering from food poisoning from THEIR food, I would have assumed they would cover most charges or at least offer to help us get a ride.

Thankfully, my husband took a turn for the better. He slept the rest of the evening, finally getting a break from throwing up. And I went to dinner by myself that night, which was just so sad on our honeymoon.

The next day, things got WORSE! My husband was feeling somewhat better, but could only stomach eating bread. At this point, I was nervous to touch any of the food so I did basically the same thing. We spent most of the day on the beach and when we came back in the room to get ready for dinner, I was going to put on my wedding ring. I had tried hiding it every other day, but this day, we were just so excited to be back outside that I completely forgot to hide it. While we were gone, some member of room service came in and stole my ring. We spent over an hour digging in the room, going through everything. In order to report a stolen item, we had to have police come into our room to also search through our items. They then told us that it would take 72 hours to conduct interviews and that it would be hard to know who did it considering around 20 people have access to our room at any point (this is kind of an unsettlingly large number of people in my opinion) and that it was most likely a lost cause. That was it. They didn’t offer to do anything. That was our last night there before waking up the next morning just so happy to finally get to leave.

This was actually all together a terrible experience and a nightmare of a honeymoon. My husband and I have talked about redoing our honeymoon experience at our one year. This time, however, it will be in the mountains.

reviews.author: Brandon Halavi
reviews.text:
If I could give less than one star, I would. This venue has been a complete nightmare and has ruined what should have been a joyous time in our lives. From start to finish, Gloria and her team have been unprofessional, dishonest, and entirely unreliable. We chose this venue and paid a substantial amount because Gloria herself promised us the Del Prado ballroom. We have it all in writing and even a voice recording of her confirming this space. But when we showed up for our tasting, after flying all the way out to the hotel, they suddenly informed us that the ballroom was no longer available. There was no warning, no heads-up—just a complete shock when we arrived. They didn’t even bother to tell us beforehand.

This bait-and-switch tactic was just the beginning. They also attempted to overcharge us for the room block, quoting rates higher than what they advertised on their own website. When we questioned this, they had no real explanation, and it felt like they were simply trying to take advantage of us. It’s appalling and downright unethical.

Now, with our wedding just weeks away, they’ve stopped responding to us entirely. We are left in the dark, unsure if we even have a venue at this point. The stress this has caused is overwhelming. We had expected professionalism and care from a venue of this standing, but instead, we’re dealing with silence and unanswered calls.

To make matters even worse, they refuse to return our deposit, even though they failed to honor their commitments. Holding onto our money without delivering on the promises they made is beyond frustrating; it’s disrespectful and feels like outright theft.

I can’t urge people strongly enough to avoid this venue. Save yourself from the heartache, stress, and disappointment. The lack of transparency, bait-and-switch tactics, and appalling communication from Gloria and her team have turned what should have been a beautiful planning process into a nightmare. Please, don’t make the same mistake we did.

reviews.author: Marcel & Andreea Bodea
reviews.text: today we came back from vacation. We cannot say that we were extremely pleased with this hotel. A lot of food indeed, but only their Mexican food. I didn't find any steak or anything at any restaurant.  I don't know how clean they cook there because I felt very bad with my husband and my 3 children from the food, we had a lot of indigestion with vomiting and diarrhea for the 6 days we stayed there. Bad experience

reviews.author: Tomer Carmiel
reviews.text:
I am here for not even a day , I come to the pool to reserve pool chairs at 6:45am. The guard comes over and tells me I can’t do that till 7am. Ok 7:01 now and “Arny” the cabana boy tells me while I’m setting up that if I am gone for more than 45 min they will remove all of our things.
Isn’t the point of vacation is to relax , that is not one of the feelings I am experiencing right now.
We spent almost 3 couple 5k per couple. So almost 20k with kids and this is what you have to deal with over pool chairs.
If you are going to pack a hotel like livestock have the grounds accommodate or do not be Soo greedy and take our money and not provide the quality service you advertise
Pic taken at 720am with plenty of chairs not being used.

reviews.author: Chad Bacon
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun from 2/8-2/14. Overall, we were disappointed with our stay. This is not a 5 star hotel and the poor quality of the rooms, food and drinks reflects that. Don't be fooled.

The biggest thing that turned us off to the Paradisus was the "concierge" staff that are actually part of the sales staff for the Melia Circle Club. Upon arrival, we were approached by Oscar, a concierge. Looking back, his friendly conversation was used to gather info on us to see if we could to suckered into buying a membership into the Melia Circle Club. Oscar told us to find him later for our free welcome gift for simply staying at the hotel. The next day, Oscar asked us if we wanted our gift, which was going to be a new beach bag, a massage for my wife and a discounted massage for myself. He sat us down by the sales office and over more friendly banter he told us that to receive free gifts we had to go through a presentation, that would take 30-45 minutes. We declined, but Oscar said that we would be helping him, as he receives a bonus for each group that goes through the presentation. His exact words were "just play the game." We accepted, as we still thought he was a good guy who truly cared about us as guests. During this time, he also promised me a bottle of tequila to take home. Once we accepted, he brought over another "concierge" named Cinthia, whom he said was his boss and he just wanted to show her he was doing his job. Cinthia then brought over the "big boss" an older, gentleman, who led us into the sales room and introduced us to a salesperson, Eduardo.

The presentation began with questions on how much we paid to stay at the hotel, how often we travel, how often we would like to travel, etc. He recommended we join the blue membership, which is entry level. For the LOW PRICE of $36,255, we could join, which would allow us access to low rates to other Melia properties, upgraded rooms/food/drink for free, etc. We would need to ONLY put $12,000+ down today and pay a LOW monthly payment of $869/month at 8% interest for 36 months, which came out to ONLY $1255/month with 4 weeks at hotels for free. I couldn't help but laugh at this offer. Eventually the offer became $29,000, with $2500 down and $369/month BEFORE interest with 7 weeks free. He said to keep this deal quiet because it was so good. Ha! I continued to say no, even though Eduardo said that type of money is nothing for Americans and that he recently sold a Canadien couple who were younger than us and the husband was "just the manager of a store." The back and forth continued and he offered to take less money down, $499 and finance for 48 months. I informed him there was no way we were going to say yes despite his trips to the office of the "big boss" to get a "better deal." Eduardo ended the presentation asking me if I want to pay double or triple to travel and I told him, yes, that is fine with me. Before leaving he asked one final time if he made the monthly payment lower to $200/month or $100/month, would we sign. No Eduardo, we want to leave. After an hour, we were finally out of there without joining the club.

After that, Oscar was no where to be found and over the next few days. If we saw him he would bury his head in his phone or pretend like he didn't see us. Suspicious, I did some research on the Melia Circle Club and if you look online, it is described as a scam by those who unfortunately signed the contract. On our last night, we ran into Oscar and he asked where we had been, to which my wife responded, where have you been and where is my free massage? He acted shocked that we hadn't received the gifts promised and blamed Eduardo. We had already gone to the spa for massages so I declined his offer for a massage coupon. He then offered me $100 at the hotel gift shop which I laughed at. We settled on a $100 gift certificate, as we had extra charges from dinnerss. I brought up the bottle of tequila he had promised and he said he would get it to me that day. I never received a bottle of tequila. BEWARE OF THESE PREDATORY PRACTICES!

reviews.author: Nirari Barm
reviews.text: The service and staff were very good and clean.  But the quality of food compared to other high-end hotels for similar $$$ was low and expected more for the price.  On our fourth day, there was construction right above us in the morning with loud machinery, and we had to let the staff know 3 times until it stopped while our baby was sleeping.  They didn't bother to check if there were guests below before doing that. The pool didn't have enough chlorine in it, and our baby got sick on the way back home.

reviews.author: Aldo Rios
reviews.text: Booked a ocean view reserve suite and didn’t get it. Room service sucks. Water from shower completely flooded the bathroom due to poor construction. AC can’t keep the room cold. Management doesn’t care. Not worth it.

reviews.author: Milagros Martinez
reviews.text: Believe me if you're reading this. I came on a family vacation and stayed here in 2018 and let me tell you it was amazing great vibe amazing food staff etc. This year we decided to have another family vacation and I insisted we stayed here from past experience. However we were highly disappointed and won't ever stay here again. So much has changed over the past few years to start off they lost my one family members of luggage and when I asked about it they said it was impossible and it couldn't have happen. We demanded that it was taken or lost and that we needed it back had money passport and other valued items inside .. few minutes later turns out it was handed to another person and that person was nice enough to return it and when they returned our luggage they weren't even apologetic about the situation or apologized for saying it was "impossible". Second issue was when making the reservation here we asked if my family could be put in rooms next to each other or at least across the hall because they only allow 3 adults per room, they were super understanding and said it was a grantee that they always put rooms close or next to each other when it's a big family.. we show up and the rooms are in complete different tower buildings in random floors we asked reception about it and they were super rude saying there was nothing that could be done. Sadly our family had to be separated all over the hotel. Third issue our balcony wasn't cleaned for 3 days I had to call reception to send someone to clean it. Mini bar fridge wasn't stocked up for 4 days we got there Monday we called Wednesday asking why it hadn't been restocked that we needed some water bottles and etc they were super apologetic about it and said their staff was suppose to go everyday and that they would report this issue, then said they were sending someone up right away to restock it. They never showed up again super frustrated we called again Thursday about having the fridge stocked and the issue we were having for the past 3 days when they finally decided to come and restock. I mean there was so many issues with this hotel. Food is okay it's not great but it definitely isn't horrible either it's  mediocre I mean for all inclusive what do you expect. Drinks are okay also not the best. Wait time for restaurants vary from 1 hour estimated time to eat. Their inside club closes at 11 back in 2018 it closed around 1pm so the vibe is dead at night. No AC in the hotel lobby only its so hot only AC in the rooms. Staff is a hit or miss some are really nice and friendly others are rude and annoyed. Last day we asked to speak with the manager the guys at costumer service said he couldn't make that happen for us? My whole family was highly disappointed and definitely won't be staying here ever again! If you reading this please trust me im not the type to write reviews... looks can be deceiving it's a beautiful looking hotel don't get me wrong but what was once a great hotel has now disappointed and completely transformed. Next time we are in Cancun we will be staying at the hard rock or so many other hotels to choose from. Sad disappointing experience.

reviews.author: radhika b
reviews.text:
This is a money making scheme kind of an all inclusive hotel. They will charge you exorbitant prices for everything even after you have paid for an all inclusive.
Do not book here. We have had friends stay in Marriott, Riu and other big hotels which were better.
We were fooled by the pictures and reviews.
The location is same as all other resorts.
The restaurants are not great, not too many options for vegetarians.
Overall super disappointed. Will stay in big brand hotels like we do from next time! Also, no night activities or clubs here. So nothing much to do for adults. Save your money and go to another more happening hotel!
Special mention for the concierge- ZERO help. Having stayed at a ton of 4 and 5 star hotels, this one really sucked.
Esp Cuoh was extremely rude and spoiled our experience.

reviews.author: Fatemeh Moghimi
reviews.text:
**DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY!**

Our stay was a complete disaster, and I don’t even know where to begin. We booked a Family Concierge Junior Suite with an ocean view directly through the Melia website for 4 nights and 5 days, and I specifically requested a king bed. Instead, we were given a room with two double beds.

To make matters worse, our first room was filthy. All the glass doors and mirrors were smeared with dirt, there was a ball of hair on the shower floor, a used razor was left in the shower caddy, and water wouldn’t drain from the shower. The room also had a revolting smell. I immediately complained to the front desk, and they assured me someone would come to clean the room again and that we’d be moved to a room with a king bed the next day. However, after housekeeping came and went, the room was still just as dirty. The only change was that they sprayed an unbearable air freshener throughout, making the smell even worse. We had to air the room out for an hour, but it was still difficult to stay in because of the overpowering stench.

The next day, we were moved to another room, but once again, it had double beds although I was ASSURED that this time, the room does indeed have a kind bed. Although the new room was clean, the air conditioning didn’t work properly—it wouldn’t turn off, and we couldn’t adjust the temperature or fan speed. And as if that wasn’t enough, after a heavy rainfall, our room flooded, and we had to use towels to contain the water.

On top of the filthy, faulty rooms, the food was dreadful. The sushi at Lemon Fish was worse than supermarket sushi, and the food at MALVA Food Bazar was either bland or downright disgusting. The pizza from Mascalzon was tasteless, and the food ordered by the pool was stale and disappointing. Even the sodas were watered down. The vegetarian options were extremely limited and what little vegetarian food was available was always contaminated with meat due to a lack of serving utensils by each dish. The food was so bad that my kids survived on nothing but bread, fries, chips, and fruit during our entire stay.

The staff constantly expected tips for even the smallest service. If you gave them anything less than $5, they would give dirty looks and delay service for the rest of the day.

Bottom line: DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS HORRIBLE HOTEL. We deeply regret our decision, and you will too!

reviews.author: Emir Exploring
reviews.text:
⭐☆☆☆☆

If you’re looking for a peaceful, luxurious getaway—this is NOT the place for you. Paradisus Cancun markets itself as a high-end, all-inclusive resort, but in reality, it feels more like an overpriced, overcrowded party hotel with subpar service and mediocre food.

First off, the food quality is nowhere near what you’d expect from a “luxury” resort. Bland, uninspired, and barely edible at times. The buffets feel like a glorified cafeteria, and the VIP restaurants? Good luck getting a reservation unless you enjoy eating at 10 PM.

Want to relax in the evening? Too bad. There’s a DJ blasting music until midnight every single night. Apparently, the resort thinks we all came here for a Vegas-style nightclub experience rather than a tranquil beachside retreat. Forget about getting a peaceful night’s sleep—you’ll be serenaded by bass thumping through the walls instead.

And let’s talk about customer service. Or rather, the complete lack of it. Staff are indifferent at best and dismissive at worst. Any issue you bring up is met with either confusion or a vague “we’ll look into it,” which, spoiler alert, never happens. It’s almost impressive how little they care.

For the price we paid, I expected a luxurious, relaxing experience. Instead, I got loud music, disappointing food, and indifferent service. I truly don’t feel like I’m on a vacation at a luxury resort. If you’re considering booking here, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

reviews.author: Brittany Sheppard
reviews.text:
The location and beach at this resort are perfect. HOWEVER,

This hotel is seriously lacking in all other areas. The rooms are nice and spacious however the showers and bathroom area need updating. The other issue with the room is the balcony. If you are sitting in the lounge chairs provided the only thing you are looking at is the concrete wall in front of you and cannot see the ocean (this is in every room).

The main issue at this resort is the service. It was absolutely horrible. We booked the Reserve so we had our own check in area however check in still took an hour.  They had my husband and I in a room with 2 double beds when my reservation had booked a king. They were "trying to see" if there was a king available but was advising that since it was a busy time there might not be. After seeing me immediately annoyed and mentioning that I booked a king suite, he was eventually able to locate one. My In-laws has the same experience checking into their room.

The service all around the entire hotel was just awful. We waited over an hour and a half at EVERY restaurant EVERYDAY to get our food and a bunch of times the food was never even bought out (specifically Lemon Fish, Aqua Marina, Sante, Blue Agave, Sal). My husband was furious after waiting over an hour for 4 tacos at Blue Agave. Waiting so long wastes a huge chunk of your day when you want to be out in the sun enjoying the beach or the pool. The buffet was not great and is poorly designed. They have egg stations however be prepared to wait over 30 minutes while being bumped by several passing people moving around buffet and children running.

The food quality overall was not great. The only place we had decent meals were at Sante and Sal (both only allowed for Reserve Side Guests) however it still took over an hour.

The Atrium is an area in the Adults Only section that serves breakfast and lunch and has a bar. There are not many people there so it does not get busy however one morning my Father In Law ordered a bagel with salmon and they advised him it would be over 45 minutes which was ridiculous.

The service around the pool and and the beach is non-existent. If you are not in the first two umbrellas on the beach in the Reserve side then no one will come to you. You are not allowed to sit in any of the pool cabanas unless you reserve them ahead of time however you are only allowed 2 per stay. The worker who does the seating is extremely inflexible so if you do not like your cabanas location, too bad (even if there are several still open).
My father in law had asked several people to send a waiter over however the only person who kept continuously coming over was someone from the property trying to sell time shares which was extremely annoying.

SIDENOTE: There is NO SWIM UP BAR in the adults only section! Which was pretty shocking to me and major thumbs down.
The daily/nightly activities and entertainment are pretty awful. (except for the New year's Eve Show)

Due to its many issues, Lalo the concierge explained that this hotel is closing in May 2025 for a year and a half to conduct renovations.

The only positive to this place was Lalo the concierge. He was able to book all of our reservations and get everything done that was requested him.  He advised us that at Sante (Reserve Guests Only) they do a special dinner on Thursdays. We did ours the night before we left and it was the ONLY time we got good service and our meals came quickly (it is a set menu).

We went for New Years Eve which they did a pretty good job on the event. The service that night was actually pretty attentive (due to it being in the ballroom and it being the catering staff).

My advice is SKIP THIS HOTEL. Although it looks beautiful you waste a lot of time and money here because a lot of things are "Extra Charge". Book somewhere else if you don't want to spend your entire vacation waiting in restaurants for mediocre food.

reviews.author: Shirin M
reviews.text:
Where do I begin, bad service, noise until 4:30 in the morning, we couldn't sleep.
We were not able to reserve any restaurants because they were all booked.
Long line getting to buffet.
No spot by the pool or the beach.
Took a cold shower because the hot water went out.
Dirty rooms and outdated.
I will add more in the next few days.
We have staying at RIU and Barcelo for the past 10 years, we want to give another resort a chance to try. Big mistake, no comparison.

reviews.author: Vaishnavi Reddy
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Paradisus (Pyramid 3) and unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory. Despite being an all-inclusive resort, the quality of the amenities and services left much to be desired.
The rooms were outdated and in dire need of renovation. There were visible damages to the infrastructure, which made the stay uncomfortable. The trash was not cleaned up when we first went in and we needed to coordinate back and forth with the hospitality front desk to get the maintenance team fix issues with the bathroom  which cuts into our time at the resort as we have to be available for the maintenance team's unscheduled visit to explain the issues. They never gave us a change of room and asked us to pay extra for an upgrade thus leaving us stuck in the same room. The bath tubs and the sink were damaged and outdated causing leakages.
The buffet food was subpar, lacking variety and flavor. It was quite disappointing considering the resort's all-inclusive promise. The staff at Malva buffet did not backfill the dishes and always had missing cutlery.
The staff's attitude was another major letdown. They were often rude and unhelpful, which significantly impacted the overall experience. Gabriela at the front desk was very unempathetic and impolite even on the day of check out when we shared about our experience at the resort.
The remaining restaurants require reservations so please expect long waiting time to get in line and most restaurants were disappointing with inadequate staff who were unable to attend us for 30 mins after getting seated.
Overall, I would not recommend Paradisus to anyone looking for a pleasant and relaxing vacation. The only plus point is the direct access to the beach with cabanas which is something I will fondly remember. There are better options available that offer superior service and facilities on the same hotel strip.

reviews.author: Alison L
reviews.text:
I just check in tonight. I booked this trip through Costco Travel and already upgraded Junior Sweet Ocean View. The front desk offered me an one more upgrade, but I declined. And they gave me the old&dirty one bedroom even the sands on the floor. I called the front desk and informed them of the problem and hoped they would take care of it.
But the front desk staff told me there was only one way and that was to upgrade. OMG WHY? Eventually I went to the front desk to argue and they changed my room to a two bedroom junior suite ocean view room which they said they didn't have. My new changed room is in building 3. Too much noise, no working refrigerator, Air conditioner not working properly, Water is leaking from the shower to the toilet. I don't want to argue with them anymore. Because my young children were very scared when they saw our arguments. It's horrible having to spend six nights in this room, I decided not to argue anymore for my kids. I swear I will never stay at Melia’s Hotel again. I will go back to Hyatt.

reviews.author: Sabine Najarian
reviews.text: The most horrible hotel I have visited! The hotel was sooo old, the room was leaking water through the wall of the bathroom, flooding the room! The staff was unhelpful! The pool area is mediocre! No chairs available! The staff had the audacity to tell us to wake up at 5:30 am to reserve a chair on the poolside otherwise we needed to pay 250 USD to book a bed on the poolside otherwise which was already sold out! No towels available so we had to sit on the floor without any towel and kids would get cold after coming out of the pool because we had no towels!!! The buffet us always empty! All food stations gave line ups! U have to wait and wait and wait to be able to eat! No entertainment or if there is, it is mediocre! The worst hotel experience I have ever had!!!! Would not recommend it to anyone ! Oh by the way, very overpriced!!!!

reviews.author: Dan B. Daneshgar
reviews.text:
Two pros: location, building architecture

Cons: countless
Limited food,
Super old building.
Bad service,
Smell of mold
Extensive noise from the club across the road. Every night till 4 am

One day with no hot water in the building! I understand problems happen. But I don't understand how a business doesn't care about their reputation. Just saying sorry!

You got to pay for every normal thing that is free in all inclusive hotels

Beach is nice. Not many seats are available though. Most of the beach and pool area is occupied by cabanas. $250 per day!

reviews.author: Aw B
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun, and I must say it was a very disappointing experience. This resort markets itself as a luxury all-inclusive, but in reality, it operates more like a money-grab operation.
•	Not a Proper All-Inclusive: Most of the premium food options in restaurants come with an extra charge. Only basic food is included in the package, and even something as simple as fries will cost you extra.
•	Pool & Cabanas: The pool chairs are never available unless you reserve them before 7:00 AM. If you want a cabana, be prepared to pay a ridiculous $250 USD per day.
•	Unprofessional Staff: The staff is very unprofessional and, in some cases, outright arrogant. They are often misleading, and it’s difficult to get a straight answer.
•	Dirty Towels & Sales Pitch: Towels are handed out by the Aqua Activities team, and you’ll be subjected to their sales pitch before getting one. Even then, the towels are not always clean.
•	Constant Sales Pitches: One of the most annoying aspects was the constant interruption by photographers trying to sell their services, multiple times a day, whether you’re at the pool or on the beach.

The facility itself is poorly maintained. There was no hot water for over 24 hours during my stay, and the staff offered no assistance or apology. It also rained, and my room flooded. This wasn’t an isolated incident — multiple families experienced the same issue. The staff showed no urgency in helping us.

The food quality was average at best, and several people in my group experienced vomiting and diarrhea. To make things worse, the chefs hardly understand English, so requesting anything customized is pointless.

Overall, this resort fails to deliver a true all-inclusive luxury experience. It’s overpriced, poorly managed, and focused on upselling services instead of guest satisfaction. I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for a relaxing and hassle-free vacation.

Dear Guest Service Center Management,

Thank you for your response, but I must express my disappointment with the dismissive tone and lack of accountability in your reply.

Firstly, referring to your offerings as "an array of gourmet options included in your stay" is misleading when basic items like fries and guacamole are either unavailable or come at an additional cost. This is not the hallmark of a true all-inclusive luxury experience.

Secondly, the suggestion to make early reservations for cabanas disregards the fact that a $250 USD daily fee is far from reasonable for most guests. Calling it "an inviting and relaxed atmosphere" does not justify the exorbitant cost.

The unprofessional attitude and lack of urgency shown by your staff during serious issues, such as room flooding and the absence of hot water for over 24 hours, are unacceptable. Your team’s failure to address these matters adequately left many guests feeling neglected.

Additionally, your claim of prioritizing cleanliness contradicts my experience. Towels were not only unclean but were distributed after an intrusive sales pitch. Furthermore, the pool cleanliness left much to be desired, with sand present and the water being too cold for comfort.

As for the culinary experience, describing it as “inspiring and delicious offerings” is disingenuous when the food quality was subpar, and several guests in my group fell ill. The language barrier with your chefs compounded the issue, making it impossible to request customized meals.

Your response has only reinforced my perception that guest satisfaction is not your priority. I hope you take this feedback seriously and implement the necessary changes to meet the expectations you set through your marketing. Unfortunately, based on my experience, I cannot recommend your resort and will be sharing my review with others to help them make informed decisions.

reviews.author: mauricio k
reviews.text:
Worst place to stay in cancun. Having come to cancun for 20 years and staying at every level of hotel, all inclusive or a la carte, and this is by far the worst experience. All restaurants, except the crappy buffet, are reservation only. Which means, you have an early dinner, look for a cool place to grab a bite at 10 that is completely empty, NOPE they can't seat you. Mind you, they close at 11. There isn't a soul inside, there is nowhere else to go because the 4 other restaurants say the same thing. You can't eat anywhere without a reservation, hard stop.  Our check in happened at 5 first day, the "concierge" closes at 5, they're the only person who can book you anywhere. So your SOL, you're literally going to go home without getting seated at a restaurant.
Room service isn't bad, takes 90 minutes at least
Bars all close at 2300. Room service can't take you drinks after 2300

Ordered drinks at the bar, they swished some tap water in the cup after someone else had used, no soap, no washing. Great way to catch something unexpected and very disappointing.

This place really is terrible
Poorly organized, poorly run. The app doesn't work
The beach isn't swimmable.
The pools aren't heated. They're un-swimmable unless you enjoy 65 degrees water
You can't eat without a reservation.
The concierge that you pay for is a joke. Only available "9-4". Waste of $$
The rooms are run down. This place is shutting down in june allegedly, and rightly so. Hopefully they don't open back up because this really is a terrible use of your money. 0/5. Awful experience
The ONLY saving grace is a handful of the staff, the majority are honestly terrible. Joan was awesome to helping us get a table, armando at the luggage check in was excellent, but the one who really saved us this trip was Gaudencio. He made the experience bearable. His counterpart Francisco en la playa was also excellent. These are the people who make the hotel and made it bearable. If you can't cancel your reservation and you're stuck at this place, find these people and tip them because they will treat you excellently

reviews.author: Kyle Boehm
reviews.text:
If you're looking for the worst vacation of your life, look no further! This place has it all...worker strikes, mediocre food, dingy rooms and fraud!
In all seriousness, I wouldn't recommend this place to my worst enemy. There was a worker strike during our stay because they hadn't been paid in over 90 days. While the majority of the staff are friendly, there seems to be no cohesion between different parts of the resort. You'll feel like an absolute afterthought in The Reserve section of the hotel. The cherry on top to our stay was being charged for 2 bottles of wine costing $900 a piece at Sal Steak Cave that the waiter decided to upgrade for us without letting us know. Multiple members of the staff surrounded our table and demanded immediate payment by credit card as soon as we had finished our meal.
DO NOT SUPPORT THIS COMPANY. They do not care about you the moment they have your money. Their corporate department has been zero help in resolving our issues. They also do not care about their employees. YOU CAN DO BETTER!

reviews.author: Rizwan Chaudhry
reviews.text:
Thanks GPT. So let me break it down for you:

Towels: If you're looking to dry off after a swim, forget about it. The beach towel situation is Hunger Games-level competitive. Better bring your own or embrace being a damp beach gremlin.

Buffet Lines: Speaking of survival games, there's one buffet for the entire resort, with lines so long you'd think they were serving Michelin-star meals. Spoiler alert: they’re not. By the time you get to the food, you’ll be so hungry even the mystery meat will look good.

Wait Staff: Rude would be an upgrade. These folks are auditioning for Mean Girls: Hospitality Edition. I half expected them to say, “You can’t sit with us!”

Property: Outdated charm? Sure, if “charm” includes torrential indoor rain showers. Some unlucky guests experienced their rooms transforming into Waterworld. Ours didn't flood—yay! But just to keep things interesting, the last day delivered a lovely drip-drip-drip in our room.

Wildlife: One roach made an appearance and demanded its 15 seconds of fame. I caught it on video for proof because this was starting to feel like a nature documentary: When Pests Attack.

Reservations: This is where it gets next-level scammy. Every restaurant is mysteriously "fully booked" despite glaringly obvious empty tables. But if you press them hard enough (and maybe perform an interpretive dance?), suddenly a table materializes. Magic! Or gaslighting—jury's still out.

Shower: If you love the thrill of a weak drizzle masquerading as a shower, you're in luck. The water pressure was so pitiful, I started calling it "the whisper wash."

Nightlife: If you value your eardrums or your heart rhythm, brace yourself. The nightly party bass is so intense, you'll feel it deep in your soul—and not in a good way.

Highlights: The lobby is genuinely gorgeous, but sitting in it feels like being the unpopular kid in a cafeteria with a restaurant smack in the center, flaunting its inaccessibility. The beach is stunning but operates on the same cruel seating shortage as the towels.

Best tip? Leave the resort.

reviews.author: Omer mimon
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus for the past week, I was shocked from the low quality food, we ate outside lunch and dinner, the italian restaurant has nothing in common with italian food.
The food is under every imagination.
The hotel is old , shower was leaking to the outside tile, toilet went overflowing.
Takes about 45min for room service to arrive.
You need to reserve a seat in the pool/beach at 7am if you want to have a normal seat in the pool cause there are limited tanning beds.
The only 1 good thing I can say is that the hotel staff is trying really hard to satisfy the clients but they have poor resources to work with.
Unlike Paradisus at Cabo San Lucas, this is the worst hotel I've been.
I won't go back there

reviews.author: Aj Makeup
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at a Paradisius for the second time, 1st time was in playa and this time cancun. My experience was not as pleasant as what I expected.

1st the food, the selection at the buffet was horrible, at one point I was just eating breakfast there because they couldn’t mess up egg so I was safe but the food was tasteless and always cold. Very disappointing there’s only one buffet for the family & adult side.

Now the beach restaurant & beach bar I was a major disappointment. The service was far from what I expected, they would come once every 2hrs on the beach for drinks I would always have to leave my chair and go get my own drinks annnnd still tip them at the bar.

Now the food area by the beach there are several things about the dining setup that were frustrating.

First, the resort has two separate menus—one for the POOL resto  ( burger, tacos, nachos, chicken wings…) and one for the RESTAURANT (more formal menu). While both menus come from the same kitchen, you're not allowed to order from the pool menu if you're seated at the beach restaurant. ( to order from the pool menu very important you have to have a bed or a sitting spot but you don’t because you are sitting at the beach and not by the pool). You can’t get food by the beach because the pool service guys don’t come and don’t serve you food by the beach.

Now  the beach restaurants have rules:

-You can’t order, leave and come back when the food is ready (takes about 45mins to 50mins wait to get your food)

-The insistence on dressing up for the beach restaurant is insane at one occasion, the staff told me I couldn’t sit at the BEACH RESTAURANT had to go back to my room, change into "decent" clothes( while I was already dressed up), return to order food their explanation was because theres business meetings happening (probably from the circle to sell the resort to new clients while they’re miss treating the returning ones.

-You can’t take your food to-go, you have to eat at the restaurant.

-Again you can’t order on the beach and continue to enjoy your time you have to waster about 1:30 by the restaurant because of all their rules.

-This level of formality was frustrating, especially when I was hoping to enjoy a more laid-back beach experience. Seemed like eating there was always a problem  was complicated and added an extra layer of stress. ( specifically that I couldn’t just leave to go eat at the buffet for the previous reasons listed above)

I could go on and on, on the unpleasant experience I had to go through during my stay, like room issues intense noise coming from the bathroom during the day and  in the middle of the night , or like after 23:00
