I booked my trip thru my credit card rewards site (which I always do and never had a problem). I received email confirmation of my stay for a luxury junior suite for 5 guest (my wife and 3 children), yet when I arrived at the hotel to check in, they only showed 1 regular room for 2 adults. I went back and forth with them for 4 hours!!! At the end of it, I had enough and I had to pay for a new reservation for 5 guest for an additional $300. They honestly just gave me a small basic room with a street view. Definitely NOT what I paid for initially. They tried to switch blame to my credit card service but the issue was with their reservation department. They tried calling them but no one picked up.

While in the hotel, the food was subpar in the restaurants, reservations took a long time although their Concierge did try to help as much as she could. They have an additional charge for a cabana, and for their steak house. They really should remove the "all-inclusive" they claim.

And whoever was the genius that design the entertainment stage in the middle of the hotel with super loud speakers should be fire immediately! Super loud in the rooms when you're trying to sleep. I stayed last year in their Playa del Carmen hotel and enjoyed that stay, I was expecting better from their cancun location but sadly not the case. I WILL never stay with them again.

1 star for hotel upkeep. The beach was infested with seaweed as well, other cancun hotels have much better up keep in their beach. Also, it took them 30 min and 2 calls to their front desk to get extra sheets and pillows. Needless to say but I'm super disappointed at the current stay... and I still have 2 days left in my stay.  SMDH!

reviews.author: Matilda Beqiri
reviews.text: There were definitely pros and cons!                 Pros: the resort is beautiful, food and the waiting staff were very good! Cons: the rooms were very old and dirty! They only dusted the tv stand, but the closet door and bathroom door was covered in dust! The bathroom sink was plugged all our stay. We had to call every day to bring us drinking water, and we stayed there for two weeks! We bought something in the inside stores, but they don’t accept dollars, so they told us to either pay with pesos or charge it to the room! We charge it to the room without knowing that we had to pay extra for not paying it on time! So, something that costed $15, we ended up paying $37! Also, my baby got sick, and when I asked in the middle of the night about the doctor, they said that the doctor comes at 9am. When we saw the doctor, she said that they have a doctor 24/7  in the resort!

reviews.author: S
reviews.text:
Worst all inclusive resort I’ve stayed, least friendly staff, and overpriced for what’s available. The food is awful unless you make a reservation, which none of the staff seems to be on the same page about. Also, check in process was a nightmare. We were there for a festival but had to house friends of ours in rooms that WE paid for just so they had a place to sleep because of the resort’s incompetence. More of a spring break hotel than a Mexican resort. While I do believe the quality of the stay was tainted by the arrival of the festival, we stayed extra days beforehand and we’re equally unimpressed. Would not recommend this resort to ANYONE.

EDIT: The replier wants to make it seem like nothing was brought to anyone’s attention. The staff was well aware of the problems and neither the event staff nor the hotel staff seemed to care and continued to lead everyone on with borderline lies and no updates. Also it takes a simple stay at almost any other resort in the Playa/ Cancun area to realize that this is no more than a glorified hotel. Better service, better food, more options, nicer staff, etc. The list goes on. Again, we stayed before the festival multiple days also and it was also absolutely nothing to write home about.

reviews.author: Miriam Mickel
reviews.text: The resort was NICE! The views were so awesome. I enjoyed my stay at paradisus cancun for the most part. However, one bad apple does spoil the entire bunch. We stayed May 31-June 5. The cooks that were at Sunset Grill on that Monday and Tuesday were very MEAN! I did not get their names however, I did get the name of the drink server who was also mean. He would not ask us if we wanted anything to drink. He skipped over us every time. His name was Luis. He was an older guy. He made us feel like we were "different" especially watching him ask other people what drinks they wanted. My kids should never have had to experienced that! I don't care what "kind of person" the sunset grill cooks and drink server preferred to wait on. The cooks were not nice at all! When we asked for food (wings) they would tell us that we could not get any. The last time I checked, we paid for an all inclusive vacation so why where we denied food? The resort was great! If it wasn't for these two incidents, I would give the resort all 5 stars.

reviews.author: tanya vi
reviews.text: This is one of the worst hotels I’ve ever stayed. Wanting peace and quiet we asked for a quiet room multiple times, emphasizing that it’s our ONLY request. We checked in at about 5pm, checked the room (it was quiet) and guess what?  At 9pm some weird concert started right under our windows with MARCHING band and screaming. Imagine listening to repeating drum roll for 2 hours. I went back to the receptionist (it was the same one that checked us in) and she pretended we never asked for a quiet room... people here don’t give a heck about your comfort. On top of that food is just terrible, everything is greasy, unhealthy and over sweetened. And when they gave us door keys they didn’t work after 10 tries, so we had to run back to the reception, then back to the room (receptionist claimed we didn’t use the key right, that’s why it wasn’t working), then wait for the “technician” to fix the door lock for us (still standing with our language near the room) for 25 minutes...

reviews.author: K W
reviews.text:
We are here now and had $$$ stolen from our safe. Trying not to let it ruin our vacation but they are doing nothing to compensate us. Very upsetting, we have been melia club members for 20 years, typically go to Dominican Republic and never had any problems.we made a hand written report to security personell and then spent days chasing down a response .
Sadly the resort is beautiful , the staff is excellent. So we are not happy to have to make this review. We are vacation club members and after securites "investigation" was complete , it was basically decided ," oh well ".
The door jam in room 1214 is damaged and you can tell it's been forced in the past. Even after showing this they still claimed they couldn't reimburse us . They gave spa credits in the amounts of $100 not nearly the $450 that was stolen.
Most of the $$ stolen would have gone out as tips !! .
We will update as we continue to hold paradisus , sol melia and their vacation club accountable . The rest of our stay I carried our important documents , Nikon camera and anything important w us in a backpack . To be clear , we are not drama people and have NEVER. Made a theft claim in our 30 years of

reviews.author: Katie N.
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review with the intention to let other up-coming guests to learn my lessons so they have a more pleasant vacation. We paid for the highest package (Reserve) but what we received is absolutely not what we paid for.
1. They promised you butler services but you don't see him/her unless you ask for them. So don't wait, ask for them right away at the check in desk. Many rooms in my group never met their butlers. You mostly need the butler to book restaurant reservations for you because you cannot book it through their app. Most of the time there is no reservation available on the app. If it does, there are only 2 or 3 seats available. If you go in a group, it is very hard for you to dine together. What's the point of traveling together but cannot dine together? You can try to call the reservation line to book but you don't have a record of it. (You have evidence if booking through the app or texting butlers.) The reservation representative booked a reservation for my aunt and uncle but when they went to the restaurant, the restaurant didn't have their reservation, and my aunt couldn't prove it to them. So my aunt and uncle had to leave to eat at the buffet. My aunt was so upset because on top of that, they hadn't been able to dine together with us. Things like this can totally ruin your vacation, which you paid high price for. Restaurant managers should accommodate guests who tell you that they have a reservation. I'm sure this doesn't happen a lot.
2. Some adult families in our group who were also Reserve guests wanted to stay in building 5 (Reserve building) but no room was available. They asked for building 4, also no room was available. They ended up in the noisy and a lot of traffic building 3. Paradisus should check back on their guests if they are still wanting to stay in building 5 when rooms are available.
3. Food is OK, not great. There were a few dishes that were too salty. Mixed drink is pretty plain and hit and miss. I only see one restaurant that is great, which is the La Palapa, but this restaurant is only for breakfast and lunch and for Reserve adults only. We cannot take much advantage of it because we have our kids with us. Be careful when you're eating sushi and drinking water. Half of our group got diarrhea from eating at ENSO. You need to buy diarrhea medicine from their store, the front desk doesn't have anything for you. They have a medical office but the doctor will charge you $100-200/visit.
4. There is too much seaweed on the beach. I don't know if they attempt to clean them but there is lots of it on the beach. You have to step on it to go to the water. If you dream of a beautiful Cancun beaches, well it's not here. The next door resort had a big net out in the sea and when I walked early in the morning, I saw them cleaning seaweed so their beach was clean and white. Paradisus should do the same.
5. If you are Reserve guests, when you arrive, ask the luggage guy to show you the way to building 5. If not, you will wait in line for 30-45 minutes at front desk of building 3 (main entrance) then they will tell you actually you need to go to building 5 to check in for Reserve. Normally 30-45 minutes wouldn't be a big deal, but it would when you just spent a whole day flying, being tired and hungry.
6. If you decided to take professional photos, schedule with them as early as possible, because they need time to edit and print or making any photo books for you. We received our pictures 10pm the night before we leave, and we leave very early the next morning.
7. If you decided to do scuba diving, don't eat at least 2-3 hours before you do it. All the guys in our group threw up badly because the boat was very shaky. My husband stayed in bed one whole day to recover. Paradisus's instructor should advise their guests about this.
8. Don't think that you can just walk in to buffet to eat when you want to. At peak hours, the wait could easily be 30 minutes.
If you're reading until this point, I wish you a great vacation!!

reviews.author: Luis D
reviews.text:
Never ever

The trim very old and bad maintenance
The service very rude and impolite
I put the towel of the bed and one men said why did u put a towel on the bed I said where o have to put it, maybe on the floor!?
Everything too much old! I told them several time to guest service and reception

reviews.author: J
reviews.text:
All included right?!? Parts of menus (extra charge) some restaurants not included. All full of surprises! Ah and not forget the initial "green tax" the one your agency always forgets to mention.
Pay attention to all the small letters around here. You have been warned.

reviews.author: Mark McQueen
reviews.text: Went on a trip 100% paid for by work. Absolutely the worst resort me and my wife have ever stayed at. Mattress was spring from 1960's, fridge did not work, both sink and shower drain were plugged and shower head leaked causing drywall to start falling off the ceiling and paint to flake on you while showering. That was only our room......Whole building smelled like a hippie shop from incense everywhere and was hot. Service was mediocre. Drinks were a hodgepodge of whatever they wanted to throw together and weak on cheap liquor. Then there was the food.....THE WORST FOOD I HAVE EVER HAD!!!! If you are wanting to go on a diet, this is your place because you will get sick trying to eat that stuff. We ate at the market cafe one night and that was actually pretty good. Other than that, nothing and I mean NOTHING was even edible. We would of been better off walking across the street and eating Mcdonald's every day/night. Never again will I stay at another Paradisus resort.

reviews.author: Kevin Gagnon
reviews.text:
Technical issue with the website where I was booked for 2 rooms on the same night (only needed one room). Immediately called hotel to rectify the situation and they refused to refund me. (again - minutes after the technical error occurred). When I showed up in person I spoke with the manager and again they refused to refund me and told me to "speak with my bank".
No common customer service/business sense.
Resort was fine, nothing special.
I ended up at the Moon Palace Resort about 20 minutes away - nicer, bigger, more activities. I'd recommend going there in the future.

reviews.author: Kee Crawford
reviews.text:
I would not book here again nor recommend to a friend.

My best friend and I purchased the highest package available to attended a festival hosted here. Our concierge seemed nice when showing us the facility and getting us in our room and then after that he was pretty much non existent and very delayed in responding to messages. We booked our stay for 2 days prior to the festival and 1 day after. On the 1st day of the festival access to food became extremely difficult as most of the restaurants turned into reservation only and room service was no longer allowed. There is absolutely no benefit in purchasing upgraded packages because everyone is treated the same. There was no ability to reserve cabanas even with an upcharge or vip seating/access Which is typical for Vip packages at festivals. This by far was the worst resort/ festival experience I have had and I do this many times over in the course of a year. Guest services called our room and had us meet with them to bring some resolutions to the issues we had. They offered us 15 dollars off of a massage and a new concierge, that was the ultimate slap in the face I have never been more dissatisfied and disappointed in a place.

reviews.author: Frank Ortiz
reviews.text:
I hope you will reconsider your stay here, after reading  my horrible experience.
Check in/out only 1 person working. The Hotel tells me what restaurant am I going to eat at every day and the time, so it was their choice and not mine. They only have 1 person answering the resetvation for the guest. I was holding for over 36 minutes till I walk to 4 difrent employees till finally I was able to get with someone and only to tell me what, where and time. It was a take it or go to the buffet.
Bell man never show up to help us with luggage. This Hotel has lots of potential to have clients like me to come back again and again. But they just dont care how much you complain, they just wont do nothing to make you happy! Is a take it or leaved. Other Hotels in Cancun will sit with you to plan your stay for the next 7 days with people on at least 4 difrent desk to help you plan you restaurant experience memorable.
Beautiful loacation and ocean view. Too bad they have no idea what customer service is all about. Its simple MAKE YOUR GUESTS HAPPY!

reviews.author: erik stengel
reviews.text: Had a great stay until we checked out and got charged a 100 dollars for a deep clean when one was absolutely not needed. Also the room above us threw all their cigarettes on our balcony every night and nothing was done about it. Besides us getting over charged!

reviews.author: Lash 'n Brow Haven Studio & Academy
reviews.text:
This one star is for all the servers. They are nice and friendly. The rest of the experience are horrible. I have no idea how they have so much star. I went for a wedding and they promise the rate will be the best for us if booking through their website. Well, it's not. I check on orbitz later and all other site offer better deal if you book a package with air fare. It's super expensive and all restaurants need 24 hr reservations. They are not flexible in appointment time for these restaurants at all and they only serve dinner.  Well, they make it super hard to reserve any restaurants and during our stay, We can only eat at the buffet and small snack bars. The food are horrific and disgusting for a 5 star resort. Seem like the food are soak in lime juice for a day, SOUR and Rubbery way over cook and left out for hours!!! Please hire better chefs.  The buffet food in a normal US restaurant will be way better than Paradisus.  My aunts are lucky enough to get to eat in one of the asian fusion restaurants but she said the food are just like buffet food, nothing good.

Oh and the air conditioning....horrible!! it is super hot and there's no ac in lobby or restaurants area. Our room is cooler but still not cool enough and the rest of the resort is like an oven. This makes the entire stay even worse. The reason I have to stay here in the first place was that if we stay somewhere else, they will double charge my cousin for the guests that come in for her wedding.

The workers and servers here work hard and friendly. I do like them a lot, they seem to be overworked by the management. The resort itself, no thank you. Never ever come again or recommend to anyone.

after 2 days staying at Paradisus, I can't take the heat and the food anymore I have to go to a different resort (GR Caribe Deluxe). The experience is totally different like heaven and earth. Food, service, AC, and no reservations needed for restaurant are all excellence.

reviews.author: Rachana Patel
reviews.text: Paradisus is the worst place to stay. The hotel is under construction when I booked it was not written that the hotel was under construction. The management does not even help you as you walk in my husband and I was standing there for over two hours just to check in the AC is not working in the whole entire hotel it’s very uncomfortable you’re there to relax you don’t even feel any type of relaxation. The restaurants they said nine restaurants online only six were operating, even as we complain to management nothing is what they stated online and management did not care at all the manager came up in the front and told me he’ll take care of some thing and he took care of nothing. He seem not to care of what we said . And the woman that checked ask and I’ll also said there was no manager over and over then finally he came out . Overall I give this hotel a zero. Worst vacation ever I’ve had and I went with my whole entire family thanking will have a nice vacation. I wish I chose a different hotel.

reviews.author: Gelnn Lau
reviews.text:
Buffet closes at 11:00am - 12:00 noon and other restaurants open at 11:00 am. However, although they seat you at 11:00 am and say kitchen will be ready in 10 minutes, staff are busy to clean up buffet and not able to return to work at the other restaurants and nothing can be ordered before 12:00 noon. As a result, you will be starving in the an all inclusive hotel everyday from 11:00 - noon. Furthermore, all the restaurants need to be reserve for dinners. Idea is good since you don't need to line up to wait for dinner. The problem is that there are not enough spaces for the guests and you have to race with other people to make reservation everyday. If not, you need to eat dinner at 10:00pm for the latest bookings or even nothing available. Eventually you may need to have buffet for every single meal.

NEWLY ADDED: Since I cannot response to the "Response from the owner" below, I edit my review here: I think "another restaurant opens for lunch" is talking about Feugo. Feugo was the one that seated me at 10:55 am and told me that the kitchen would be ready in 10-15 minutes. But I still could not place any order at 11:45am because the kitchen was still not ready. As for "the snack bar next to the pool", officially it opens at 11:30 am but the staffs start preparing foods, veggie, pizzas, etc at 11:30am. They will tell you that they need 30 minutes to get the burgers/hot dogs ready, and 2 hours for the french fries, which is ridiculous. For room service, I don't think people will want to hide in the hotel room to eat in lovely sunny days. I will prefer to go across the road and go to McDonald even I need to pay there.

This is the fifth time I have been to Cancun in past few years and I have no issue in staying at other hotels such as Grand Oasis, Hard Rock, Moon Palace, etc. The only reason that makes me try Paradisus is that Paradisus is the closest hotel to Acquaworld which I need to go there almost everyday. However, I will stay away from Paradisus since I want to have more dining choices everyday except buffet after enjoying my water activities.

reviews.author: Cassy Valentino
reviews.text: Very underwhelming and not worth the money. When we checked out, we were charged over $150 for using the palapa service which we never used. We almost missed our shuttle to the airport trying to get these charges resolved. We were told that they needed to put a card down before we left but that they were going to work on getting it removed. We were then told to call them the next day to speak with customer service to make sure the charge was dropped. We did just that except when I called customer service, they had no notes or any idea of the issue that had occurred. The man that checked us out charged us the $150 and did not work on getting the charge removed like he said he would be doing. Customer service questioned me why I didn't get this resolved when I checked out and I told them that I was going to miss my ride to the airport. They still havent been able to help me/do not believe me when I tell them we did not use the palapa service.  We gave this hotel a TON of our money, from using one of their photographers & buying photos, paying for a beachside dinner, booking all of our activities, paying for massages at the spa, going to Sal restaurant (which is not apart of the all inclusive & also gave me food poisoning btw). The system is flawed because the only information they ask for is your room number and then all of that adds up onto your tab that is paid when you check out. I could give anyones room number and they would be charged. It makes no sense. It is extremely disappointing that after the thousands we spent at this hotel, they try to charge us for even more money that was 100% not us.

reviews.author: Kristy Frost
reviews.text:
Cancún is wonderful. If you’re planning a trip, go for it, but think twice before you book with Paradisus Cancún.  We have had issue after issue with this place. The servers have been wonderful but the hotel itself and the way it’s managed and ran leaves much to be desired. We came for 7 nights with our kids and a family of our friends. 10 people total. Our friends have had a whole list of problems with their room but I will only speak of our experiences. Here is the list of what they need to fix before we will EVER consider spending $10k+ to vacation there ever again:

Wasted half our first day because they kept telling us to come back in 30-40 minutes and our rooms would be ready then we’d come back and they had put us in different buildings etc. We kept telling them all 3 rooms needed to be in the same building and not across the entire building from one another (we have kids with us and wanted them close)

Finally get to our room where it smells terrible like bug spray and the drawer to the dresser won’t even close

Had to call the concierge or track down employees to get our fridge restocked on 3 different days

Had bath towels replaced each day (although some days there weren’t enough) but never received any other towels (floor towels, wash clothes, hand towels after the first day and had to walk to the first floor and take them from the bathroom so we’d have them.

App has been consistently wrong. Says restaurants are open when they’re not: tried to go to Enso twice bc it doesn’t require reservations but it was closed.  Tried to make reservations at Market grill several different nights and it was closed 3 nights. We were only able to get reservations one night of the 7 we are here. We tried to make reservations a couple days in advance and were told they couldn’t make them that far in advance and to call back one day ahead. Every time we did that they would say they were booked and couldn’t get 10 people in.

The quality of the food in the buffet is definitely less than par!  Every single one of our group of 10 people was disappointed with the quality and taste of the buffet food. The restaurants have been pretty good, however, we’ve hardly been able to get into any of them.

App has also been very wrong about shows etc. several times. Just one example beyond the restaurants is when we planned on going to a “silent party” at the Red Bar. We planned our evening around it and then we get there and it’s canceled and the club is closed.

A whole row of bricks fell off the pool side while my son was in the pool and hit his foot. His foot was extremely bruised by the next day. When our friends told the manager about it she wasn’t even concerned for him.

We were never notified that there were two days of our trip that are “dry days” and we wouldn’t be able to get alcohol. When you’re paying for an all-inclusive and they can’t include what you’re supposed to be entitled to, that’s pretty bad business. Some of our money should be refunded.

The people who are selling for you guys are being dishonest. They’ve been trying to sell us a “bar hopping” trip that we almost booked for Saturday or Sunday. They told us that it was open bar at all the locations and the drinks were included in the price. Now, we’re hearing from other people that went that they couldn’t even get drinks because of the dry days. I’m glad we didn’t book and pay over $500 for 5 of us to go but I’m still rather angry that we were deceived by your employees.

reviews.author: Joern K
reviews.text:
Biggest disappointment in my life. Although the servants do their best to serve the guests, the Administration of the hotel is terrible. Breaking all safe distance rules, closing 1/2 of the pool and pushing guests to get even closer just to charge $1,500 dollars on top of the all inclusive charges for one bottle of moet and supposedly safe distance during the new year celebration. In the mean time folks left and right complaining about the lack of each beach  chairs. They are supposed to be at 30% occupation. By the looks of it they are well over 60%.
Additionally, there is no wheel chair access anywhere!!. Rooms are not well maintained. They clearly fired a lot of personnel and are now filling up the few restaurants they have open. No way to keep safe distance. Long lines in front of the buffets, no organization what so ever to get food and the few restaurants that serve via menu are fully booked and days in advance.
First and last time at melia resorts. They really give cancun a terrible reputation. I come to cancun 3 to 4 weeks every year. Never ever have I been so upset at any of the other great resorts I have stayed in.
IF I WERE YOU, I'D CONSIDER STAYING IN ANY of the many other resorts in the area.

reviews.author: Kap Papino
reviews.text:
We were welcomed with over 30 min of wait in the lobby to start check in procedure, no refreshments while only 2 people were working in thereception. 5 hours after arrival, my luggage was still not in my room. I called front desk, hour later, still waiting for my luggage. I ended up picking up my luggage personally , i got the general "sorry senor" .
In comparison to other paradisus hotel that I previously visited, this one didn't have toothpaste, a tips, robe, shoes....the only thing that bathroom was equiped with was soap, towels, and tissue. Bathrooms were old with excessive caulking around appliances.
Food: One of the reasons i picked this hotel because we previously had gread food experience at paradisus in playa. Cancun paradisus food was extremaly disappointing.
I will start with good; Lunch taco place was very consistent and always delicious, the only bright start of that establishment. Buffet was actually decent too. Probably the worst food experience was at " Japanese" restaurant. You get same sushi rolls that are served during linch time, and Fried rice, and some beef and noodles, more like your cheap Chinese takeout menu. "Enzo" restaurant would follow Japanese in quality. Summarizing, no white cloath on the tables, no specialty drinks, NO steakhouse, no food presentation other paradisus was know for - just poor.
Drinks, oh only 3 beers to chose from: Heineken , dos equis, and some other B grade beer. Not even corona or models. Shame. Mixed drinks tasted diffrent at every bar, it is obvious they don't have oncologist just random guys pouring drinks with hope that it will work. So, if you would try to forget about bad food, or poor experience it was impossible because drinks were mixed poorly, and beer was just bad.
Good things: for the most part staff is friendly and hard working, it just seems like there is lack of lidership and executive decisions / oversight . Beds were comfortable, TV, although not HD,  has a lot of chanels to watch. Finally, beech and ocean is beautiful but no thanks to hotel.
In general, i don't write reviews, but consider money spend, and extreme disappointment with false 5 star hotel i took couple minutes to warn people of this pseudo paradisus hotel.

reviews.author: Nadja Huskic
reviews.text: This is actually my first day here, and the first time I’ve ever written a review. The first thing I didn’t like as soon as I came into the door was them trying to convince us into a timeshare meeting. We kindly tried to say we’re tired and have had a long flight and are hungry, but he took an hour to “just explain” things. Second, we go to check in and get offered a king room or a double bed. It’s me and husband here for our anniversary so obviously we choose king. No one mentions it’s in the basement, had a parking lot VIEW, and there’s construction going on next door with loud banging. I go to the front desk and kindly ask if there’s anything they can do, she apologizes and says they can switch us to the double room. We agree because I couldn’t stand to be in a basement. We come up to our new room expecting a little better, but I’m very disappointed. From the pictures & reviews I’ve read, this is FARRR from “luxury” and 5 star. It’s old, outdated, the bathtub doesn’t have a shower head you have to hold the handle, the lagoon view is whatever, the tub takes forever to drain, and the “master bathroom” is so small, 2 of us can barely move in there (has 1 sink). I received a coupon book for booking 7 nights & asked if I can use the upgrade 2 nights coupon. She says no you have to buy a whole week. Let me remind you this was NOT a cheap vacation. I understand “you get what you pay for” but that’s not the case here, so I don’t want to spend more money just for a better view. The supervisor was next to her and kept his head down when I tried to look/address him. The whole check in desk was very rude. Didn’t mean to write this long but thought others should know before booking!!! Will update on everything else.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text:
Do not get married here! Unless you want a complete disaster OR if you want your wedding gifts stolen...

Still waiting to hear from Jose (Wedding Manager) to issue a refund for all the services we paid and did not receive. Jose didn't want to provide contact information to his boss.

reviews.author: Wladimyr Duarte
reviews.text: We had the worst experience ever. This hotel is like a two stars hotel. we were over charged at the check in; the hotel is super hot everywhere you go; they reuse and wash by hand the plastic cups when they pour your drinks (pretty disgusting); .... First and last time with this Hotel...

reviews.author: Lilli Rask
reviews.text:
WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER.

I booked a trip with some friends in December of 2020 to go in June 2020. Due to the pandemic, the hotel was not open in June, so THE HOTEL cancelled my reservation. They will not issue me a refund of the TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS I paid them. They say the best they can offer is a $2000 coupon that I never wanted in the first place??? The friends I booked this trip with received a full refund but I can't? I booked through Expedia and they have offered almost no help either. The best part is I spent $150 on travel insurance when I booked my trip but apparently that means nothing now and I am out 2 grand.

reviews.author: Louis P.
reviews.text: There is no quiet spot in the entire hotel complex. Loud music is played on Kanna Beach, the bass disturbs the entire beach.  There's always a party at the main pool.  Events are constantly taking place at the second pool. You can be lucky at the children's pool and maybe get a 30-minute break when the construction work with jackhammers is on hold. Even in a hotel room you don't get to close your eyes until 1 a.m. at the earliest. The room doors are so thin, you can hear the crying children from floor 0 even on the 5th floor (behind the closed door). Every evening there are loud parties in the hotel lobby and the noise gets into the hotel rooms.

reviews.author: Francisco Ortiz
reviews.text: I arrived to this hotel last night. We reserved the lagoon view deluxe junior suite. We did not get what we asked for, because it was “fully booked” they gave us ocean “view”… all I see is the building next to us. Nothing has been done about it. How is this an upgrade???? Super disappointed. Do not waste your time in coming here.

reviews.author: Andrea Moore
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice and and the workers were all friendly and great. But the FOOD WAS THE WORST I HAVE EVER HAD.  The need more food choices that stay open. Even by the pool side you have to pay. They should be coverage all day for your guest that should be free. The hotel was very hot . Would not stay again. was not worth the money. Bring a fan!!!

reviews.author: M H
reviews.text: If you have family and kids stay away from this place. I gave this place 5 stars 8 months ago. They changed their policies and reservations category where if you have kids they will not let you in the higher category where you can't get to many restaurants or cabanas . No Matter how much you pay you can get to one or 2 restaurants and go to the pool or beach but NO cabana . If you have kids they treat you less of human beings. Please don't come here if you have family

reviews.author: Natalie Manzanares
reviews.text:
A terrible experience with this hotel. I've been trying for several days to receive a refund they promised, and to this day I still haven't received my money or a clear confirmation. They told me they would send the refund via bank transfer, but every time I ask for information, I only get excuses and delays.

The most disappointing thing is that they asked me to delete my negative review in order to "help" me with the refund process. I agreed and deleted the review in good faith, expecting professionalism and cooperation, but after doing so, they stopped being clear, and I still have no solution.

The lack of communication, transparency, and follow-up has made this whole situation very frustrating. I just wanted my money back and to receive honest service.

reviews.author: Miguel Rodriguez Velazquez
reviews.text: Terrible. On May 12, 2026, my 74-year-old mother fell in the hotel, fracturing her hip, and they refuse to honor the liability insurance, cover medical expenses, or even extend her accommodation so we can take care of her.

reviews.author: Laura Zalazar
reviews.text: I just got back from the Ava, a complete disaster! From the damp-smelling rooms and wet sheets to the flooding bathrooms, it was awful! Even the penthouse wasn't spared from this mess! Despite our membership, the butler kept saying there was no room, and the Ava was deserted. We went straight to the restaurant and asked for a table—it was a disaster! They have no variety of drinks, and they denied us access to the Riviera Maya even though we could request it! And they recommended this as a Hard Rock affiliate?! Please, there's no comparison with Hard Rock! The only good thing is that it's close to the airport for getting back. Don't waste your money; they're far from being a 5-star hotel!

reviews.author: Fernanda Castilhos Bosi
reviews.text:
We had a terrible experience. We booked a suite with a king-size bed, but when we arrived, we received separate beds. It was incredibly stressful to change suites.

There was no replenishment of mineral water in the room; when we asked, it took another 5 hours for us to receive water. My parents needed to take their medication, and there was no water in the room (in an all-inclusive hotel). We bought wine outside the hotel and called room service to request a corkscrew; we've been waiting for 2 hours, and the corkscrew hasn't arrived. The pool was very crowded; we had to wake up at 5:30 am to reserve a sun lounger, otherwise we had nowhere to lie down.

reviews.author: Jerusalem Spider
reviews.text: Expect to be treated terribly if you're not a foreigner. The bartenders at the main pool are very rude and unfriendly, as are almost all the people in the restaurants. We went on a business trip with about 100 people from the company I work for, and everyone was complaining about the poor treatment and service. Some colleagues had their doors opened by the cleaning staff and were seen without clothes. One colleague's room flooded, two others had power outages, and two more had no hot water. At reception, when we were given our rooms, the Americans were given a full explanation of the hotel map and services, but we were only given a brochure and told that all the information was there. We were denied tables, but if foreigners asked, they were seated immediately. The food was awful! Bland, tasteless, and always with very little variety. Only three waiters were extremely kind and attentive; all the other staff we interacted with were rude and dismissive. A terrible service experience. Don't even bother replying if you're just going to give a generic response with no intention of making any changes. As the head of a UX department, I'd rather you not respond at all than give the same answer you give everyone, which only demonstrates your lack of empathy and intention to make a difference. After years of negative reviews and with many of us still complaining about the same things, it's clear you haven't done anything to demand friendlier and more helpful customer service.

reviews.author: Eder Souza
reviews.text:
It seems awful that they're just trying to cut costs.

Right after making my reservation from September 25th to September 30th, 2024, I already had some setbacks. I tried to get help to arrange a transfer, and after a few questions, I was informed that I would have to deal directly with the transportation company.

I'm a GOLD member of the Meliá chain, so I thought I would receive a little better service. I requested late check-out, which was not granted.

I received some vouchers that I simply couldn't use. They create several rules that make their use impossible. I tried to buy an energy drink, but it wasn't possible because its value was less than the voucher credit. I asked to take several and get the difference, but that wasn't possible because it was one voucher per product. It's ridiculous; it's almost an obligation to use it for something that generates an extra cost so they can generate more revenue.

There are no restaurants where you can eat all you want at dinner, and if you don't make a dinner reservation, you simply can't get in. Even though the hotel was empty because it was low season, I tried to enter a restaurant and was refused due to lack of a reservation. If you forget or go out and don't have time to make a reservation, be prepared to go without dinner, inexplicable for a hotel that claims to be all-inclusive.
A waiter, who I believe was Brazilian because he spoke my language very well, made a point of being very unpleasant. At lunch, I got some nuts and asked for yogurt, since there were several at breakfast, and it was simply refused. You can't take anything from the restaurant to your room. The next day I tried to take some yogurt (a cup) and was refused. This same waiter refused to let us into the restaurant at dinner due to lack of a reservation. I believe that because we have the same nationality (Brazilian) and he was working while I was on vacation, he made an effort to be very unpleasant.
In the room, the phone doesn't work, and the shower doesn't maintain a constant temperature; it simply fluctuates strongly in the same position. I have experience with other hotels; there was even another option in Cancun (Catalonia) where I've stayed before that would have been cheaper, and yet I chose to stay at the Paradisus believing it would be a higher level of accommodation. It was simply disappointing. I won't be back, and I certainly don't recommend it.

reviews.author: lizett hernandez
reviews.text: The worst experience I've had with any of the hotels in this chain. Out of the five days we paid for all-inclusive, the minibar was only restocked twice, with the explanation that the staff weren't aware we'd paid for all-inclusive for those rooms. We reserved a Balinese cocktail, and the next day they wanted to change it simply because another family had requested it. At the Agua Marina restaurant, they told us they were out of the dessert we'd chosen, even though it was still early. They wouldn't let me use the kids' club with my baby due to "security concerns," which seemed illogical when it was clear the staff couldn't control and supervise all the children. At the Meliá Cozumel, I was able to use the space without any problem. On the beach, two foreign women blocked us off with two lounge chairs so we wouldn't invade "their space," which made us very uncomfortable and I found it incredibly disrespectful. Overall, the service left much to be desired, and although our concierge (we were with a Meliá Club card) was attentive to these details, little was done to resolve them. The only thing they offered was a late check-out and to sort out the issue with the luggage. The only positives were that some of the staff were very friendly and the facilities were in good condition, but I wouldn't return.

reviews.author: melina almada
reviews.text: The service was terrible. The hotel didn't have any food; you couldn't eat what you wanted. One night, all they had was rice and noodles. It advertises all-inclusive, but it's not. In the afternoon, there were no meals available. Only the bar was open... and the food? It's a shame to pay so much for such bad food! Very poor service, and the hotel is only frequented by adults.

reviews.author: Esteban Cabral
reviews.text: The hotel was terrible. It's not the value for money they advertise. The rooms are a disaster, half the amenities don't work, and all they do is apologize and send people to fix things. There aren't enough sun loungers by the pools, let alone on the beach. I'm giving it one star because I can't give it zero. The only positive thing is the friendliness of the staff.

reviews.author: Percio Mello Jr
reviews.text: Empty mini-fridge; we asked three times for drinks to be refilled and they didn't. Blueagave restaurant: terrible food. Água Marina restaurant: food took an hour to arrive and was cold. TV without remote control. Phone doesn't work. Room furniture is very old, outdated flooring. Jacuzzi doesn't work.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Siqueira
reviews.text: This place is very beautiful, but it's not an honest company, especially the management. I bought a "Circle By Melia" program, paying in 10 installments, and after paying all the installments, they continued to charge me. I haven't been able to get my money back. So be careful, you could be the next one to be scammed.

reviews.author: Rosa Matheus
reviews.text:
This is not a 5-star hotel. I recommend you consider other hotel options at the same price before booking here.

I'm sharing several experiences we had in just one day at this hotel. We arrived yesterday, February 19th, and immediately had some bad experiences.

1- We booked a shuttle service from the hotel, but they made us wait at least 40 minutes to leave from the airport.
2- The rooms are quite far apart, so if you want to request something for your room, like a dental kit or a hairdryer (which wasn't in our room), you have to wait about 30 minutes for it to be delivered.

3- You have to make reservations in advance during the day to book the restaurants where you want to have dinner. 4- There's an ENDLESS line at the buffet for breakfast between 8:30 am and 10:30 am.
5- The buffet area is tiny, the number of people there makes it impossible to have a pleasant breakfast, and the lines inside the buffet for eggs or omelets are EXTREMELY LONG.
6- We ordered coffee for breakfast, and it arrived just as we were leaving.

7- The bars have limited alcohol; you can't get 12-year-old whiskey, and it costs extra. Drinks like coconut water also cost extra (10 USD).

8- During the day, it's impossible to get a lounge chair; they are extremely limited and completely occupied by 8 am. By 9 am, none are available.

9- Finally, at check-in, they don't take into account the preferences specified during the reservation. They tried to change the double bed selected by a couple of friends to single beds. 9- There are no lounge chairs available on the beach either, and the sunbeds for relaxing cost $250 USD to rent per day.

Finally, a group of eight of us came to this hotel, paid around $500 USD per night, and it's not worth it. DO NOT COME TO THIS HOTEL. Choose options like Xcaret or the Hyatt for a similar price and a much better experience, without a doubt.

I hope this helps :)

reviews.author: Виктория Филоненко
reviews.text:
I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL.

Don't be fooled by your expectations—you'll have the same terrible experience we did. If you want to enjoy your vacation, choose another place. This hotel completely ruined our vacation and, worst of all, our birthday!

We booked a suite with a sea view a month and a half before our trip and specifically requested a room on a high floor. This was confirmed. However, upon arrival at 12:30 PM, we were told there were no available rooms. We were offered either an additional $360 for a superior room or the only one available on the ground floor, with the promise of being upgraded later. When we agreed to pay the extra, the price suddenly jumped to $385. We ended up paying, but they didn't check us in until 5:00 PM.

When we checked into the so-called "upgraded suite," we were shocked. The sink didn't drain, the shower didn't work either, and the towel hooks were missing—there were gaping holes in the wall instead. The air conditioning didn't work, the walls were cracked, and the balcony was a whole other story.

While standing on the balcony admiring the sea, plaster kept falling from the ceiling onto us. The windows were dirty and covered in paint chips. We spent our entire nine-day vacation trying to make the room habitable, but it proved nearly impossible—the staff simply refused to work. Installing towel hooks took three days and was a real pain, as were solving other problems. They simply brought us a fan to "fix" the air conditioning.

If you're afraid of cockroaches, this hotel is definitely not for you. One time, during dinner in the restaurant, a huge cockroach sat next to us.

The soup in the restaurant was a different story. While serving it, the waiter's finger ended up in the soup bowl. He calmly pulled it out and wiped it on his clothes right in front of us, then wished us a pleasant meal, as if nothing had happened.

Everything at this hotel is incredibly slow. We had to wait a long time and call repeatedly to get toiletries delivered to our room. We even had to beg for drinking water, which also took a long time to arrive.

It's impossible to relax in the room. The staff barges into the room without knocking, and the "Do Not Disturb" sign was delivered only three days later, after we'd asked for it more than ten times.

This hotel ruined my birthday, even though we paid $5,000 for it.

Organizing a birthday party is a whole other saga. A week before the event, we had to persuade the receptionist to discuss all the details. We asked for the room to be decorated by 9:00 AM while we were eating breakfast, so it would be a surprise. However, when we returned at 11:00 AM, there was no decoration at all. When we contacted the receptionist, we were told that the decorations had been postponed "due to force majeure." At 12:30, they finally decorated our room while we were sitting in the next room. What a wonderful surprise, right?

The chocolate-covered strawberries looked like they were made by schoolchildren. It looked like expectation and reality, like in the worst memes.

We ordered lobsters in advance, asking for large ones. They confirmed they would be two 2.5 kg lobsters. We paid for that weight. Two hours before the celebration, they showed us three 1.5 kg lobsters. WHY DO WE NEED THREE SMALL LOBSTERS FOR TWO???
We wanted a beautiful presentation and photos. Two 2.5 kg lobsters were agreed upon.
Getting a refund turned out to be very difficult, and we still haven't received it.

The photographer, who paid $385, took terrible photos and missed the most important moment with the cake and fireworks. We paid for 25 photos and only received 19. As always, no one refunded our money. It's better to take photos with your phone than to hire such a "professional." Furthermore, construction work was visible in the background of the photos, which were taking place right during our celebration.

For three days, we felt like we were living on a construction site! There was construction work going on right above our room—loud banging and constant noise emanated from early morning until late evening. This completely ruined our vacation, as it was impossible to rest or relax due to the incessant noise.
The staff ignored our constant complaints and requests to stop or tone down the noise.

reviews.author: Dither Lobato
reviews.text:
The room was a disaster on the last day. Pieces of the ceiling were falling off and there were a lot of leaks. What they did was put towels on the floor… instead of proactively reaching out to us and providing a real solution. When I reported it at checkout, the service was very poor. They didn't like me mentioning these comments about the room and directed me to customer service, who was also very rude and didn't care… I told them I was going to complain, and they told me to do so… It's very unfortunate that they treat customers like this, who are their reason for being.

At the buffet restaurant, we happened to see cockroaches… very unpleasant.

One of the people who served ice cream by the pool provided very poor service, giving them out very reluctantly…

Clearly not a 5-star hotel.

reviews.author: Jhonn Salcedo
reviews.text: Very bad experience. Mrs. Angie Natguas was very rude. They gave us the wrong room. When we went to complain, she spoke rudely to my children. My children were traumatized after this. I do not recommend this place, at least not with employees like that.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Quevedo
reviews.text: Terrible service. The restaurants require reservations, and some days there's no availability at all. The food is deplorable; it's supposed to be a premium hotel, but everything is bland. Room service takes ages to answer, and when they do, it takes over an hour and a half to bring the food. The jacuzzi, sauna, and other amenities aren't included. I was extremely disappointed with the hotel; I'll never return.

reviews.author: Edgar Martinez
reviews.text:
This hotel is in dire need of renovation! ‼️ The food, while of decent quality, is generally poor.
They require reservations for all restaurants and don't accept walk-ins, even though people who make reservations never show up!
So the restaurant with reservations is usually half empty; the system doesn't work. Then they send most people to the only buffet restaurant, which is always packed, with a huge line and small, mishandled portions. Of all the options in Cancun and the Riviera Maya, choose any other hotel!

reviews.author: ABADÍA DE YUSTE de Rubén Hornero
reviews.text:
As a Circle Blue member, this hotel is a disappointment because they're not yet ready for it. We booked Circle Blue at the Paradisius in Punta Cana, which included all the amenities they offered, and arriving here full of excitement has been a disaster because they have nothing to benefit club members. They're simply not prepared. In Punta Cana, where we booked, there was an exclusive members' area on the beach and pool at lunch and dinner, and there was a wine list with about 20 different wines and cavas.

We went down to dinner and were told we only had one cava and two red wines, neither of which were very good.

In the beach area, it doesn't matter if you're a Circle member or not, and in the pool area, you don't have any privileges either. This has cost us 36,000 options, which is a lot of money. We've been talking to the Circle members' area, and well, they haven't really offered any solution. We even told them we'd file a complaint, and they didn't seem to care. But we'll do everything we can to make sure this doesn't end here. They've played with our money and our hard work.

reviews.author: Giovanni Ballarin
reviews.text:
The hotel has several problems that spoil the experience. When we look for a high-end all-inclusive hotel, we expect a certain quality of service, food, and amenities.
The all-inclusive concept is almost an insult to anyone who really knows how such a system works. Reservations at some restaurants are impossible to make when you are in groups of more than 8 people (we were a group of 12).
During the first 5 days of our stay, the main restaurants were under renovation (we were not informed of anything) and we noticed that there was some improvisation to maintain breakfast, lunch, and dinner service with food lacking variety and of low quality. Every day the food was the same, and bad.
The drinks, in addition to taking a long time to be served, all the sodas were flat...it seems to be on purpose so that you always order water.
There is no menu in the bars...it is very difficult to know what is served, as the volume of customers that the staff attends to is always very large.
The rooms, besides smelling of mold coming from the air conditioning, the beds are awful and water got in on rainy days. (all 4 rooms we stayed in had the same problem)
The quality of the food (after the renovation) has improved a little but it's no different from simple and cheap restaurants in Brazil...we're tempted to go to McDonald's across from the hotel.
The overall 1-star rating is to warn our fellow Brazilians to consider other alternatives for their vacations, as the experiences here can be quite bad and the feeling of having wasted money is terrible.
We still have 2 more days here, but the desire to leave appeared in the first few days.

reviews.author: Livia LIMA DE OLIVEIRA
reviews.text:
It was the worst stay we've ever had.
It started with a delay at reception. We paid for a Nikte package, and nothing was good.
The facilities are old and need remodeling.
The room didn't have a hairdryer, the doors are heavy and difficult to move, the towels were old, the minibar didn't refrigerate properly and had few drinks. I had to ask for water; there was a difference between the guests—some had bottled water, others served water in a disgusting plastic cup.
Room service was very slow.
Most of the waiters were unfriendly. The drinks were also terrible. My daughter had a very bad experience and suspected food poisoning. The food was bland and tasteless. There's only one good restaurant called Sal.
The lounge chairs by the pool cost $250. I won't be returning, and I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: milu !
reviews.text: The response I received was completely disrespectful, LIARS!!!! The room change they gave me was because I PAID FOR IT!!! Because I requested a room change to one with an ocean view from day one. That was before I found cockroaches twice in the other room, since we had 3 rooms and were a group of 11 people including myself. The room where the cockroaches were found was my parents' room, and they NEVER made any changes. Disrespectful!! And second, yes, they did return 2 items of clothing (the cheapest ones) out of the 4 that were left behind, but only because I HAD TO GO IN PERSON to ask what was happening because they NEVER gave me an answer over the phone since they NEVER took my case. And their response was even more inept when they said they couldn't suspect any employee because they had been with them for many years, meaning that if SOMETHING IS STOLEN from a guest, it's the guest's fault for forgetting it. The real problem isn't the cost of things, it's the lack of respect and the way they "provide solutions" by trying to make it seem like the guest is lying or telling the story wrong.

reviews.author: Fransisco Alejandro Garza Lopez
reviews.text: Let's get down to brass tacks. The cleanliness of the common area bathrooms is disgusting. I'm surprised no one's mentioning it. It's unbearably hot throughout the hotel (except the rooms, that would be the last straw). Room cleaning is equally awful; they don't even clear the dishes from room service. The waiters are incredibly classist, most of them. (Poor things, I feel sorry for them seeing how close they are to kneeling and kissing the feet of foreigners.) The facilities are old, the furniture is outdated, and the service in the restaurants is incredibly slow. It took 30 minutes for three measly tacos at Blue Agave. It's nothing like Paradisus Playa del Carmen in terms of cleanliness, service, facilities, and speed. Paradisus Playa del Carmen is a thousand times better. The only redeeming feature of this hotel is its proximity to the beach and its location. Beyond that, it's awful. We're not coming back. But who cares? There are plenty of customers.

reviews.author: Olgaa Santos
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun Experience
Room 2015
December 31, 2015 to January 4, 2024

Pros:
1. Bellhops. Upon arrival, they give you a welcome that makes you feel like your stay will be great; their service attitude makes you feel enthusiastic.

2. Alberto, the waiter at the buffet restaurant.

3. Beautiful views.

4. Heated pool.

Cons:
1. Rude staff:
- Bartender: When it was my turn to order, I said "good afternoon," and he replied, "And what do you want?" in a very rude tone.

- Waiter: I asked for more Coke, and he replied, "There's still one here."

-The waiter at table 23 in Salón del Prado sold us a bottle of Moët for 500 pesos. Later, he came back and asked if we could return it. We did, and he gave us our money back. An hour later, he tried to sell it to us again. Then he asked again if we could return it, and we did. He tried to sell it to us again! That was the last straw. We refused, and he got very angry.

2. Sick Staff:
-The young woman from the kids' club was coughing and sneezing a lot. It sounded like she had a lot of phlegm, and she was still in contact with the children without a mask, not caring that she could make them sick.

3. Poor Food Quality:
-I ordered ceviche to my room. I was vomiting and had diarrhea, nausea, and body aches. I'm currently at home and still have an upset stomach.

-The next day, my husband ordered a chicken Caesar salad, and he currently has diarrhea. The symptoms appeared almost immediately in both cases.
We believe it's food poisoning.

4. Room service: The food was tasteless, cold, and took 2 to 3 hours to arrive. Once, I canceled it at midnight because it had taken too long, and they knocked on my door at 4:00 AM to deliver the food even though I had already canceled. They said, "Sorry for the delay."

It's not completely free; you're only allowed to order room service three times a day, which is fine, but if you order water once, it counts as one room service order. If you order water a second time and they consider it too much, they count it as two orders (and that's the daily limit). After that, they charge for each subsequent delivery.

4. Minibar: It's not restocked daily.

5. Rooms: Old rooms and the air conditioning didn't work; it read 18°C ​​but you were sweating all the time.

6. Maintenance: Twice I couldn't get into my room. The first time they said my wristband had been too close to my cell phone and that's why it had deactivated (haha). The second time they finally changed the batteries in the lock because it simply wouldn't work anymore.

7. Restaurants: There were cockroaches at the buffet; we counted 15 in one small piece. The food was tasteless.
At the taco restaurant, the tortillas were cold and hard, and the meat was awful. I couldn't visit the other restaurants because they were already full. For example, you'd go at 7 PM and there was no room (even though they closed at 11 PM).

8. Towels: We asked for replacement towels at 3 PM and they didn't bring them until 11 PM! At the pools, you were lucky if you got towels. There were few lounge chairs, and most of them cost extra. $10 and $25 for members, and 4100 Mexican pesos for us mere mortals.

reviews.author: Mariana Gianelli
reviews.text: This is the third time I've visited the hotel. The last two times were excellent, which is why I decided to return. This time was truly disappointing. I suppose it has to do with the fact that it's closing for renovations in June of this year and reopening in 2026, so they don't seem to care if we're not happy. The hotel was packed. If you want to get a lounge chair, you have to get up at least at 6 am because after that, you have no choice but to lie down wherever there's space. When we arrived, the room was a disaster. There weren't enough lights, the air conditioning turned on and off randomly, and the step to the bathroom was broken. I asked for a room change, but they wouldn't give me one. They told me they were fully booked. Mind you, I had paid for it in August 2024, not at the last minute. The hotel staff is all very friendly; in fact, they're the ones keeping this hotel afloat. The food is impeccable, although if you go for dinner at 9 pm, you have to hope there's anything left because by 7 pm they've already eaten everything. I think they weren't prepared for so many people. I was completely disappointed with the hotel this time; next time I'll choose one where they don't have to apologize every 5 minutes.

reviews.author: Juju HMehr
reviews.text:
I can't recommend this hotel to anyone. The first thing we did after arriving was wait in line for about an hour for check-in (with toddlers). Then, please see the video and pictures below; it will show you everything you need to know. We asked for a different room, but they kept telling us to come back the next day because they were fully booked.

We've traveled all around the world, but we've never had an experience like this before.

I can't recommend it. First impressions count! Upon arriving at the hotel, we had to stand around for an hour just to check in (with two toddlers). There was a construction site right outside our room. We asked for a different room, and the reception team kept putting us off for three days, telling us to come back the next day.

Not a pleasant experience. Perhaps the manager plans to spend his next vacation in front of this construction site?

reviews.author: Aka 70
reviews.text: Terrible service from the check-out staff. My family and I had a flight scheduled to leave before noon, but due to the hotel staff's negligence, we couldn't leave on time because they hadn't received a final payment. Their only solution was to detain us against our will, and even when we tried to explain our situation, they refused to explore other options.

reviews.author: A NP
reviews.text:
As a Circle Blue member, this hotel is a disappointment because they're not yet ready for it. We booked Circle Blue at the Paradisius in Punta Cana, which included all the amenities they offered, and arriving here full of excitement has been a disaster because they have nothing to benefit club members. They're simply not prepared. In Punta Cana, where we booked, there was an exclusive members' area on the beach and pool at lunch and dinner, and there was a wine list with about 20 different wines and cavas.

We went down to dinner and were told we only had one cava and two red wines, neither of which were very good.

In the beach area, it doesn't matter if you're a Circle member or not, and in the pool area, you don't have any privileges either. This has cost us 36,000 options, which is a lot of money. We've been talking to the Circle members' area, and well, they haven't really offered any solution. We even told them we'd file a complaint, and they didn't seem to care. But we'll do everything we can to make sure this doesn't end here. They've played with our money and our hard work.

reviews.author: RAFAEL DE FIGUEIREDO BARBOSA
reviews.text:
Bad experience. My wife and I stayed from November 18th to 21st, 2018. Upon arrival, check-in took over an hour, and they still wanted the physical credit card I HAD USED TO MAKE THE PURCHASE in JUNE/JULY 2018, even though I had replaced the damaged card (but the account was the same). They said the reservation confirmation required this procedure, but this wasn't written ON THE RESERVATION CONFIRMATION, and they couldn't show it to me. Many people who received the package as a gift and purchased it with another card had the same problem. I had to send an email with the invoice statement (a procedure I found abusive and an invasion of privacy). After that, the receptionist put us in an old room with construction work nearby.

The good things: cleanliness of the hotel areas, the hotel's beautiful architecture, the Japanese restaurant and bar, the Blue Argave restaurant, the themed shows at the pool, and the beach location.

The bad things: food poisoning (3 days of diarrhea, stuck in the room) with no assistance from guest services (they're useless, not even able to point out the pharmacy across from the hotel), the hotel reception staff are generally grumpy, and most of the waiters are impatient and impolite.

reviews.author: Francisco Morín
reviews.text: A terrible experience. As I was walking from the pool to the elevator with my wife, children, and I, a man—who appeared to be a hotel executive with a Spanish accent—stopped me and told me I couldn't be shirtless in that area. Incredibly, there were other shirtless people around me, and only I was stopped. My children were completely confused. Then, at breakfast, one of my four-year-old sons was carrying cereal when he was stopped by someone else. I definitely don't recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Mariela Coronel
reviews.text: The poor response and mistreatment came from the hotel staff, not the app or agency. Let me make that clear. If you'd like, I can upload screenshots of the responses so everyone can see the mistreatment from the hotel staff. They still haven't apologized or admitted that they are the ones mistreating the customer. I'm making a reservation through an app, and the service is terrible. If this is how they start treating you, considering what you have to pay, I seriously doubt it's a viable option. Pay close attention to the service you provide. Reservation canceled. I'm going to look for another hotel where they treat customers better. Even their "apologies" are incredibly arrogant. Can you imagine having a terrible vacation with your family? I'm not going to risk it.

reviews.author: Яна Є
reviews.text: Our family stayed at this hotel for Christmas 2021, and unfortunately, our stay turned out to be poor considering the hotel's standard and the high price. We were extremely disappointed. Reservations for restaurants are incredibly difficult; getting through by phone is practically impossible. Secondly, we ordered a cake for our son's birthday, paid for it, and they delivered a different cake. The restaurant promised they wouldn't charge us, but in the end, upon checkout, they charged us the full amount. I explained about the cake at reception, but they couldn't help us and took the full amount. The rooms are very modest for the price. We asked for an ocean view when we purchased our package, but upon check-in, we were told we had to pay extra. And for Christmas itself, the kids' gifts were, guess what, a notebook. And the adults didn't even have enough beach hats to color in; they said they were out. Just think twice before going to such an expensive hotel.

reviews.author: Federico Calabrese
reviews.text:
English:
- Check-in was a half-hour wait
- There weren't enough lounge chairs for the number of guests (the beach is VERY small and full of sargassum seaweed)
- We asked them to change the channel at the sports bar and it took more than an hour because they couldn't find "the person in charge of changing channels"
- We booked and paid for a room with a lagoon view and they gave us a room next to a pool on the ground floor
- We asked them to open a broken umbrella by the pool and complained to several people, but (more than 6 hours passed and they never came)
- They charge extra for the lounge chairs when they don't even have enough, so the "All Inclusive" is a LIE
- You can't reserve dinner in advance; you have to sign up at the door and you can end up waiting more than an hour
- I called room service to ask for something as simple as drinking water; they told me they would come in 10 or 20 minutes and they never did They came. The service is terrible; every time you ask someone a question, they send you to talk to someone else.

English:

- check in line for half an hour to do it
- there are not enough lounge chairs for the number of guests (the beach is VERY small and full of sargassum)
- We asked that they change a channel in the sports bar and it took more than 1 hour because they could not find "the person in charge of changing the channel"
- we reserved and paid for a room with a view of the Lagoon and they gave us a view of the side of a pool on floor 0 (ground floor)
- We asked that they open an umbrella that was broken on the edge of the pool and we complained to several people but (more than 6 hours passed and they never came)
- they charge you extra for the lounge chairs when they don't even have enough lounge chairs, for which the "All inclusive" is a LIE
- for dinner you cannot book in advance, you have to sign up at the door and you can end up waiting for more than 1 hour
- I called room service to ask for something as simple as drinking water, they told me they would come in 10 or 20 minutes and they never came. The attention is very bad, every time you ask someone something they send you to talk to another person.

reviews.author: Jose Luis Cristóbal
reviews.text:
It's a very nice hotel, in my opinion too big and very crowded, we already knew that, but we were traveling with our 14-year-old son and wanted him to have a good time.
The problem with the room was immediate upon arrival; they gave us two small beds for the three of us. It was supposed to be a Junior Suite, they told us that's how they were there, but the bathroom couldn't fit two people... it was just a regular double room!
They changed it and we had to pay an extra €1000!!!
Then we booked the "18+ Area," which was a complete waste of money! Our son couldn't even go near the pool; they were constantly telling him off (I understand, it was an adults-only area), but they could have told us and we wouldn't have paid... The problem that ruined our vacation was when we booked excursions through the hotel, specifically with the agency OTIUN INTER Mexico Dolphin Team, which has several offices in the hotel. We booked a tour to Isla Mujeres with dolphins and snorkeling. We went on the Victoria catamaran on August 2nd at 9:30 am (they picked us up from the hotel at 8 am). The driver had to stop at several other hotels to pick up other people… After snorkeling, as we were getting back on the catamaran, my son dropped my iPhone into the water. It was brand new, only a week old, an iPhone 14 Pro that I had received as a gift.

I asked them to please help me snorkel and get it. My son was snorkeling, trying to retrieve it. I wanted to jump into the water to get the phone, but they wouldn't let me. They just stood there, completely still! What's more, they told the other people in the water to get back on board and that it was our problem if we had dropped it!

I couldn't believe it. It was a dark-skinned, very rude guy who wouldn't let us go get the phone. I got angry with him, and he told me to talk to the captain, but there was no captain, no one was doing anything, and I seriously doubt there was even a captain! They were just standing around with a microphone, acting silly to get tips. They brazenly said they were passing around a collection box so everyone could put in whatever amount they wanted! Put in jewelry, watches, rings, whatever you want! Absolutely shameful.
The guy completely ignored me, yelled at me, and told me he wouldn't let me on his damn boat again, and that he couldn't wait to dive because he was already four minutes late. None of the crew bothered to jump in the water and try to find the iPhone. If it had belonged to one of them… things would have been different! They told me I should have given him a tip under the table, secretly, and then YES, they would have gone looking for him. There were even people who wanted to help us with their snorkeling gear to find him; they didn't leave anyone alone!

“I'M SORRY, MA'AM, you're responsible.”
I would have been furious, so frustrated… a bunch of jerks who don't know how to treat people, they only know how to get them drunk on tequila, they were shoving the bottle straight into everyone's mouth.
The dark-haired guy was wearing blue mirrored sunglasses. I have his picture, the picture of the Victoria catamaran, the registration number, and the names they gave me of everyone (under the tip).
I'm going to file a complaint against the hotel and against them. Of course, the agency is to blame for hiring people like that. I hope the hotel removes that agency from its premises, as I've heard about several bad experiences and many irregularities… I doubt the agency had insurance, I doubt there was any safety on that catamaran. I only saw one life preserver, and there were over 60 of us. They were all silent among themselves, and I'm sure that if someone had fallen overboard, they wouldn't have stopped to rescue them. There were no life preservers to throw out; they wouldn't have jumped into the sea to rescue anyone, and they're always late! The whole "man overboard" thing doesn't apply to them!

Well, if you tip them, you're all set.) Very, very regrettable. A hotel like this ruins its reputation because of people like this.

Thanks to a wonderful receptionist who helped us use her own iPhone to find out where the agency was and block it. Even so, a supervisor approached her and reprimanded her! The girl was very, very kind.
The best thing to do is book a private excursion outside the hotel. It's more expensive, but it's always worth it.

reviews.author: Angela Barone
reviews.text: Hello, I'm writing because last year I wrote a very good review of the hotel. We liked it so much that after 6 months we returned, this time with the whole family. When we arrived, they gave us rooms in tower 1, which were quite old. I explained to the receptionist that it was my second time at the hotel, and that the first time they offered me a room in tower 5. He said it was a courtesy, and this time I had the same package. I showed him last year's reservation. My mother-in-law, seeing how old the room was, paid extra to have it moved to tower 3 and paid for two wristbands. And that's when the ordeal began. The air conditioning didn't work in my in-laws' room in tower 1. Their room wasn't cleaned for two out of eleven days. The jacuzzi was leaking. In my room, the sink was clogged, so we called to have it fixed. Every day I had to call room service because they cleaned the room but didn't leave water in the refrigerator, and being pregnant, I had to take my medication. The service was over an hour and 45 minutes late; I often had to call two or three times. After my mother-in-law paid extra for two wristbands that included drinks, they gave her some green olives. Every day it was an ordeal to get a sunbed at the pool because the beds cost $250. There were more than 10 empty beds and not enough sunbeds and umbrellas for everyone. People were starting at 6 a.m. grabbing sunbeds. What kind of 5-star hotel does that happen? There are many classifications among the blue, green, and brown wristbands. Not counting our experience with Yuli, a girl who insisted on giving us a talk at all costs. When I told her I had already given it last year, she took it upon herself to call all the rooms. I very politely explained that I had already given the talk, that my family already belonged to the club, that I had enjoyed many Melia facilities around the world since I was a child, and that I wanted my sister-in-law and mother-in-law to attend. I explained that we had local friends, that we wouldn't be spending much time at the hotel facilities (there weren't even sun loungers at the pool), and that we had to get up early. Our friends were going to take us out, and she asked us where our friend worked for an agency, if they were going to take us to another hotel—a lot of personal questions. She suggested that, to avoid enjoying the hotel facilities, I stay in a B&B, to which I replied that I would spend my own money and stay wherever I wanted. She called again, and this time my husband answered. He asked her not to bother him anymore, but she said she wanted to speak to the lady, not him—a total lack of respect. The hotel facilities have declined in quality; there were water leaks everywhere, the water in the indoor pools where the bar is located was green and had a very bad smell, so my husband suggested they please add chlorine. The next day it was a different story. My sister-in-law's birthday was on the 13th, and they called to tell her they would send a gift to her room, which never arrived. My sister-in-law also told them she intended to celebrate at the Rosa Negra, and they said they could get her a good table and make the reservation, which they didn't. We had to call that same day to make the reservation ourselves. Last time, they gave us rooms in Tower 5 with all the premium drinks, even though we had the same package this time. I hope my review helps improve the hotel's quality, as it's a shame it has declined so much in six months.
