To name a few that i can recall Abraham, Victor, Gisell, Alejandra,  Valentina and wish I could remember other names, but I can't.  Everyone was great! I also loved the nightly entertainment.

The hotel looked very luxurious from the moment our van turned to their grounds when dropping us from the airport. Security has a very tight management of who goes in and out. Even keeping count of how many go in and out. That made us feel so safe.

The ambience of the hotel made me feel serene and at peace since there were so many green areas and water running like fountains. So many different spots to take pictures in.

The restaurant experience was great as well. Malva, Aqua Marine, Sante were delicious. The only one I didn't care for was Flora. They didn't have many options in the menu, unless you wanted to pay extra. We only went for 6 days so didn't have time to try the rest.

Now for the part that wasn't the greatest was our first room. We asked for a change of room and they did. The second room was so much better, but it had a leak in the wall in the bathroom.  It didn't affect us much so we didn't complain any longer being that it was a lot better than the 1st room.  I do know they will be closing the hotel for renovations this may. So hopefully it'll be much better afterwards.

To all the Staff Thank you so much! You made our trip memorable !

reviews.author: Joti B
reviews.text:
Visited as a family with two children March 9-14th and had a great time! The hotel is only 15 minutes away from the airport making it a seamless commute.

PROS:

We booked through Expedia and were able to check-in a private lounge which made it comfortable and convenient. The resort overall is great for families with children and couples. There were many restaurants to choose from. I would recommend making the reservations the day you arrive to ensure you get your picks. The restaurants we really enjoyed included Lemon Fish  which was Sushi and Japanese inspired food and Capella which was Italian cuisine. This was the consensus we received from the reviews and guests visiting. The buffet was also pleasant. We preferred eating breakfast at the buffet and lunch at Masi’s Pizza which is poolside. Room service was also good. The amenities were top notch and providing many areas to lounge and enjoy time with your loved ones with a great view. Coffee is a must when I travel and the Nespresso bar did not disappoint! The beach was extremely clean and water was crystal blue. I also liked that there were not vendors trying to sell you services every other minute. The gym and tennis court are also great!

CONS:

As mentioned in previous reviews the rooms are outdated. They will be closed for 1 year in a few months and I’m assuming they will be updating the rooms. In addition, you have to wake up at 6 am to hold beach chairs and pool chairs for yourself and loved ones, as after 7 am they are not available. We encountered a rude waiter at Capella restaurant on March 10th at 9pm. Otherwise, service was great!

Overall, our group of 7 had a great time! I would recommend requesting a room in pyramid 4 if you are travelling with kids as this was a central location to everything!

reviews.author: Anh-Tuan Le
reviews.text:
Had a great experience overall at the resort.
Staff and service were amazing.
The food is a hit or miss, but I highly recommend Lemon Fish.
The beach is pretty and clean, but the water is a little too rough to swim in

reviews.author: Debbie Block
reviews.text:
The check in was easy.  I am a RCI member and there was a separate check in. The service around the pool was great, especially Laura. We selected to use the all inclusive benefits and she knew what we wanted and thought ahead and brought us drinks, ice and other items (French fries) without asking. The pina coladas were delicious!

It was wonderful sitting around the pool and going back and forth between the beach and the pool. The chair situation around the pool was inadequate. Luckily we had people in our group that got up early enough to get chairs (530 to 6am). The weekend was especially busy. I would recommend a floaty for the pool. The whole pool is about 5 feet deep and walking on your tip toes all the time can be uncomfortable. The swim up bar was fun. It was a great way to meet people. Carlos made the best drinks.

The view out the main door walking out to the beach side is amazing. The water is all shades of beautiful blues!! The sand is great. Soft, white and not hot. The entrance into the ocean is a little tricky right in front of the resort. But, if you go down the beach a little (to the right) it is an easier entrance into the water. The waves are fun to play in.

The restaurants and buffet were good. As a gluten free person the labeling and choices were not adequate. Every meal was a challenge in communication for choices and staff understanding what gluten free was. Made things uncomfortable for everyone in our group.

We were in a 2 bedroom. One bedroom had a loud air conditioning unit. Hot tub was not usable. Old, water trickled out, and the tub was dirty. We didn't use it. The beds were very comfortable.

reviews.author: Kerry Earl
reviews.text: What a great place! Staff was so wonderful and cheerful.  We could not have asked for better people to spend 5 days with. Food was delicious, but on the buffet many times food that was meant to be hot was not. All the great food gave us an opportunity to try food we would not usually eat. Golf course was fun but was difficult to find which hole was next. We just played the the next one we could find. It was a little close to the road but a fun little  par 3. We were directly across from Aqua World so we could walk to our excursions.  Very convenient.  As for the room, the view was fantastic! Beds were quite soft compared to our extra firm mattress at home. There was a step going into the bathroom that caused a few stubbed toes and getting into the shower was a little sketchy. The tub was quite deep and not sunk in, so you had a giant step. There was also no fan in the bathroom so you had to leave the door open to let the steam out. Lights were a little confusing. Overall, we loved it and absolutely plan to return.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Gray
reviews.text:
We have a 10 & 12 year old and stayed using the Family Concierge option.

Staff: All the staff is amazing and they work really hard to meet your needs and keep the resort looking good. We had a butler assigned to us, LALO and he was awesome. I could text him anytime with something we needed or questions. He kept me posted on the status of our room as well because we got there pretty early. Overall all the staff is super nice and accommodating. Make sure you tip!!

Family Concierge: I recommend getting this if you can. We had a personal butler, ocean view family master suite room. The Aqua Marina restaurant was only available to us during breakfast so we didn’t have to wait in the buffet. Nobody used this option either so we got personal attention for breakfast! They dropped off a bottle of champagne and cookies one night.  Also you get one of the Bali beds by the pool for a full day.

Room: Our room was very nice, loved that we had 2 balconies. They brought in an extra bed for my daughter and my son slept on the sofa bed. Was nice to have the separation from the kids at night! The cleaning staff did a good job cleaning it as well.

Food: The kids loved the buffet for lunchtime. Our favorite restaurant was Capella. We didn’t eat at all the restaurants because the kids loved the buffet so much. They enjoyed there was something different everyday. Ordered dessert via room service and it was okay, just wasn’t very cold. Also the Nespresso cafe was awesome, the guys working there does a really good job! One big negative was my husband got sick after eating at Lemon Fish.

Pool: Was a bit confused on the chair situation at first but was told if you put a personal item on the chair then it is saved. I learned to get up around 6:30am and put some stuff down there. The towels are kind of hidden, the closest place is where aquaworld tries to sell you trips which was annoying. The pool bar was really nice and fun. We enjoyed sitting in the pool with some drinks! The pool does get really warm toward the end of the day. Another complaint is there are no bathrooms near the pool at all so you know people are peeing in there.

Beach: same situation with the pool if you want chairs and a shade tree get down there early and save your spot. Bonus you can catch a beautiful sunrise! The water was breathtaking with the colors, was our favorite part! The staff does bring drinks and food around as well.

Store: The store is super expensive, like $40 for a bottle of sunscreen! So bring lots with you!

Activities: they had Karoke and some other fun stuff my kids were too cool to partake in. They did get to play on a VR headset and they enjoyed that. On Friday night they had a festival with a bunch of food and vendors which was very cool. There was also a mariachi band that we really enjoyed! Was a perfect end to our trip!

reviews.author: Hattie Hodge
reviews.text:
The food was wonderful, but Miguel made the experience perfect
He brought us drinks all evening. Let us try all the food and brought us so many fun things.
The food is wonderful, fresh seafood, and great sushi but Miguel makes it an amazing experience. Make sure you try the salmon, the beef skewers, or the green aguachiles

reviews.author: isabel escudero
reviews.text:
Great hotel. You can tell it's been renovated. We had a problem at check-in; they make you check in online before arriving to "save" time, but then you still spend half an hour at reception. Our room wasn't ready yet (even though they ask beforehand what time you'll arrive so they can have it ready), but we were able to use the facilities in the meantime. When we got closer to the time they told us the room would be ready, they still made us wait an hour in the lobby. They didn't give us the room until 4:30 pm. It was a shame because, between one thing and another, we ended up losing almost the entire afternoon, and we were only staying two nights. That first night, we also had to wait an hour for dinner at the Japanese restaurant, and when we finally went, it was practically empty. We specified that we wanted a room with one double bed, and they gave us one with two single beds (they ask you beforehand about that too). Aside from those inconveniences... the Japanese restaurant was delicious. The staff was very friendly, and the buffets were good. The evening entertainment was a bit short. Everything closes at 11 PM.
The facilities are very well maintained. There were enough hammocks for everyone, and they were in excellent condition.

reviews.author: Belle MC
reviews.text:
My husband surprised me this past week by taking me to Paradisus Cancun, where we celebrated our honeymoon. I arrived and was speechless because upon entering, you see those five pyramid-like structures, and it's truly unique. Then, in the lobby, surrounded by lush greenery… I was in love. The check-in staff were incredibly kind, and the place smelled amazing. We stayed in The Reserve (adults only). Our concierge was Sergio, an excellent gentleman—very kind, attentive, cordial, and respectful. One of the things that made the experience so wonderful was Sergio. The restaurants were delicious, and I found Kao to be beautiful, a unique and special space. I was disappointed that I couldn't try the dumplings; they weren't available. The Mexican restaurant was absolutely delicious, and I loved the service, especially since I have allergies, and they took great care of me. The steakhouse was good, although we would have appreciated more attention. They have an ice cream shop, which is super nice. The ocean view is beautiful. For families with children, there's plenty of entertainment for them. The spa staff were very friendly and helpful.

It was a special stay that I hope to repeat, and when I return, I hope Sergio is still working so he can take care of us again. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Maylin Alejandra Ruiz Tejada
reviews.text: I visited two restaurants at the all-inclusive resort, the Japanese restaurant and the Aquamarine. I had a pleasant experience at both; the waiters were good. At Aquamarine, Paolo served us—excellent service, very chatty and attentive. As for the rooms, only the bed smelled a bit odd, but otherwise, everyone said good morning and was in a good mood. The karaoke was also 10 out of 10; DJ Uriel Avilés served us. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Patricio Eduardo Barriga
reviews.text: I want to talk about the service at Cappella. We were served by Edgar, an exceptionally helpful person. Very kind, and his diligence made all the difference in an elegant restaurant, even if it didn't necessarily have the best culinary quality.

reviews.author: Ivonne Mata
reviews.text:
At Aqua Marina restaurant, all the food was delicious. I loved the octopus and the coconut shrimp. The waiters Lucas and Alfredo were incredibly attentive, Chef Iván's cooking was amazing, and Captain Natsh was wonderful.
Congratulations!

reviews.author: lourdes maricela suarez gonzalez
reviews.text: The dinner was delicious; we had fried fish tacos and a wonderful watermelon salad. The service was excellent, especially from Chef Ivan and waiters Lucas and Alfredo.

reviews.author: Diana Garcia
reviews.text: Excellent service, very friendly staff, Richard was a very attentive and dedicated waiter, very helpful. Regarding the rooms, the only issue was that the vanity light in the bathroom wasn't working. The hallways and common areas weren't heated, which made them feel hot and humid. Overall, the staff's attention created a pleasant atmosphere. Thank you.

reviews.author: Aurea Gonzalez
reviews.text: Having Omar as our butler definitely made all the difference in making our stay perfect! He was very attentive to all our needs, questions, and requests.

reviews.author: JC Vela
reviews.text:
Excellent service from waiter Juan at Agua Marina.
The bad part: The food portions are so small you'll be starving. I ordered a seafood casserole. It had only clams (some were just the shells), and only one shrimp, and even then, only the head... and it was like that in most restaurants. Since you already paid for the "all-inclusive," they take advantage of you.

reviews.author: Jacqueline Jacqueline
reviews.text:
Excellent service and attention from Armando at Blue Agave, and high-quality dishes.

We enjoyed a delicious dinner at Cappella restaurant and the excellent service from Melvin. Congratulations to such a great team!

reviews.author: Jesus Benitez
reviews.text: Everything was great, the best part was the Blue Agave restaurant! Tacos every day, and at night they have even more delicious dishes. The staff—Atilano, Guadalupe, and Natanael—are very attentive, and Chef Miguel is fantastic!

reviews.author: Natalia Moll
reviews.text: Today we did yoga and crafts, and honestly, Jesús is a great employee who makes our vacation very special…

reviews.author: Erika McElhinney
reviews.text: Everything was great! We loved the food at all the restaurants, especially the Italian one, and the service at Kao was excellent. We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Maria Paula Aviles
reviews.text:
Chef Karen makes delicious sushi at Lemon Fish! Jorge and Miguel at that restaurant provide the best service! I didn't like the room service, but the food at the restaurants is very good! At Santé, order the moussaka, it was amazing!
The rooms are actually very comfortable, but I was a bit disappointed with some things. The lights on the fans or chandeliers didn't turn on, so the rooms were a bit dark. The internet isn't very fast either. But everyone who serves you is wonderful and very attentive.
The service on the beach is incredible! There's nothing better than lying on a lounge chair and having mimosas and burgers brought to you.

reviews.author: Mony Salazar
reviews.text: Mexican acupuncture, a great activity to relax and take some time for yourself. Giovani was very kind and helpful. It was a lot of fun.

reviews.author: J. “José Manuel Nequiz” Nequiz
reviews.text: A very nice, family-friendly hotel, the service is just okay and this is reflected in the hotel management.

reviews.author: Thomas SERRANO
reviews.text:
The entire resort was magnificent. The concierge was very helpful and attentive, truly making my experience enjoyable and relaxing. The food was very good. I would love to return after the remodel; I was impressed! The pools were top-notch.
My girlfriend and I recently had a trip, and the experience was exceptional.
We were very impressed with the service; the staff, who were always friendly and helpful, elevated our experience to the next level.
There were nine restaurants to choose from and about five bars, all amazing, but I was most impressed by Aqua Marina. We've been three times, and the service has always been top-notch, with all the care and advice from Martin, the manager. For bars, we loved the Gingle Bar, with Salvador, Jorge, and Glady, all funny and making sure I was well looked after. Jose Garcia at the Capella restaurant helped us with incredible dinner choices. The food was excellent, and his
fun personality added to the experience.
Abraham at the Ginger Bar is always excellent. His mixology expertise allows us to try new and wonderful drinks on every visit.
I had a 75-minute full-body massage with Guadalupe! It was very well done and therefore very relaxing! The spa had a very zen feel with the water features just outside the spa area. I was satisfied with the experience overall. I wish I had been charged to my room instead of having to pay immediately on-site. At another Paradisus.

reviews.author: Erick Sickta
reviews.text:
I want to sincerely thank the entire hotel team; they are truly amazing!

A very special thank you to Flora Restaurant, where we received impeccable service from Fany and Cinthia. They were so welcoming and made our dinner a truly special occasion.

On the beach, Irina served us with great kindness and always made sure we had ice-cold beer—thank you for your wonderful attention!

At Blue Agave Restaurant, we also received a warm welcome and enjoyed delicious dishes.

Everything was simply wonderful. I am so grateful for our stay at the Meliá Paradisus and for the professional, friendly, and dedicated team who made our vacation an unforgettable experience.

Thank you so much for everything!

reviews.author: Pablo Zaragoza
reviews.text: The Cappella restaurant is one of the best things about the hotel, and without a doubt, Edgar's service makes everything even more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Luis Alfonso Orta
reviews.text: Cintya Ortiz, Agua Marina Restaurant, Veloz, attentive, my, my, my, my, with, a smile, always, thank you very much for your work.

reviews.author: alex goncalves
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant is spectacular, the spinach pasta with almonds and picanha is the best. Waitress Anabel is very attentive and helpful. 10 out of 10. Waiter Didier from the pools is the best, very attentive, concerned with providing good service, understanding and making the menu understood. He works with joy, without a doubt the best.

reviews.author: Ev Vc
reviews.text: The room is comfortable, and the mattress is excellent. The staff are very attentive and helpful, especially Jorge from Lemon & Fish. The facilities are well-maintained, and the beach is fantastic. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Alfonso Micucci
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for four nights. The location is excellent, with a beautiful white beach right in front that gives way to a turquoise sea. There are several restaurants, including the Malva buffet (not the best food), a steak house (for a fee), a Mexican restaurant, a tapas restaurant, a Caribbean restaurant (the best!), and an Italian restaurant. The sand was generally clean (early in the morning they stir up the sargassum, making it disappear). Obviously, the better options cost extra. The downsides: old rooms in need of major renovations, very, very noisy air conditioning (so much so that you have to turn it off to sleep), extremely slow check-in (there's even no fast track for those who checked in online), very noisy at the pool (where the cabanas are reserved for those in "The Reserve" rooms). Little evening entertainment. Being a family-friendly hotel, it's easy to encounter very rude people who shout, blast their own music, and keep you from relaxing.

reviews.author: Erika Prats
reviews.text: Excellent service from all the staff, from the moment we arrived to the incredibly friendly Venecia's warm welcome. A special mention goes to Cynthia, who served us at Flora restaurant; we loved her suggestions and she provided outstanding service. It's clear she loves her job. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Erik Gonzalez
reviews.text:
For me, it was very good. I came in February 2025. The room (junior suite) was fine, except the air conditioning was a bit noisy, but since I sleep like a rock, I didn't find it bothersome.
The buffet food was pretty average; some items were delicious and some were bland and/or cold, but overall, the buffet had a lot of variety and the food was good.
However, they have a serious problem with pool towels. There were never any, and you had to hunt down the staff to get a couple. The room towels were perfect.
Overall, the service from the staff was very good; very friendly, smiling, and sometimes joking. A few were very serious, but never disrespectful to anyone.

reviews.author: Julio C C
reviews.text: Fanny and Alex provided excellent service at Flora restaurant. Overall, the service was good to average, but theirs was particularly outstanding. The food was also very good. My only complaint would be about the upkeep of the facilities, which appear to be deteriorating, and the air conditioning, which wasn't very effective.

reviews.author: Rosaura Mendicoa
reviews.text:
My opinion is about the staff: Roberto Isla de la Playa, who provided exceptional service during our stay. We are very grateful.

Jesús de Capella, a genius. Great service too.

reviews.author: Ananda Delgado
reviews.text:
Check-in was incredibly slow, over an hour's wait, and there was only one family ahead of us when we arrived, and they were already processing our request. 🤨
The hotel is huge and very beautiful, honestly, I loved the decor and the facilities. 😍
The food was quite acceptable, I'd rate it 4 out of 5. 🫠
The pools are spacious; one gets very crowded, another was always very quiet, and there's one just for adults, which is perfect. 👌

reviews.author: Alexandro López
reviews.text:
The hotel isn't that new, but it's worth it.
Good service. But in my opinion, they should have more variety in restaurants.
It gets crowded at breakfast and lunch times.

reviews.author: Tomás Segundo Estrada
reviews.text: This is truly a dream place for any tourist visiting Cancun who's unsure where to stay—this is the perfect spot! The staff's service is incredible; they're always available to help at any time. I also want to give a special shout-out to Alejandro and Ricardo from Nespresso, who always greeted us with a smile and a great cup of coffee each morning! With staff like these, it's always a pleasure to return.

reviews.author: liza romina
reviews.text: I want to highlight the excellent service from Julio at the adults-only bar in Pyramid 5. He's a very kind, cheerful, and helpful person, always attentive to any need. Excellent.

reviews.author: Paola Vargas
reviews.text:
Paola, our waitress at Blue Agave, was wonderful to serve. The food was delicious, the chef's tacos were amazing, and everyone was so friendly!

Daniel, our waiter at Leomon Fish, was fantastic. He was incredibly attentive and served us on time. 🙌🙌

Orlando, the bartender, was also a 10/10—very attentive and friendly.
10/10 🙌☺️

reviews.author: BORJA GARCIA
reviews.text:
The staff was the best, the service was excellent and very polite.
The gym was under construction, which I don't understand during peak season.
The spa always had issues; I didn't get a chance to use it.
The food was okay, you get tired of it, but it's normal; there's hardly any beef.
The rooms were fine but a bit outdated.
The golf course was fantastic.
The service was great and always friendly.
The place is nice, I would return, but there are a few shortcomings for a 5-star hotel. Watch out for vermin in the garden at night!

reviews.author: Josi Daresbach 2
reviews.text: Carlos and Alejandro Nespresso, Baltazar from the pool bar were the best servers! 10 stars for them!!! 👏🏼 Please, they live off tips, so when possible give them something, as they do much more than they should and are excellent at service! Thank you friends!!!! You were exceptional! 🤩👏🏼 The hotel left a few things to be desired considering the convention, one or two grumpy waiters, but for the most part it was very good! However, with so many people, the restaurants were packed! The last 3 days were so-so! The first 4 days were perfect!

reviews.author: Susana Vega
reviews.text:
The Sante Bar at The Reserve has a 10/10 service. Luis is an excellent bartender and provides top-notch service. Very kind, friendly, and attentive! It's definitely a paradise, perfect for an amazing vacation. Thank you!

P.S. My husband and I are with Luis in the photo 😉

reviews.author: Giovanna Lo
reviews.text: I had a wonderful vacation at the hotel. The quality of service was exceptional, and I truly enjoyed every moment of my stay. I want to especially congratulate Oscar from the entertainment team, who made our vacation even more special with his amazing activities. Thank you for everything! I will definitely return.

reviews.author: Hector
reviews.text:
First of all, a big thank you to Captain Guillermo at the Malva buffet. He immediately resolved a problem we had with dinner because we were given the wrong restaurant hours at reception. From then on, he was always attentive to ensure we had everything we needed. He was pleasant and fun.

The hotel was very well-equipped and clean. The beach was the best, and the access to it was excellent.

For those of us who love coffee, the 24-hour Nespresso machine was available!
Thank you so much! Greetings from Chile/Argentina.

reviews.author: ANA GARCIA-TALAVERA ALONSO
reviews.text:
This year, I spent my vacation with my son at Meliâ Paradisus Cancún. We bought a membership last summer and wanted to give the Meliâ group a try, especially because, in theory, being members would have a series of benefits/privileges that, unfortunately, I haven't seen. From day one, I've been experiencing incidents, one after another. I don't know if it was bad luck or simply that Meliâ has a lot of room for improvement; or both. After the experience, I've decided to cancel my membership. I sent the email 10 days ago and still haven't heard back... it gives me a bad feeling.
Regarding the reservation, as I mentioned before, I had one problem after another, and after speaking with a concierge, Alejandra Vilches, who forwarded my complaints to her superiors, I was finally able to enjoy my stay a bit. Although I returned somewhat happy after 12 days, I insist, thanks to her because she was very attentive to making sure my son and I were as comfortable as possible, my expectations weren't met.
I want to highlight her professionalism and empathy because from the very first minute, she connected with me, understood my arguments, and did everything possible to resolve everything. Thanks to her, I was able to speak with up to three supervisors, and I'm sure it was possible because she's a great professional, a decisive person who loves her job, who understands and empathizes with guests perfectly, and who strives for them to enjoy themselves and, of course, want to return. Thank you so much, Alejandra, for everything. I wish you much success. You deserve it, and lucky customers will be those who are fortunate enough to meet you.
That said, I'd also like to highlight the professionalism and friendliness of Alejandro at the Nespresso corner. A kind, smiling, and friendly person, he made you feel special every time you went to order a coffee. And also the rest of the employees in general, all very friendly and helpful, especially the waiters (or bartenders) at the "quiet" pool, which borders the "Adults Only" area.
And I don't want to forget the Kidsdom counselors, who are incredibly charming and affectionate and treated my son wonderfully. Thanks to them, he thoroughly enjoyed himself.
As for the rooms, they're pretty average. The bathrooms need updating, and while the ones with ocean views are a bit better, the most valuable thing is the view, which is spectacular, because otherwise, they look a bit dated.
The buffet wasn't bad, but I missed more healthy options, like sugar-free yogurts and a wider variety of whole-wheat bread, among other things. I give it a 7 out of 10, and the same goes for the restaurants. There are several, and the food isn't bad, but nothing special. The best for us were Lemon Fish and Aguamarina. What I liked least was that several dishes had an additional charge. I understand that there might be one or two with those conditions, but there were several, and it seemed like too much. That's my opinion.
And finally, the pool area is nice. What I liked most is that you can see the ocean, but I think they were too close together, barely providing privacy between them, and they were also a bit uncomfortable because most of them were fixed and couldn't be adjusted. The beach area was better, but the sun loungers were the same. And the beach was spectacular.

reviews.author: Josefina Reyes
reviews.text:
The service is excellent, the staff is very attentive, and everyone is very concerned about the guest's well-being. The waiters are very friendly and helpful.

The buffet is excellent, from breakfast to after-hours room service. Special mention goes to the Blue Agave taco restaurant, Johana Torres at reception is very friendly, the food by Chef Anibal Perez is excellent, and the waiters Atilano Diaz and Oscar are excellent.

I'm giving it 4 stars because our room (having paid for a premium suite) has mostly faulty electrical outlets, the bathroom smells like sewage, and it's very far from everything. Also, it says "lagoon view," but we're on the first floor, with a "view" of the pool area; it doesn't really have a view.

The hotel is very quiet and offers few activities overall.

reviews.author: Ha m
reviews.text:
As expected of a 5-star hotel. Everywhere in the hotel was beautiful, and the cleaning was impeccable.

There was so much greenery that it felt like we were outdoors, which was lovely. At night, the greenery was lit up, creating a magical atmosphere.

Our room had an ocean view and a bathtub. With the curtains fully open, we could soak in the bath while gazing at the beautiful sky.

There was a bar counter and snacks very close to our room, but the food was removed early in the evening, so we only got to eat once. We wanted to have a late-night snack, so it would have been nice if they had food available during the hours when alcohol was served.

Good points:
- An incredibly beautiful hotel
- The buffet had a wide variety of delicious food
- The private beach is beautiful
- You can access the beach easily by going down the stairs from the poolside
- There were sand toys for children in the room as a gift
- The spa was discounted on certain days of the week

Bad points:
- Dinner is almost entirely by reservation only. We couldn't go to the restaurant we wanted to, and the reservation time was too late.
- Childcare is extra.
- No rental of children's inflatable rings or life jackets.

Perhaps we went at a bad time (end of the year), but we couldn't get a reservation at our desired restaurant at all. Moreover, it was after 9 pm every day. As a family with children, we wanted to eat earlier.

We went to the buffet four times, and the contents changed slightly every day and every time slot, which was great. Many items were even tastier than those in the restaurants.

I recommend this hotel to those who want to enjoy a luxurious experience while traveling with children. If you want to let your children have as much fun as possible, a family-friendly hotel with water slides or similar amenities might be better.

Also, if you search for "Cancun family all-inclusive" in Japanese, you'll find many reviews, and it seems that many of the hotels have Japanese guests. We didn't see many Asians at this hotel, which I personally appreciated.

Although I've written about many negative points, overall I'm satisfied. I'm glad we chose this hotel!

reviews.author: Darlyn Otero
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay. The rooms need updating, but the service and the rest of the hotel are very nice. I recommend the Blue Agave restaurant; we received excellent service from Atilano.

reviews.author: vero villegas
reviews.text:
The service was excellent, the staff were very attentive.

The only downside to our room was the jacuzzi, which was very dirty and only partially functional.

The food lacked variety.

The best thing is that it's adults-only.

reviews.author: Miguel Vasconcelos
reviews.text:
I had a fantastic experience at the Nespresso stand in the Paradisus Cancun Hotel, thanks to Alejandro's exceptional service. He was extremely professional and attentive, always with a smile on his face and contagious friendliness.
A big thank you for your dedication and excellence in service!

reviews.author: Jesús Uzcátegui
reviews.text:
Jorge and Miguel are excellent hosts at Lemon Fish Restaurant, which is the best in the hotel for its food, service, and ambiance: 100 points.
The hotel's architecture is very modern despite being a 90s design; however, it's time to update the rooms.
The beach is very well maintained and offers excellent services.
Breakfast at Malva is fantastic.
You have many options for Nespresso coffee in various areas of the hotel.
They should improve the service and food at Aguamarina for lunch and dinner. Overall, a great experience.

reviews.author: melissa valle garcia
reviews.text:
I stayed from April 8th to April 12th. I really liked the hotel. The best part of my experience was the Pool Bar. The drinks were very good, and the bartenders were very attentive, especially Carlos, Timoteo, Melin, and Josué. They were very nice people, and the service was excellent.
The service at the Malva restaurant was very good, very attentive and helpful.
I went to the Cappella restaurant and loved the food. Congratulations to the cooking/pastry team.
The Blue Agave restaurant also had very good food and service. It was my first time eating tacos, and I had a good experience. Congratulations.

Something that could be improved is the Lemon Fish restaurant. The service was poor, they took too long to take my order, and the food wasn't very nice. I tried the Peruvian ceviche and didn't like it at all. I know it's a fusion, but they need to improve it a lot.

reviews.author: Danusa Farias
reviews.text: The hotel is large and beautiful, clean, and the staff is always attentive to your needs. Roberto Isla, in particular, was very attentive and polite at the children's pool. I expected more from the food service. I found it cold, the meat tough, and unlike other all-inclusive hotels, food isn't always available by the pool; you have to constantly ask for things, wait, and bother the waiters. I didn't like this.

reviews.author: José Orozco
reviews.text:
A very nice place with very friendly people. Many diverse and high-quality food options.
The 24/7 Nespresso station is a must, and Perla was super friendly and attentive to our family.
The buffet is just okay; it's the only weak point. The food is lukewarm to cold; it doesn't arrive at your table hot. During breakfast, the egg and omelet station has a very long line. Only one station has bacon, and it's not replenished quickly. I think it should be arranged differently to make it more accessible so everyone can enjoy different options at the right temperature.

reviews.author: Mai
reviews.text:
Having spent two weeks at the hotel, we had a pretty comprehensive experience and wanted to share a few things to help both other guests/readers and the hotel itself.

To begin, the first thing I want to say is that they should adopt more of the style of other Paradisus hotels. For example, we've stayed at the Paradisus in Punta Cana, and there are shows or some kind of entertainment every night until midnight. At this hotel, it was noticeable that they operate on a different schedule; for instance, the restaurants start closing around 10 or 11 pm, but that didn't bother us. There were some very good artists who came to sing in the bar on the first floor in the evenings. However, not every night was like that compared to the other hotel.
My second comment concerns the first-come, first-served system. It wasn't bad, as you don't have to wait too long for a table after joining the waiting list, unless the hotel is very full, as happened to us on our last night. It would be great if, given these situations, they tried implementing a reservation system like the one in Punta Cana, where your concierge reserves the restaurant and time you prefer. This would avoid any unpleasant surprises or complaints on this matter.
I also have a few quick comments I'd like to highlight, such as the lack of sufficient beach chairs and the fact that they don't fully recline. Furthermore, we had to water our balcony plants many times; we noticed they weren't being watered, even though the cleaning staff came by every day. The bar staff deserve praise for always refilling our snacks, but they should pay more attention to refilling their water bottles. We went days without them refilling our water, which is essential, even more so than chips and other snacks. During those days, we asked the beach attendants for bottled water. A big shout-out to all of them; they're fantastic! Now, the rooms are a bit dated, as the hotel is quite old, but we didn't find it to be a problem. In fact, we appreciated that it had a bidet, which we didn't usually find at the Paradisus hotels we've stayed in. We were given rooms 2207 and 2208, which were connected. I've read many comments complaining about the age of the rooms, but I don't think a modernization is necessary right now. They could simply add complimentary bathroom accessories or put shelves in the closets to store more clothes and compensate that way.

Finally, I'm going to talk about the most frequently mentioned topic in the comments section: the restaurants. Our favorites were Capella (Italian) and Lemon Fish (sushi and ceviche). The waiters at Lemon Fish were very attentive; greetings to Jorge and Daniel, who were very kind, and also to Osvaldo from Cielo Lindo. Thankfully, we didn't see any cockroaches, we didn't get sick, and we weren't treated badly. The food at Malba was excellent; the poke bowls were a great idea.

Our only comment on this matter is that the waiters often forgot our orders or took a very long time to come and serve us, especially at the Malba restaurant where we had to get up and go ask a waiter to serve us. Many of the waiters didn't even look at the tables to see if anyone needed a drink. In my opinion, they should set up an area where people can serve themselves, as the waiter system seems to be unreliable and they take far too long, especially when it's busy. We simply ask that they be more attentive when people first arrive to eat, serving them drinks and making more eye contact with the tables to ask if they would like more drinks or anything else.
Despite these comments, we had a fantastic time. The beach is beautiful, the hotel is huge and unique, but I felt it was necessary to mention these things because before coming to the hotel I was quite intimidated by the reviews section, so I wanted to write my own review to help. Thank you very much for reading, and thank you to the hotel for the wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Jorge Jara
reviews.text:
Baltazar and Rodrigo. The best waiters at the pool bar. Excellent service from these guys. Very attentive and always available to satisfy the customer. I had a great experience with them every day. Very attentive. I felt very well taken care of in a very friendly and pleasant atmosphere.

Cintia from Fiona Restaurant. Excellent service. The food is very healthy and the variety is excellent. Spectacular service.

Abraham and Luis are super bartenders at La Reserva. Excellent service. I feel like I'm at home.

We went to dinner again at Furia Restaurant. Since the first time we had a very good experience, today was the opposite. What a disappointment! We found four cockroaches. Horrible, we lost our appetite. What a shame. They should address this issue.

reviews.author: Francisco Javier
reviews.text:
The Bad:
-The rooms are somewhat outdated.
-The air conditioning was a bit noisy, and we couldn't turn it up or down.
-The Mexican taco restaurant leaves a lot to be desired; the food was bland and greasy.
-In my opinion, the staff (not all of them) is very keen to ensure you leave a good tip, which made me a little uncomfortable.
-The lounge chairs are not included in the "All Inclusive" package.

The Good:
-The beach and the water were exquisite (although we went during the sargassum season, we hardly noticed any of it).
-Most of the staff was very attentive.
-The service from David, the gentleman who greeted us and gave us a tour of the hotel, was excellent; he made our stay very enjoyable!

In conclusion:
I do recommend the hotel ⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Pablo Boggio
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, especially the Malva and Nespresso cafes, the Flora restaurant, and the excellent service from the staff in general. I especially want to highlight the service from Richer, Alex, Francisco, Martin, Javier, Alberto, Perla, Adriana, Anabel, Teresa, and Cinthia. The beach is excellent! I would also like to mention the attentiveness and friendliness of Gaudino and the lifeguards, Manain, Carmen, and Johnny, who were always helpful. One area for improvement is the juices, which are generally very artificial, so the fruit juice drinks aren't very good.

reviews.author: Alejandra Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Blue Agave Restaurant was delicious, especially the tongue tacos.
Paola provided excellent service; she was very kind and attentive to our baby, who needed extra care.
Lemon Fish Restaurant was also very tasty, though the portions were small. Our waiter, Miguel, was very helpful, ordering the right amount of each dish.
Aguamarina Restaurant was excellent; the coconut shrimp and ceviche are must-tries. Our waitress, Paola Krystel, provided outstanding service.
The rooms were very clean and comfortable, but the minibar wasn't working and was never fixed.
We ordered room service, and the hamburger was raw. We asked for another one, and it was cooked through, but it was a minor issue.
Regarding the hotel's location, half the beach is fine, while the other half is rocky. The VIP area with lounge chairs, which is off-limits to regular guests, is the best beach. We couldn't use the other half because the sea was very rough, and the rocks made it dangerous. Only the VIP area was available, and there were no sunbeds.

The hotel is generally very nice and well-equipped, with delicious food and facilities.

reviews.author: Fabian Montenegro
reviews.text: Lemon Fish restaurant is excellent; they have a rib dish where the meat falls off the bone. Arce and my family really appreciated the service; he guided us throughout the meal.

reviews.author: Saylin Carolina Camero Poriett
reviews.text: A pleasant place to spend a vacation. The rooms are comfortable, but I think they need to be renovated and updated. The food is delicious, prepared by chefs Karen and Marcos at the Lemon Fish Restaurant. The dishes are excellent, especially Jorge's service.

reviews.author: Erik Mayerstein
reviews.text:
We liked everything overall; it was a great experience, but there are some small details that are good to know before booking.

The rooms are very comfortable and nice, but the hotel is somewhat old, so the A/C is in the same room, so you can hear the machine. It's not a big deal, you can sleep without any problem, but I think it's something worth knowing.

We love the 24-hour Nespresso bar!

When ordering drinks like fresh water, ask the bartender to stir them before serving. The water comes out a little higher than the bottom, so what settles stays at the bottom, but what comes out is very sweet.

The restaurants are "okay." For example, Lemon Fish has very limited options, although it's very nice.

The Mexican restaurant (I don't remember the name) is like a very fresh taqueria. The food tastes delicious, but as for gringos, if you're a Mexican who really likes tacos, adjust your expectations.

The buffet is delicious, super varied, and excellent! Just keep an eye on the opening hours, as it's not always open.

The bathrooms are "okay" but difficult to find, as they're not well-located and sometimes not as clean as you'd expect at this level of hotel.

The staff is always super attentive and helpful!

The hotel is wonderful overall. I really plan to return, and it's well worth it. The things I mentioned above are things that could be improved, but we had a great time!

reviews.author: ROSA CINTRON
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful, and the housekeeping service is very good. The staff is generally very attentive. Alejandro always greets guests with a smile in the Express area. Ariel, who was in charge of karaoke, was the best; he has so much energy and is super cheerful. He really got us dancing and having a lot of fun, unlike Layla, who was in charge of karaoke the next day and didn't seem very involved; she just wanted to finish the activity quickly. Rodrigo, one of the waiters at the pool, was also very kind and attentive. I have to mention that my family has been part of the Melia Club for over six years, and this trip had some very uncomfortable moments. Our concierge, Pedro, never showed up or was attentive to our needs. We were very disappointed that we didn't have the option to make reservations. We think they should maintain the reservation option for those who plan ahead, especially if they come with large families. Daniel, one of the waiters at the FishLemon restaurant, was super attentive and provided us with vegetarian options that other waiters had refused. Daniel also made sure we had a nice birthday dinner. **** Room 1101 had problems with the air conditioning; it didn't cool properly. We spent the nights feeling hot, and there was a very bad smell coming from the pipes and the bathrooms. This is a crucial issue that needs to be addressed because it was very unpleasant.**** Aside from that, I am very grateful for the work everyone does to try to please the guests, and I do recommend staying at this hotel; it is generally very pleasant. Thank you all!

reviews.author: Miguel Moreno
reviews.text:
We received the best service in the entire property at Sante Restaurant in The Reserves. All the staff—Natanael, Arnulfo, Axel, Miguel, Moisés, César, Joel, Josue, and especially Ms. Estefanie and the rest of the Sante team—made our stay an unforgettable experience. They were all kind, accommodating, attentive, efficient, diligent, courteous, and above all, humble in the excellent service they provide every day. More employees should be like them. They are an example for everyone to follow. They do their work with pride in a job well done, and it's clear at first glance that they do it with pleasure. I also have to thank our concierge, Violeta, for her excellent service. She was always attentive to any needs, even on her day off. You couldn't ask for better service from a person. It's also worth mentioning Lai, Uri, and Bryan from Activities. These three make a great effort to entertain guests with their daily activities, jokes, and infectious laughter. And we must give well-deserved recognition to Victor and Nicole, who were always there to ensure we had our Balinese bed. Thanks to this great team, the few minor inconveniences were insignificant.

This team made our vacation a truly memorable experience, and we take away many magical memories from a natural paradise filled with beautiful and kind people. Room 5406, April 3-9, 2024. And I can't finish without giving a very special mention to Chef José; his cuisine is exceptional.

reviews.author: Angela Peña
reviews.text: It was a very pleasant stay; the food, the service, the beach—everything was spectacular. The rooms weren't my favorite, after being moved three times for various reasons, such as humidity and the air conditioning. However, the important thing is that the staff always tries to help and resolve any issues. The spa experience was well worth it if you stay at a Meliá.

reviews.author: Paula Giletta
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel. Its infrastructure is INCREDIBLE.
THE STAFF IS FRIENDLY AND KINDLY ASSIST YOU. ALWAYS WILLING TO HELP YOU WITH GREAT RESPECT AND CARING.
WE THANK GEMMA from the Resto and PERLA from Nespresso for being so excellent with us. Thank you!!!
The only thing I would ask for is a microwave in the dining room because the food is served rather lukewarm and arrives at the table FREEZING. Not to mention if you have children who have to heat up food and bottles...
That's all!!!!

reviews.author: Gabriel irazuzta
reviews.text:
Excellent service from our concierge Jenny, attentive to every detail.
Very good service at Flora restaurant by Anabell, at Capela by José Garcia, and at Limón Fish by Arce.

0

reviews.author: Judith Angulo
reviews.text: The resort was great! The best part was definitely the beach we fell in love with its beautiful turquoise water. The food at the restaurants was delicious, and the buffet was especially enjoyable. I have to give a special shout out to Armando, Pascual at the buffet, Roger at steak house who provided exceptional service. They were friendly, attentive, and made our dining experience even better. We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: Mandy Doy
reviews.text:
I have been coming to Paradisus for 11years.  The last couple of years have not been the amazing experience we had hoped for.  I was nervous to come after the remodel, just not knowing what to expect.  I was pleasantly pleased with the remodel and changes that have occurred.
Rommel was our concierge and he was amazing.  Israel was also so kind and always willing to help with anything we needed.
Cesar, Jamil, Valeria, Julio, Boris, Mike, Hoarcio are all amazing and willing to create an amazing experience for the guests.

Please continue to work on the water level in the pool for the Reserve side.  That is going to be crucial to making sure the guests are happy.

Edgar was amazing at Capella!  Food was delicious and service was even better.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Shannon clark
reviews.text:
My husband and I celebrated our 20-year anniversary at Paradisus Cancun in April 2026, and we had a wonderful experience.

The resort had recently reopened after renovations, and everything felt fresh, modern, and very clean. The beach was beautiful, the pools were relaxing, and the grounds were well maintained.

The highlight of our stay was the staff. Everyone was friendly, helpful, and genuinely seemed to care about making our vacation special. A special thank you to Chris, our Reserve Concierge, who went above and beyond throughout our stay.

If you’re considering upgrading to The Reserve Adults Only section, I highly recommend it. The concierge service, exclusive lounge, premium drinks, coffee bar, adults-only dining, and Bali beds were well worth it.

The resort offers several dining options, including steak, seafood, Japanese cuisine, and a buffet. While the food wasn’t our favorite part of the trip, breakfast was excellent and there was plenty of variety.

We especially enjoyed the live saxophone music during breakfast, the beautiful beach, and the peaceful gym each morning.

Overall, we had an amazing anniversary trip and would gladly return to Paradisus Cancun in the future.

reviews.author: Walisa Dickson
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancún exceeded every expectation.

From the moment we arrived, we were treated with warmth, professionalism, and genuine hospitality. The resort itself is beautiful, well maintained, and offers an outstanding experience, but what truly sets it apart is the people.

A special thank you to Alejandro and Rommel from the Family Concierge team. They were phenomenal throughout our stay. They anticipated needs before we even had to ask, provided excellent recommendations, and always made us feel like valued guests. Their attention to detail and commitment to exceptional service made a lasting impression on our family.

The restaurants, pool staff, housekeeping team, bartenders, and servers were all wonderful. Every interaction was positive, and it was clear how much pride the staff takes in creating a memorable experience for guests.

One idea I would encourage the resort to consider is providing a QR code tipping option for staff members. We quickly learned that cash goes fast when so many people are providing exceptional service. There were several team members we wanted to recognize and thank, but we simply ran out of cash during our stay. A digital tipping option would be convenient for guests and would help ensure outstanding employees receive the appreciation they deserve.

This trip was a special graduation celebration, and Paradisus Cancún helped make it unforgettable. Thank you to everyone who contributed to such an amazing experience. We will be recommending this resort to family and friends and hope to return again.

reviews.author: Diyora Khasanova
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived, the hotel made our family feel welcomed and well taken care of. The level of service throughout our stay was exceptional and truly made this trip special for us.

First and foremost — the family concierge service. We were lucky to have Erick Mejenes, who truly elevated our entire stay. He was always available, answered all of our questions, booked restaurants and spa appointments, and helped organize family events like birthdays. His attention to detail and genuine care made everything feel smooth and stress-free.

Second, if you’re traveling with kids, you should definitely choose this hotel for its amazing kids program. Our stay wouldn’t have been the same without the extra care and attention from the wonderful Kidsdom team — especially Maylin, Fernanda, Esmeralda, Alondra, and Vianey. Our son is usually very shy, but he couldn’t wait to go to Kidsdom every day. The program was very well organized and engaging.

Among the extra activities offered by the hotel, we especially enjoyed the Cocoa Ceremony and the cocktail master class, hosted by attentive staff members including Mauricio, Daniel, and bartender Xavier.

Among the à la carte restaurants, I’d highly recommend Kao, Blue Agave (especially the caramel flan ice cream dessert), and Vibra, where we received especially high-end service from a very attentive waiter named Omar.

reviews.author: VLORA CAKOLLI
reviews.text: We had a wonderful dining experience at Capello! The food was absolutely delicious—the antipasti were the perfect start, and the pasta dishes were fresh, authentic, and packed with flavor.A special thank you goes to our waiter, Edgar. He was incredibly attentive, professional, and warm, making sure our family had everything we needed for a perfect evening.We highly recommend this place and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Hajar Lyazidi
reviews.text: Very pleasant experience.  The service we received from Martin Kucan and David Rodriguez @ GastroHall restaurant  made us want to extend our stay. The manager Nayeli  made sure kids are taking care of since they have Gluten Allergy. The best experience ever we will definitely come back here thanks to their assistance

reviews.author: Lou Dempsey
reviews.text:
Omar our butler was beyond amazing, made our stay absolutely magical, always attentive and went beyond with everything for us. The hotel/Reserve section far surpassed any all inclusive accommodations we have stayed in previously. It’s a 10/10 from accommodation, ease of day bed use, ability to reserve speciality restaurants, amenities cleanliness/comfort of the rooms. At no point did we go hungry or thirsty, fantastic food options for celiacs (staff well aware), so much fresh fruit and delicious options. Amazing greenery/plants everywhere, gorgeous tropical vibes throughout the hotel.
We cannot wait to return here again.

reviews.author: Suli Marquez
reviews.text: I loved this resort so much! Javier is the bartender and such a vibe! Mauricio handled prepping the activities like cocktail lessons, Mexican shows, circus show etc lots of cool things to check out. The people are AMAZING! The vibes are chill but can definitely pick up if you want it to!

reviews.author: Miguel Guerra
reviews.text:
My partner and I traveled from Miami and had an absolutely amazing stay at the beautiful Paradisus Cancún, and a huge part of that experience was thanks to our incredible butler, Omar.

From the moment we arrived, Omar went above and beyond to make sure every detail of our vacation was perfect. He was professional, attentive, friendly, and always one step ahead of our needs. Whether it was helping with restaurant reservations, arranging activities, answering questions, or simply checking in to make sure we were enjoying our stay, his dedication to outstanding guest service truly stood out.

What impressed us most was his genuine kindness and willingness to help. He made us feel welcomed, valued, and completely taken care of throughout our entire visit. It’s rare to encounter someone who takes such pride in creating memorable experiences for guests, and Omar exceeded every expectation.

The resort itself is beautiful, but employees like Omar are what make a vacation unforgettable. Thank you for making our trip so special and stress-free.

We will definitely be returning to Paradisus Cancún, and we hope to see Omar again on our next visit!

reviews.author: Maureen Vera Clark
reviews.text: Adriana & Fanny took so much good care of us making it such a special day celebrating our little one. This place is so family oriented and their attention to detail and customer service is world class. Recommended and cannot wait to come back!

reviews.author: Aliza Delva
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience during my stay. Food was delicious and fresh. Many options. The servers at my meal times especially Alejandro, Reynaldo, Hermes and Richer kept the vibes going and we’re on top of getting anything I needed. This will be my go to resort for my trips to Cancun!

reviews.author: Kara Ward
reviews.text: Literally the best meal I had during my stay, and that is saying A LOT. The ambiance, food, and service (thank you so much Edgar!) were all amazing. Should out to my concierge Natalia for both recommending this restaurant out of all the restaurants here (I'm only here 5 nights so I wouldn't have been able to try them all) and for making sure this was my final dinner here at Paradisus. I will be back.

reviews.author: Victoria Silva
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was absolutely unforgettable! From the moment we arrived, the entire hotel staff made us feel welcomed, cared for, and truly on vacation. The resort is beautiful, clean, relaxing, and the service was top tier in every area restaurants, pool service, housekeeping, and guest experience.

But the real highlight of our trip was our amazing butler, Erick Mejenes! He went above and beyond every single day to make sure our family had the best experience possible. His attention to detail, kindness, professionalism, and genuine care made us feel so special. No request was ever too much, and he always made everything smooth and stress-free for us.

Erick truly elevated our entire vacation experience and is honestly one of the best butlers we’ve ever had. Paradisus Cancun is lucky to have someone like him representing their resort!

Thank you again to Erick and the entire Paradisus Cancun team for making our trip so memorable. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Kendri Sabillon
reviews.text: This is genuinely the best resort I’ve ever been to. The attention the staff give you is amazing! They go out of their way to make you feel taken care of and seen. Alejandro and Bernardo at the buffet were so so sweet and they took such good care of us the whole week. I definitely hope to stay here again. (Wish I didn’t have to go back home😭💔)

reviews.author: Kate Grinshpon
reviews.text:
Had an amazing dinner at Kao restaurant. Our server, Daniel, provided top-notch service!

Service by the pool was excellent every single day of our stay thanks to Vianney! Thank you!

Our dinner at Cappella - Italian restaurant - was amazing. Delicious food and great service. Our server, Jesus, was very knowledgeable and provided amazing service!

reviews.author: Zachary Donato
reviews.text: Paradisus is perfectly named - it truly is a paradise. The staff are absolutely amazing and helpful, the rooms are wonderful, and the experience is everything you could ask for. The food is amazing, especially Blue Agave. Their tacos were delightful and the staff were even better. Nathanael the manager and Alberto our waiter were attentive and great to converse with. I highly recommend coming here, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Charlie Johnson
reviews.text: Fantastic stay at the Paradisus Cancun. All of the staff around the reserve were absolutely fantastic and a credit to the hotel. Jared & Israel looked after me super well. A big mention to Julio on the reserve bar, fantastic service from him. Thank you!

reviews.author: Amanda Hart
reviews.text: Mario was such a great help & waiter at Kao! He made sure our order was correct because my stand is allergic to Avocado and he took time to expect our food before dropping it off! I cannot say enough good things about the employees at this exceptional resort! This is our third time coming back and we love the staff here!! The remodel also looks amazing!

reviews.author: Julia Tighe
reviews.text: We loved our experience here!! Such an amazing experience, went on a girls trip and had so much fun! The staff was so sweet and attentive, we loved Uriel! He was as so sweet and always making sure we had everything taken care of!

reviews.author: Sonja Katanic
reviews.text:
We came to blue agave and had Armando as our server. He was amazing and so friendly! Everything he helped us choose was delicious; we are both gluten free and he helped us through the menu and ensured everything we wanted was safe for us. We felt super welcome!

We also loved the bar in the lobby, and Anahi and Diego specifically there were so lovely! We can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Vicky Chan
reviews.text: Ernesto was very good at servicing us, made sure we liked everything and gave us very good recommendations on food choices!!!! Go to Aqua Marina now! This is the best restaurant in this resort so far. The manager Teresita was very caring too. She invited us to this restaurant and gave us special order to try the seafood and dessert. Thank you! Will be back & definitely recommend this to our friends.

reviews.author: Nick Kravchuk
reviews.text:
We had an amazing experience at the Italian restaurant in Paradisus Cancun, and a huge part of that was thanks to Edgar!

From the moment we sat down, he made us feel genuinely welcome and taken care of. His attention to detail, friendly attitude, and perfect timing with everything—from drinks to recommendations—made the whole evening smooth and enjoyable. He knew the menu really well and helped us pick dishes that turned out to be absolutely delicious.

What really stood out was how effortless he made everything feel. He was always there when we needed something, but never intrusive—just top-tier service all around.

Edgar truly elevated our dining experience. If you get the chance, definitely ask for him—you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Yesmina Maurer
reviews.text:
Appreciation and recognition for the outstanding service provided by Carolina Guitierrez concierge assigned to us during our stay at your hotel Malia Cancun.
From the very beginning, the attention we receive was truly exceptional. The concierge  Carolina was always kind, professional, punctual, attentive and welling to assist us with every detail we need.
Her warm attitude, dedication and commitment to excellent customer service made our stay enjoyable and memorable.
Thank you !!!  To her professionalism and disposition.
Sincerely,
Yesmina Pulido

reviews.author: Mindy Langley
reviews.text: We stayed for 4 days in May. We had 2 family concierge and they were amazing! Eduardo and Alejandro were great. They went out of their way to make us comfortable. We truly appreciate everything! It was a great experience!

reviews.author: Simran Chandi
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was truly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the exceptional service, attention to detail, and warm hospitality from the staff. The resort is beautifully maintained—everything from the rooms to the common areas was spotless and well cared for.

The atmosphere throughout the resort is relaxing yet vibrant, making it perfect for both families and couples. The staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and enjoying our time, which made a big difference in our overall experience.

The combination of cleanliness, excellent service, and the stunning beachfront location made this trip absolutely amazing. We left with wonderful memories and would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking for a luxurious and stress-free getaway. We would definitely love to return!

reviews.author: Liz val
reviews.text: First time visiting this resort it is so beautiful. The room is beautiful the only downside is our air conditioner did not work but they are on top of it getting fixed. Second day here and we did an activity making a key chain. Jesus was an amazing instructor.

reviews.author: Pierre Galarza
reviews.text: Our butler, Eduardo Mena, went above and beyond during our one week stay at resort Paradisus in Cancun. He was always making sure we had everything we needed. He reserved our dinners for us and any activities we wanted to do. His hospitality towards our family made us feel comfortable and right at home. Anyone that's being helped by Eduardo will have a great experience. We all highly recommend him as a butler.

reviews.author: Ashley Gilani
reviews.text: We really enjoyed Kao restaurant at Paradisus! Daniel was our server and although we don’t eat seafood, he was very helpful in giving us guidance on what to order. Everything was so delicious and it’s a beautiful restaurant! We would love to be back during the rest of our stay.

reviews.author: Areyousingle lin
reviews.text: The Karaoke was funny with the Mc Uriel and the DJ Bryan!! They know made the party!!! The party was so much fun. They're very professional guiding the whole thing and whole grew with a vibe. It's a definitely fantastic night. If I were rayday we'll be 10 out of 10 100%

reviews.author: Ancsa Szepesi
reviews.text:
We recently stayed for 12 nights and overall had a good experience, made memorable by several outstanding staff members.
A special mention goes to Jesus, the wellness instructor, who truly elevated our stay. His yoga and meditation sessions were excellent, and we also really enjoyed his Mexican herbs class, as well as the margarita and tequila tastings; such a great mix of relaxation and culture. We had a great experience on the Sound healing as well with the team, Jesus, Giovani, Uriel, Rogelio and Mauricio.
The mixology class was another highlight, thanks to Daniel, Andres, and Giovani, who made it both fun and engaging.
We also want to recognize Jesus at KAO restaurant for his very good service, and Jesus at Zesty, who was so attentive and welcoming.

A big thank you to Sergio, our personal concierge, who was always available whenever we needed anything, his support made everything smooth and stress-free.

Uriel from the entertainment team and Sommelier Miguel was fantastic as well, they joined us during the Wine & Canvas activity, which we really enjoyed.

Daniel from the entertainment team was another staff member who stood out, always greeting us warmly and taking the time to chat whenever we crossed paths.

Also thank you David for your kind service and the Bali beds with beautiful views, I can't recall the names of your colleagues but they were great too!

One area for improvement would be the breakfast service at Sante. It was inconsistent, on some mornings it was attentive, but on others it felt disorganized. There were instances where we were seated before other guests, yet they were served drinks and coffee well before us, while we were still waiting for something as a greeting from a server. That said, Valeria provided excellent service whenever she was there and made a positive difference!

It's also worth noting that there are currently some improvements taking place around the resort, including painting, hammering and general updates. While this didn't significantly impact our stay, it's something to be aware of.

Overall, we had a lovely stay and truly appreciated the efforts of the staff who went above and beyond to make our vacation special.

reviews.author: Lauren Gaston
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus for the last 3 days of our trip in Mexico and overall had a fantastic stay. Probably easier to start with the cons as there were so many positives:

- could tell they were rushing to reopen ahead of renovations. Given hotel was closed for better part of 10months due to renovations. There was still some ongoing maintenance, likes of ladders and painters not having finished.
- this sort of bled through to a few of the touches that were missing. We had espresso pods in the room but not coffee machine. Beer and water bottles which required a bottle opener, but no bottle opener. They let us know upon check in that 24 hour room service was available but then once the main buffet was closing and we were looking to order some dinner, the phone line was permanently engaged and once we went through reception, wait time for food was over an hour.
- couldn’t get dinner reservations.

That really is it with regards to cons however. The positives far overruled.
- excellent food variety and drinks.
- quality of food was high
- staff were incredibly helpful and friendly
- amenities were all very clean with a fully incredibly well equipped gym.
-availability of 24 hour coffee in the coffee shop.
- cannot comment on the à la carte restaurants as unfortunately they were fully booked for duration of our stay but they looked very nice.

Our room was beautiful and overall we had an amazing stay and would definitely recommend the hotel and would return if we were to go back to cancun.

reviews.author: Kord Davis
reviews.text:
Juan Carlos and Alondra were attentive from the start. Both of them made it their mission to make our honeymoon one to remember.

Alberto at Kanna Beach is a stud!

Vianney was fantastic as well, she remembered our names and orders!

reviews.author: Kimberly Savitsky
reviews.text:
Great visit, family has visited many times. Renovations improved the hotel room experience, restaurants moved around and refreshed.

Luis and team great at Kanna beach for private kabana

Alberto and Nathanael amazing at Blue Agave, they were so accommodating and gave us complimentary liqueur to end the dinner

Will keep returning! Love this paradise

reviews.author: Diana K
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus in Cancun and the experience was amazing. We ate at the Blue Agave which was an authentic Mexican restaurant and the food was superb. Our waiter Manuel, was absolutely amazing. He was friendly, and provided amazing service. We enjoyed every experience with him. Definitely come see Manuel at the Blue Agave if you’re ever in Cancun

reviews.author: Sarah Mcintyre
reviews.text:
Honestly Jesus from Capella has the best customer service I have experienced at Meliá.  The food and service here was next level.

Fanny & Martin from Gasto Hall are also 10/10.

Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Ina Grecu
reviews.text: Amazing experience at Aqua Marina! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was beautiful, and everything was perfect. A special thank you to Angel for the outstanding service — so friendly, attentive, and professional. He really made our evening unforgettable. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.text: Omar our butler was amazing I've never paid for the "reserve" style upgrades before but everything that was included and the attention to detail was exceptional. Also as a celiac I was able access a lot more menus with confidence. Will be back for sure

reviews.author: roy mohon
reviews.text: Julio did a great job each time he waited on us. Fkora and Olivia were excellent for our pool service. There are more wonderful people i will try to remember all their names and comment later

reviews.author: LaToya Powell
reviews.text: Gerardo in the Gastro Hall was such a fantastic waiter! I saw him every day I was there and he took great care of me. We spoke in spanish and he helped me with perfecting my conversationsl spanish. The food was delicious and I look forward to coming back. Thank you again to Gerardo, the other waiters and the chefs!

reviews.author: Michelle Abro
reviews.text: Rodrigo was great! He provided our family with the best pool service. Our waters were always full and he continued to bring us ice plus anything else we asked for! We would definitely recommend his service.

reviews.author: Karny
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Blue Agave with our server Atilano. He was very friendly and gave us the best customer service. The food was prepared by chef Miguel and he did a fantastic job. All the food was amazing and we would definitely recommend this restaurant to others.

reviews.author: Prema D Souza
reviews.text:
ADAN at the front desk of Paradisus Cancun truly made our stay unforgettable. He went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect. His professionalism, warmth, and genuine care for guests set him apart immediately.

He was always attentive, quick to assist with any request, and consistently made us feel welcomed and valued. Whether it was offering helpful recommendations, resolving questions efficiently, or simply greeting us with a friendly smile, Adan elevated our entire experience.

It’s rare to encounter someone so dedicated to hospitality, and his efforts did not go unnoticed. Because of him, our stay was not just comfortable but exceptional. I would highly recommend seeking him out if you’re staying at Paradisus Cancun—he will make sure you have the best time possible.

reviews.author: B Martinez
reviews.text: Loved the resort’s new look! The room we stayed in at the Family Concierge pyramid was spacious, comfortable and the amenities good quality. We loved the food and the service everywhere we ate. Teresa and Ernesto at Aquamarina, Vianney at the poolside Bali, took fantastic care of us. Special mention to the stars at the kids club, Esmeralda, Alondra and Fernanda who made my kids stay truly wonderful!

reviews.author: Marie-Lou Gilbert
reviews.text: Our stay at the Paradisus Cancan was such a great time!! The resort is very impressive and the staff is so nice! We had Fernanda as our concierge. She was very kind and always checked up on us and made sure we had everything we needed :) We were very lucky to have her during our stay. We also met Jesus, The fitness instructor. He had great energy and always kept us entertained! Finally, on our last Day, we had a margherrita class with Melvin who was awesome! This is a place I would want to come back to for sure :)

reviews.author: Alexandra Rodriguez
reviews.text: We loved going to the daily activities, specifically Yoga with Jesus. He was very caring with us and prioritized our experience. My family loved him!

reviews.author: Levon Byrd
reviews.text: Alfredo at Kanna was the absolute best. He helped us and kept the drinks coming. He made this trip so welcoming smd we appreciate him.

reviews.author: Liana Kachakhmadze
reviews.text: Amara and David from the buffet service, Daniel #2 from entertainment, Sabrina from bar management, and Karina from the SPA went above and beyond to make us happy and keep our vacation feeling personal. Keep up the great service quality! And a big thank you!

reviews.author: Sanjana Venkat
reviews.text: We came to Cappela Italian restaurant for dinner 2 times and we loved the food . Jesus was very good and he went out of the way to get us all that we wanted . He even helped customize few dishes because we are vegetarian. Roberto was also a fine waiter who helped us .

reviews.author: Tammy Dunnett
reviews.text: Mikele is a breath of fresh air, attentive and engaging. We have enjoyed his work and time always with a brilliant smile. A big addition to a wonderful experience. It was a pleasure meeting you this week, hope to see you next year! Tammy & Bill Dunnett

reviews.author: Heisam Allam
reviews.text:
Once again, another memorable trip and stay at Paradisus Cancun. First time back since renovation reopening and as always, it was a magical stay!
We stay on the Reserve side and were excited to see the updates throughout the resort but more importantly were excited to see the staff that came back. Our amazing experience is curated by so many of the staff that are always so lovely, they are professional, attentive and caring. Diego, a supervisor there, is hands down one of the nicest people on Earth. Diego is beyond caring and very professional, took care of any of our needs. Diego is the best! The staff at Sante/Reserve Pool, from pre-renovation staff to new employees are all super special and great people to us that show so much care and love. The staff that we know for years need major shout outs, Cesar, Julio, Yamil, Javier, David, and Victor. Everytime we go they treat us with so much care. This time around we met new staff that are cut from the same cloth, professional, sweet, vibrant and attentive. Shout out to Cynthia, Gemma, Valeria, and the new pool staff Mikele. Our concierge Galdino is so awesome, he is knowledgeable of the resort and surrounding areas, he takes care of our every need, he is available to us at all times, he definitely made our stay so much easier and relaxing.
The resort is amazing and beautiful, but the thing that keeps us coming back is the amazing staff.
The special activities/entertainment staff all came on board with the reopening but they fall right into place, as if they have worked there for years. They are very charismatic, fun and entertaining. Jesus, Uriel, and the rest of the staff, definitely set the tone during activities and classes to get everyone involved and have fun. They are awesome!
One of the major changes that happened was that our beloved Nespresso bar moved from being the center point when you enter from the beach/pool side, to having its own location on the same floor a few feet away. While we are bias and loved how the Nespresso bar was the first thing you saw when entering Tower 3 illuminated and cheerful, we do also enjoy that it has its own location along with the addition of the ice cream parlor.
