Along with the location of rhe old Nespresso bar being right in the middle with the smell of coffee and illuminating the walkway, Alejandro, the barista there is what made every morning with his infectious personality and loving demeanor. Alejandro is amazing and he is surrounded by nee staff that are just as approachable and nice, showing that they enjoy what they do, Norma, Rosalinda, Karina, Perla, all amazing!

reviews.author: Jamie K
reviews.text: Capella at Paradisus Cancun is a must have dinner spot! Snag your reservation here early in your stay! Our server Edgar was wonderful, impressed by their speedy service, ambiance and everything we ordered was delicious! The kids can many things to enjoy here, the Cesar salad, fettuccini Alfredo with chicken, wood fired pizza, tomato soup and chicken Parmesan! Yum! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Darryl Franklin
reviews.text: A wonderful experience! The first time at paradisus and very happy with my choice. Blueagave has a wonderful crew including our waiter Atilano, chef Vanessa, and chef Isobel. Thanks for the experience!

reviews.author: Ashley Caffrey
reviews.text: Miguel, lucas, Teresita and chef Ivan were amazing! Best dinner we had, Miguel went over and beyond for our anniversary. They were so sweet and to the chef, amazing food thank you!

reviews.author: Gillie R
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun after their reopening. We were Family Concierge and our concierge, Eduardo Mena was really great. He waited at the hotel to greet us personally even though we arrived very late. When we got to our hotel room, Eduardo had decorated it with balloons to celebrate birthdays. We also had a bottle of wine waiting for us with fruit and then had a cake sent to our room the next evening. Eduardo was there to help us with anything we needed and also responded immediately.

Overall, the hotel is beautiful but we had some issues with a leak in our hotel room on the last day that we did not know about. The food was also ok… not great. I would 100% recommend Eduardo as your concierge though.

reviews.author: Tyler D
reviews.text:
Our fourth stay at Paradisus Cancun—and somehow it just keeps getting better.
We had an amazing time from start to finish. Having stayed here multiple times (including once on the Family Concierge side), we already had high expectations, and this trip absolutely delivered. The food was consistently very good, the rooms were comfortable and well-kept, and the overall atmosphere continues to strike that perfect balance between relaxing and upscale. But what truly sets this resort apart is the staff—they don’t just provide service, they create unforgettable experiences.
Galdino, our concierge, was exceptional. His attentiveness made the entire trip seamless and stress-free. He handled everything for us—restaurant reservations, Bali bed bookings, and regular check-ins throughout the day to make sure we had everything we needed. This isn’t our first time working with him, and honestly, he’s a big reason we keep coming back. We would only return if we knew we had him—he’s that good.
At Aqua Marina, Juan took great care of our family. He was friendly, attentive, and made every meal enjoyable. It’s service like his that turns a simple dinner into a memorable experience.
Mornings were always brightened by Alejandro and Perla at the café. Their warm welcome each day set the tone perfectly, and they made some of the best coffee we’ve had at any resort. You can tell they genuinely care about guests—it shows in every interaction.
By the pool, Rodrigo, Ana, and Guadalupe were incredible. They were constantly checking in, making sure we had drinks, and keeping the energy fun and relaxed. They made our pool days effortless and enjoyable.
And in the evenings, Flora at the Ginger Bar stood out. She and her team created such a welcoming atmosphere, and the drinks were fantastic. She was kind, engaging, and made everyone feel right at home.
Overall, this was another outstanding stay. We would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun—especially the Reserve side—for any family or couple looking for a relaxing, high-quality, and truly memorable vacation. The people here make all the difference, and it’s why we’ll keep coming back

reviews.author: Michelle Llanes
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed Friday through Tuesday. We were in room 5006, which was the ground floor on the Adults Only Reserve side. We had a view of the ocean and were steps away from walking outside to the pool area. Our room was large with a king size bed, sofa, table/chairs, walk-in shower, soaker tub, and outdoor patio area equipped with double lounger bed and a table and chairs. The room was clean and comfortable. Our butler, Isle, was wonderful and we utilized WhatsApp to communicate with her. All staff, waiters, bartenders, concierge, we encountered were extremely nice, patient, and kind. We had the perfect weather and ate dinner at the reservation only restaurants each evening (Sal Steakhouse, Cappella Italian & Blue Agave). Only three issues occurred and two were addressed and corrected immediately: the faucet on the tub was not connected correctly and shot off when we turned on the water; maintenance had the issue resolved quickly: at the adults only pool, a guest decided to blare their music on a portable speaker which definitely took away from the calm and peaceful vibes this area markets and we had experienced the day before; we spoke discreetly with the pool manager and the person was asked to turn down their music; the person obliged and we were back to listening to the tranquil ocean waves again. The 3rd issue was on our last morning, we had planned to sleep in and enjoy a late brunch before checking out; well the lawn maintenance staff started with their weed-eater at 7:45 am! And it did not stop for more than an hour. That, was really our only complaint with our stay. Our goal was to soak in the sun, enjoy the beautiful ocean, and relax and we accomplished that 1000%.

Xochilt at Blue Agave was an amazing server today. Service was prompt. She was attentive to our requests, and she was just a very nice person. The food was delicious too!

Roger was fantastic at Sal Steakhouse. Very attentive, informative and patient with us. And he just has a very charismatic personality. The picana and salmon were our favorites!

reviews.author: Amy Milo
reviews.text:
Loved this resort!!  The  hotel is  beautiful and has a wonderful spa scent.  We had a separate check in area as we booked through expedia with champagne and snacks. The
staff was really friendly and helpful.  The pool and beach areas are gorgeous. The entire resort is extremely clean and the food was great.  Our room was sometimes cleaned twice a day.  I highly recommend this resort!!

reviews.author: Ofelia Sanchez
reviews.text:
Such an AMAZING experience.  The hotel is beautiful and the food is delicious.  The staff is super friendly and are so accommoding. Restaurant reservations take a long time, but Lemon Fish was so worth it.  Our waiter, Abraham was super nice and due to my indecisiveness recommended a family style with their best dishes (this is the best way to go).

Our room was nice but when taking a shower the water leaks through the walls and you can see the mold built up.  I am still here so let's see how quickly they can fix this issue.

reviews.author: Cin Pani
reviews.text:
We came to celebrate my sister in laws 40th Birthday at Paradisus Cancun " The Reserve" adult only side and we can't say enough great things about our stay.
From having our own concierge  Named Manuel who was incredible, from the moment we arrived, we were greeted with a warm and friendly welcome,  He was extremely attentive. He made all our Reservations for restaurant, boat cruise, greeted us with messages every morning and evening  with his schedule for the day. I requested a cake for my sister which he gladly accommodated us with. We had fruit and wine to welcome us and strawberries and champagne as a good bye. The room was spacious, clean, and beautiful, with stunning views of the ocean.
Stocked mini fridge every day with drinks, tray of snacks also daily filled. 24 hour room service.
The buffet food was excellent , they had something for everyone and they had many varieties. We loved the lemon fish restaurant it's fusion and Peruvian food was worth the hype. You must make reservations because it books quickly. The drinks throughout the resort were great and so was the service at the pool.  everyone so friendly and attentive. The beach was so clean and clear. You can expect the same service there. Drinks and food can be ordered no need to rush you always find beach chairs to lounge.
The resort's amenities were fantastic, when you book the reserve side it comes with a sunset Cruise and hydrotherapy spa which did wonders for us. We had the sauna, vapor room, cold plunge, it was magical.
We would highly recommend The Reserve Paradisus Cancun to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable vacation!

reviews.author: Nathan Walker
reviews.text:
Amazing experience. All the employees were very accommodating. The masseuse Tanya gave a great amount of pressure. Felt very good. Very relaxing as well at times and fell asleep because it was so relaxing.
Abraham,Javier and Karina from ginger 2 better than every bartender and treats everybody the same. He is very knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Keshav Gidugu
reviews.text: Great hotel, had a fantastic time. Special shout out to Berla  at rhe ice cream bar.

reviews.author: Marshall Eisenberg
reviews.text: Brand new remodel opened April 1, 2026. Great for families as well as the Adult Only Reserve section.

reviews.author: malcyy
reviews.text:
10/10 Adults-Only Resort Experience

My girlfriend and I just got back from a week-long stay in the adults-only reserve area, and it was an incredible experience. We had a couple of minor issues during the first couple of days, but once we met Enrique, our concierge, everything changed for the better. Enrique went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect for us, from celebrating our anniversary with special in-room desserts, booking restaurant reservations to getting Bali beds—he really turned our trip into something special.

One of the highlights was the catamaran cruise, which we hadn’t done during our stay last year. The live jazz musician on the boat made it such a unique and fun experience, and we were thrilled it was included in the reserve package. Overall, the resort was just as peaceful and beautiful as we remembered, with clean beaches, amazing pools, and great food everywhere we went.

I also want to give a special shout-out to the incredible staff that made our trip unforgettable: Cynthia for pool activities and Spanish lessons, Oscar, Miguel and Victor for serving us at the pool, David for organizing our cabana, and Valeria, Javier, Josue, and Miguel at Sante Restaurant who made breakfast a highlight of our mornings.

From the friendly bellboys to the front desk staff, everyone at the resort made sure we had an amazing time. We’ll definitely be back again, and we can’t wait to see the same friendly faces after the renovations!

reviews.author: Kasey Swanstrom
reviews.text: Karina and Javier from ginger bar served and maintained the best service I’ve ever seen. 5 star

reviews.author: Rex Vazquez
reviews.text:
Had a great experience at this hotel. Great food, entertainment and location.
One of the highlights of the trip was Esmeralda with the entertainment team. She was friendly, full of energy and had great chemistry with the team, engaging with activities around the pool every day.
I suggest making reservations for the Lemon Fish restaurant as soon as you get to the hotel. Best restaurant in the area!

reviews.author: Courtney Perczak
reviews.text: Incredible resort for our honeymoon! The vibes, the service, the pool, the beach - all impeccable! We stayed in the adults-only Reserve section and it was absolutely worth it! Every single restaurant was delicious! Melvin (at the Capella restaurant) was amazing - he was so kind & provided exceptional service during our time there! And our concierge, Manuel, took great care of us the entire time! Can’t wait to visit again!

reviews.author: Bruce Stewart
reviews.text:
Had a great time spending a week long vacation at Paradisus Cancun.  The interior of the hotel and the food was better than we were anticipating.  Staff was very kind, helpful, and attentive.

Anabel at Flora was an exceptional waitress.  The food was fresh, light, and delicious.

Abraham and Carina from Ginger were excellent.  The Tequila and Mezcal tasting were top notch and I learned a lot about the local drinks.

Daniel the entertainment coordinator was great.  He planned fun activities everyday and we really enjoyed his energy.

Hotel was a bit dated (however they are going to renovate at the end of May for a year) and the pool looked like it needed to be filled up with more water.

reviews.author: Jaime Davis
reviews.text: Alfredo at Kanna Beach Club provided awesome service and made sure we were all taken care of.

reviews.author: River Houck
reviews.text: Uriel, Mau, and Jesus were a lot fun in the pool activities. Would recommend him and the resort!

reviews.author: Elvira Uka
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin, so glad a friend recommended this resort and it was a great experience. From the time we walked in we felt welcomed and cared for from all the resort staff. Special shout out to two of the best Malva buffet employees Bernardo and Pascual they made our time there so special every time we went to the buffet so professional, polite, caring and so much more.
The waiters at the pool amazing as well always checking in and making sure we were all good, greeting you every time they saw you.
Would 💯 % go back and recommend to family and friends.

reviews.author: Tom and Lori Bruggemann
reviews.text:
Wonderful vacation! We had exceptional service from Carlos Quintero at the swim up pool bar. He was very friendly and made the best drinks!! We hope he is still there next time we go back.

Food was delicious with great service.

reviews.author: Jean-Pierre Rumbea
reviews.text: The Paradisus in Cancun was absolutely amazing all around. 10/10 recommend to come to this resort. The service was out of this world and a special shoutout to Esme!! Her energy is absolutely contagious. From the moment you meet her, she makes you feel like you’ve been friends forever. She’s the kind of person who turns a great vacation into an unforgettable one. Paradisus is lucky to have someone like her on their team!

reviews.author: Miss Sandy
reviews.text:
Great resort but it’s the staff who make it 5/5! The resort needs updating and there should be an entertainment area for adults only at night in the Reserve area (live music, etc). There was also a brown cockroach in my shower otherwise I would have given better reviews for the facility.

But it’s the amazing staff who make this resort a great place to stay!! They are 5/5+!

Had a lovely birthday trip and can't say enough about how great the staff are. I stayed at the Reserve (adult only) and it was fantastic. Enrique was my Concierge and was outstanding. He was so thoughtful for my birthday and his communication every day was excellent (even on his day off!).

Flora was my favourite restaurant and Cinthia (and her best friend female server) were also outstanding. Fanny made me feel so welcome each time and chef Jose cooks amazing food! The two ladies at the Reserve pool area (Gabby and the other lady) were also excellent. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jase Villaverde
reviews.text: The Cappella restaurant was very great! We ate delicious food. I especially loved the cheesecake and the carbonara. Our waiter was fabulous as well. He was so kind and everything came fairly quickly. His name was Claudio. If you get him as your waiter you’ll be  in for a wonderful dinner! Overall this was a great time, we even came two of our seven days in Paradisus.

reviews.author: Peter Knox
reviews.text:
This is such a great hotel with such amazing persons . A special thanks to Diego for setting the example to the team he is such a genuine gentleman with alot of respect and hospitality ,  thanks to christian for helping my wife eand i through our stay he is very humble and helpful with alot fo respect. Also Cynthia  Fanny  recommend some of the best tasting food at flora restaurant.
Omar is very humble and welcoming.
I can’t wait to return next year 😎😎😎😎.

reviews.author: Priya V
reviews.text:
Our stay in Mexico was absolutely amazing! The Paradise cancun resort was truly a highlight – the atmosphere was beautiful, and the service was top-notch. Every part of our experience, from the rooms to the food service, was excellent. The meals were not only delicious but also served with great care and patience.

We also had a wonderful time dining at Cappela restaurant. Our waiter, Jesús, went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. He was attentive, kind, and served all our dishes exactly as we ordered. Everything we tried was so flavorful and fresh.

Overall, the hospitality, food, and service throughout our stay made this an unforgettable experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: RaLynda Cook
reviews.text: Arce did a fantastic job waiting on us. He was on top of every request

reviews.author: Nora Ayala
reviews.text: Sound bath is amazing the team was so supportive Jesus,Giovany,Uriel,mauricio so relaxing

reviews.author: Amy Williams-Scott
reviews.text: Jorge at Lemon Fish was Amazing as our server. I have lots of food restrictions and he made me feel heard and cared for. Zero contamination problems. Overall a lovely experience

reviews.author: D. William Dodds
reviews.text: Armando was fantastic!  Offered good choices. Took such good care of us.

reviews.author: Steve Torres
reviews.text: Great place the Ginger bar  2 had great bartenders. Javier,Karina , and Carlos were awesome every time we ended up stepping in the ginger lounge Javier even made us a special cocktail excellent customer service. Carlos from blue agave was really awesome as well and Angel  from Malva buffet is a really great cook and was super friendly and had excellent customer service he made us feel welcome every-time he literally went up and above for us. Guellermo was also really great. First time in Cancun but definitely will come back to Paradisus because of the customer services and  how polite and awesome the staff is.

reviews.author: Shawn Oakes
reviews.text: My family has breakfast every morning in the Restaurant "Flora".   We are greeted by the best two servers every morning.   Jorge Sanchez and Bernardo!    These two are so friendly and attentive.   They are always smiling and happy.   The service was fantastic.   It's a great way to start our day.   Thank you so much to Jorge and Bernardo!!!! Abraham, Karina, Jeremy and the supervisor Samantha are fantastic bartenders!!!  They make amazing cocktails and are so friendly...ginger bar.

reviews.author: Zumeira H
reviews.text:
My friend and I had such a great time here! The service was excellent. Everyone was so kind and friendly. The food was also amazing, we had so many choices. The beach and the pools had access to bars or poolside service. There were activities and performances every night, and all of them different from one another. Overall, everything was wonderfully pleasant.
Some people who helped make our stay even more special were:
- Patricia and Guillermo from the Malva restaurant.
- Uriel, the activities coordinator for Zumba
- Karina, Abraham, and Javier from Ginger Bar

reviews.author: Bishal Sarmat
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Ginger Bar thanks to the outstanding service from Abraham, Javier, and Karina! From the moment I walked in, they made me feel welcome with their friendly energy and top-notch hospitality. Their drink-making skills are on another level—perfectly crafted cocktails with great attention to detail. They were also super knowledgeable about the menu and gave great recommendations.

Whether you’re looking for a chill night out or a lively atmosphere, this team ensures you have a fantastic time. Highly recommend stopping by and experiencing their incredible service firsthand!

reviews.author: MARÍA FERNANDA MENOSCAL IZQUIERDO.
reviews.text:
So far we are having a wonderful stay at this all-inclusive hotel.
The place is just wonderful, our rooms have a great view. The beach is turquoise  and the pool is just perfect!
The restaurants range from good to excellent! Our best food experience has been at the Lemon Fish. Our waiters Jorge and Miguel were wonderful, especially Jorge who managed to bring the best plates, it is like he discovered our tastes!

reviews.author: Sheenagh Resendes
reviews.text: Alberto was very friendly and provided excellent service during our dinner!

reviews.author: Dev Sharma
reviews.text: Great resort for family. We had a fantastic time at this place. Pools are abundant, and there is a lot of options for food. We loved Malva restaurant as it has a lot of variety of food. The kids' program at Kidsdom is really helpful if you want to have some time by yourself. There is a lot of activities for families, and each amenity is top notch. There is room for improvement in some restaurants in terms of service, primarily Blue Agave and Capella. The shows should have a layer start time as they start at 7 pm or 8 pm, which is the dinner time for most people. We hope to come back soon!

reviews.author: Alyssa Lakner
reviews.text: Jose at Capella is excellent, along with the food . Roger at Sal’s Steakhouse was incredible. Our concierge,  Daniel is beyond helpful and took great care of us. Great resort with no complaints!

reviews.author: Christian Navarrete
reviews.text: This place was more than amazing. I'm glad I chose this hotel. This was our first time in Cancun and we ended up staying an extra night. The building needs some updates but regardless it's a breathtaking building. Service is top notch. Food was amazing, drinks were great. Made us feel like a VIP the whole week. Beach is amazing btw. Special shoutout to Armando Candelario at the Malva Buffet Restaurant. He was our first encounter and offer the best service ! Amazing human being I hope to see him soon again when they finish remodeling the place next year.

reviews.author: Lila
reviews.text:
Food and services at the Agua Marina are incredible. Thanks to El Diablo, Juan, Sergio and Martin for the lunch and the Mezcal 101 course.

We ate at the Cielo. The good was very good and the service too. Thanks to Lucas for this very good moment.

The staff is very doing his best to make us enjoy our vacation

Update on 10 march : just ate at the Capella with my family and had another good dinner and excellent service. Jose Cahua was our waiter and did an excellent job to make us enjoy the moment. Thanks you very much. Merci beaucoup!!!

Update on match 11 : the Nespresso café si a must un morning. The ever smiling Alejandro Pitcardo is always ready to greet you and suggest you a good coffee to start the day. Thanks Alejandro !!!

reviews.author: Andrea Maleu
reviews.text:
We love Paradisus! We want to thank everyone that made our stay so wonderful. The beach is beautiful, the service exceptional, the hotel accommodations are great, and the food is amazing!

The moment we arrived we were greeted by Raul who made us feel so welcome! We then met our concierge Enrique who went over and beyond to make our stay memorable! Each day he checked in with us, shared activities, and surprised us with unforgettable experiences.

Lastly, Miguel at Sante bar was so wonderful he even bid us farewell with beautiful cocktails at the beach. We are so grateful for all the friends we met and hope to see Paradisus soon again!

reviews.author: Parth Patel
reviews.text:
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun, we had the pleasure of dining at Cielo, and it was truly one of the highlights of our trip. The ambiance was beautiful, the food was flavorful and artfully presented, but what really elevated the experience was the exceptional service.

We were lucky to have Moises as our server, and he went above and beyond to make us feel welcome and cared for. His attentiveness, genuine kindness, and professionalism were unmatched. He took the time to explain the menu, made thoughtful recommendations, and checked in regularly to ensure everything was perfect. You can truly tell he takes pride in what he does, and it made our dining experience feel incredibly special.

The entire serving team was friendly and efficient, but Moises stood out as someone who made our night unforgettable. Thank you for the amazing service, delicious food, and warm hospitality. We can’t wait to return!

reviews.author: Sandra Alonso
reviews.text: This place was amazing! We met Jorge from lemon fish one day attempting to take pictures in their restaurant area because the setting is beautiful. We weren’t looking to eat that night, but he welcomed us and immediately introduced himself and even told us about the menu. We tried to come back the next day, but the wait was too long. The following day we finally got a table and guess who served us? Jorge! And he was amazing! Super attentive, gave us tips on the menu and made us the best natural fruit mixed drinks a girl could ask for!! Gracias Jorge!!

reviews.author: Tammy Truong
reviews.text: I had a great time at Lemon Fish! Our waiter Jorge and Miguel were super helpful and friendly. The chef Mario and David delivered exceptional food. Everything was delicious and I would have seconds if I could :) …except for the ramen. Portion sizes were perfect for tasting. Carlos our bartender made a great spicy margarita and other cocktails that our group enjoyed. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Hunter Sutton
reviews.text: Jorge from Lemonfish was the best waiter I’ve ever had! He was incredibly attentive, funny, friendly, and made sure all of our need taken care of. I couldn’t recommend him more!

reviews.author: Maridel Nirosky
reviews.text: Karina,yeremi,dereck and javier from ginger 2 was amazing!! I recommend seeing them when you get here.

reviews.author: Sarah Sharpe
reviews.text:
Our family of 4 (2 adults and 2 kids) stayed in late November. We had a family concierge suite which gave us access to Sergio, our family concierge. He helped make sure we got checked in, had everything we needed in our room, knew what activities were available and got us booked for our dinner reservations.

Our room was clean, had a great view and everything we needed. It was a bit loud some evenings if there was a band/music. The beds were quite small, two average size adults had a tough time sharing.

The food was outstanding. Lemon fish was our favourite, so food we were able to go twice. Lots of choice at the buffet, the kids enjoyed room service. The seafood restaurant had the BEST lunch.

The kids club staff was lovely. It took us a few days to figure out that there were multiple locations for activities outside of Kidsdom itself (kids pool, palapa, beach). The kids had a great time.

Beach was great, serving staff were great in all the restaurants and bars. We loved the coffee bar too.

Thanks for a wonderful vacation

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.text: Ate at vibra tonight and the service was amazing… see Mario for the best experience ever!

reviews.author: Richelle Pilato
reviews.text: Lemon fish was an amazing top to our vacation. Miguel was the best waiter we’ve ever had. The wine selection was superb. His suggestions were spot on. We were so full even with our small plates, but the caramel ice cream dessert was to die for. Ginger bar the best place. Gaby,Karina and Abraham best team and The best cocktails 🍹 you can find in the hotel.

reviews.author: anisha patel
reviews.text:
Our group of 27 had the most incredible time at Hotel Paradisus Mexico Cancun, and we can't praise the resort and its staff enough. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warm smiles and outstanding service, setting the tone for a fantastic stay.

A special thank you to Angel and the wonderful Malva staff who went above and beyond to make my mother-in-law's birthday truly special. They surprised us with a beautiful birthday cake that made the celebration even more memorable. Their attention to detail and genuine care made us feel so valued.

The food throughout our stay was absolutely delicious, offering a variety of options that catered to everyone's tastes. Whether we were dining at one of the restaurants or enjoying a meal by the pool, the quality and presentation were consistently excellent.

Speaking of the pool, the staff there were amazing, ensuring that all our needs were met. Whether it was refreshing drinks, comfortable seating, or just a friendly chat, they made our time by the pool a highlight of our trip.

Overall, our stay at Paradisus was perfect in every way. The combination of luxurious amenities, delicious food, and exceptional staff made this a vacation to remember. We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Amira Deumic
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at the Paradisus Cancun and we cannot wait to be back!! This resort had everything we looked for. The service was amazing, the food exceptional and we had an over all great experience here. Our kids loved it and Roberto at the pool took great care of us. He stopped so many times throughout the day to check up on us and make sure we had everything we needed. Kids loved how attentive and caring he was. We also loved loved loved Carlos at the Malva food Bazaar. He always greeted us with a smile on his face. Big props to all the staff who keep the place running so smoothly.

reviews.author: Samuel Gamez
reviews.text: Our overall experience has been beyond fantastic at this resort. Between the views and the service staff it’s been the greatest vacation I’ve ever had. The perfect date night is defined at “Lemon Fish”. Between the Server Jorge, the chefs Karen and Mario, and the mixologist Charles and Chava, I feel like this experience will be something my wife and I remember for the rest our lives. I am absolutely coming back to this resort again.

reviews.author: Amanda Sykes
reviews.text: Have thoroughly been enjoying our visit. All of the staff are friendly and warm. We just had a delicious Italian dinner at Copella's. Our server Jose Cahun was exceptionally friendly and attentive. Highly recommend this resort, restaurant and server.

reviews.author: Kyle Davison
reviews.text: Great experience! We have been to the Paradisus four times now and have enjoyed each time. Our Reserve concierge (Enrique) was great and very kind and helpful. We thoroughly enjoyed all of the food options and pool-side cabanas. Our server at Lemon Fish (Ernesto) was very good and kind and great to have. Will definitely come back in the future.

reviews.author: Brahsky
reviews.text:
Um wow!  Where do I start?  This is my second time at Paradissus with my sweet pea and I am so glad I came back.

This is the last night and this evening sweet pea and I were blessed to have our last meal at Lemon Fish where we were lucky to be served by Jorge!  Jorge is a 10/10 and a true professional.  On top of all that he is such a hard worker and want to make the experience the very best for the guest.  Mission accomplished pal.  Thank you!

Frankly I had the same experience at every restaurant.  Auga Marina was terrific.  Huge thks to my guy Senior Martin, Carlos and Roberto.

One of the best parts of the vacay was seeing Pascal from the main buffet (I think malva).  We first met Pascal 7 years ago and we laughed because we still have breakfast.  Huge tip here: ask for Pascal because that fella is the very best.  Pascal, you are a true professional and represent the company well.  Bottom line is you make people want to return!

Lastly, I want to say, that if any readers are considering the Reserve option...DO IT! Oh boy was it the best.  The service and dedication from the pool staff is remarkable.  Frankly, my wife and I were floored by the concierge, Rossana, our Reserve concierge.  Everyday, she message us and helped everyday be the 💯 best that it could be.  To all readers and bosses of this resort, this lady made every effort possible to make our stay memorable.  Ask for Rossana, you will be happy you did!

Ok, this is a lot.  Thks paradissus and see you after the renovations!

reviews.author: ebelzince
reviews.text:
Excellent service!  My servers, Jorge and Carlos, at Lemon Fish went above and beyond to make our dinner experience a memorable one. The y made great suggestions and they were very courteous and accommodating. Paradisus Cancun Resort should be very proud of these servers. Also Carlos the bartender made us exceptional drinks. All I can say is WOW!

I will be back with my family for another vacation stay.

reviews.author: Nafia Khan
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at paradisus cancun!! Veronica, manager relations of Meliá, made our stay special and memorable. She fixed any issues she had, was sympathetic, personable and extremely kind! We had the best time doing a couples massage and hydrotherapy at the spa. Boris is the manager at Lemon fish (Japanese fusion restaurant) and he also made our experience one of a kind with the service he gave us. He was just like a friend to us, always helped us out with reservations and introduced us to the head chef who is incredible there. The decor of this restaurant is stunning and so too is the food. We had the most phenomenal dessert there made specially that evening and we really have to thank Boris for his fantastic personality, we really hope to meet him again!! Fanny at the Flora restaurant is extremely kind and warm, she also helped us out with reservations here at this healthy restaurant. We loved the food and decor at flora - the tomato soup and salmon were excellent and the environment is truly enchanting. The Nespresso bar was another favourite of ours, we visited this as many times a day as we could because the coffee is incredible here and the service is extremely fast and nice. There is a reason the queue is always so long for the Nespresso bar (since it’s so delicious including all the fresh desserts they have - we are not even dessert people but we could not resist), and yet you’re never left waiting very long at all! The pools are so much fun here  and if you can get a Bali bed (we had one with a view of the beach), you will have the most relaxing and comfortable day. Even sitting on the beach chairs was wonderful - no seaweed in the water but the sea was rough! You have to go early in the day to get seats. The aquamarina restaurant is by the pool and it has the best shrimp tacos, nice dinner options too. The pizza bar and ice cream bar are also wonderful as pool-side snacks. We also loved the pool-side bar for fresh lemonade and mojitos! We had one bad waiter at the blue agave restaurant near Malva as he was quite rude but then all the other waiters and chefs were wonderful at breakfast and dinner. Malva is the buffet restaurant and the food is sub-standard (breakfast, lunch, dinner) but it is reliable. I would recommend you to try the restaurants when you can because the food is almost always better. We also had a bad experience with one waiter at Capella as we were sat at our table late (we had to wait a while) and then nobody came to take our order or serve us water for half an hour afterwards. The food was pretty good but it did take a while to come. The gym is also really nice here - most of the time we went (in the evening) it was empty, clean and well-equipped. Overall, this resort is lively and beautiful. Highly recommend this resort for the most memorable, magical stay!!!

reviews.author: Kelley
reviews.text:
Gracias Charli, Gladys,and Irina
Service was fast friendly and WE appreciate you.

Special shoutout to Enrique our concierge who provided us with daily updates, reservations at restaurants organized us to experience the sunset Catarmaran and made John’s birthday extra memorable with special treats in our room.

Alexandro at Lemon Fish was exceptional sharing knowledge and experience with local tequilas.

Alexandro at the espresso bar gave us a warm smile and welcoming feel every morning when grabbing our cappuccino and Americanos.

The staff at the reserve pool surprised us with a birthday song and cake for my man. Well done!

Also awesome: the food, cleanliness everywhere, all staff, beautiful areas, and the beach.
We hope to visit again after the renovations.
Johnny and Kelley

reviews.author: Carla Rodriguez
reviews.text: Luis was our bartender and he was absolutely amazing everything we expected for the reserve adults only section . We had a little too much fun celebrating my bachelorette . Miguel who worked at the restaurant  Sante was THE FREAKING  BEST he helped us reserved the Cabana and  we had a blast on our last day, he’s amazing he even helped my friend in a wheelchair  live her best life …can’t recommend him enough!! The service Miguel gave at both Sante and the Cabana was unbelievable . He is The best and MOST helpful employee at this place !to be willing to carry someone when they are unable to is unlike any other resort . Lastly Francisco at Sante is exactly the type of people who you want running your customer service and restaurants. He brings all the energy  ! Would recommend this place.

reviews.author: michael sanchez
reviews.text: Everything was outstanding Daniel did a great job and Carlos was on top of everything

reviews.author: Tanya Roof
reviews.text:
I’m writing this review while sitting in the airport waiting for my flight to return home. My husband and I had an amazing time at Paradisus!!!!! Every staff member was kind, friendly, helpful and fun! Our concierge, Lalo, was top notch!

My best food recommendation is while vacationing in Mexico, eat the Mexican food and you will not be disappointed! We didn’t love the Italian restaurant but we also live in CT where we have the best Italian food outside of Italy.

We stayed in Mexico for 9 days and 5 of those were spent at Paradisus. We upgraded to the adults only side. One of the many perks of the adults only reservation is that you receive 2 days in the Bali beds! I highly recommend using this perk. We received nonstop service with food and drinks.

Also included with our stay was a sunset cruise. The music on the boat and energy of the staff was infectious!

All in all we’re sad to be leaving because we had the best time EVER! 5 stars!!!!!

reviews.author: Ernesto Magana
reviews.text: Javier,Karina,Flor y humberto from ginger 1 cant thank these people enough went above and beyond! What a great time it was 😁

reviews.author: Lina Mokhtari
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort at the end of October and the beginning of November, and even though this review is a bit late, I can’t stop thinking about how great it was! The resort itself was amazing, but honestly, what made it super special was the staff. They were so friendly and really made it a place we want to come back to.

The food was incredible! Lemon Fish was really good (special thanks to Jesus!), but Agua Marina completely blew us away. It wasn’t just the best resort food I’ve had—it’s up there with the best food I’ve ever eaten in my life! Every meal was delicious, and the flavors were just insane.

What made it even better was the team at Agua Marina. Martin and his crew were so awesome—super nice, helpful, and professional. I also want to give a huge thank-you to Erick, Sergio, and Wilbert for being so kind and attentive. They really went above and beyond, and we appreciated it so much.

We’re 100% coming back! The resort was great, but the people, the service and the food made it unforgettable. Can't wait to visit again!

reviews.author: Travis Osborne
reviews.text: Very welcoming and helpful. Edgar is great!

reviews.author: PRAGNESH PATEL
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is one of the best resorts we've ever stayed at! The rooms are spacious, spotless, and beautifully designed with breathtaking ocean views. The food is incredible, offering a variety of cuisines with top-notch quality. The pools are pristine, and the amenities, including the spa and activities, are excellent. What truly sets this place apart is the exceptional service from the staff, especially Manager Jesus Miranda, Chef Fnanny, David, and Diego, who went above and beyond for our group of 55 to ensure we had everything we needed. Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, this resort has it all. We can't wait to return and highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Eddie Baisden
reviews.text: We stayed at the paradisus cancun and this was our favorite restaurant. I had rhe octopus as an appetizer...incredible sauce...the rock seafood soup...tomatoey goodness and the squid which had a creme fraische that made it light and good. The sea bass was perfectly cooked with crispy skin and amazing seasoning to go with the mushroom risotto. Everything was fantastico. The service from Wilbur was perfect with great help from Isidro and Jaime. Thank you!

reviews.author: Emma Carruthers
reviews.text:
This was an amazing stay!! The customer service exceeded every expectation. Every staff member greets you with a smile, and you lean to know many by name towards the end of your stay. Cynthia from Cielo and Alejandro at the Nespresso bar deserve extra recognition.
Would definitely stay here again. Thank you Paradisus❤️

reviews.author: Sheri Herman
reviews.text: Agua Marina Restaurant .We ate at this restaurant and it was fantastic. The food was really good. The service was amazing.  Mark and Erick were our servers and they were great. Then much to my husband's delight, along came Kristel with tequila for my husband to finish off his night. The only thing I would change is the risotto was made with barley instead of rice. We would definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Dario Padroni
reviews.text:
We recently spent an incredible week at this all-inclusive resort, and the service truly exceeded all expectations. While the entire staff was consistently professional and attentive, three individuals stood out, taking the experience to a whole new level.

Francisco, with his impeccable professionalism and warm demeanor, made every day at the beach a treat. Whether it was setting up our sunbeds or bringing over a perfectly packed beach basket with everything we needed, he did it all with a smile that instantly brightened our day.

Alejandro, always cheerful and radiating positivity, made every coffee break a joy. Whether it was a cappuccino, a refreshing iced drink, or a decadent slice of cake, he ensured we were well taken care of at any hour. His constant smile and energy were contagious.

Moses, from the Cielo restaurant, gave us an unforgettable dining experience with his expertise in Yucatan specialties. The flavors were exquisite, and his knowledge and passion for the cuisine elevated our meal into something truly memorable.

The overall service at this resort was outstanding, but Francisco, Alejandro, and Moses are in a league of their own. Their dedication and genuine hospitality made this vacation one to cherish. I highly recommend this resort for anyone seeking exceptional service and unforgettable experiences.

reviews.author: Jessica Wallis
reviews.text: Francisco and Claudio gave us the royal treatment at Capella! We had a party of 9 for dinner including 5 children, and they were so attentive to all of us. Quick to refill water, drinks without being asked, and even brought us a special dessert for our last night of vacation. Excellent service to end our vacation!

reviews.author: Sandra Truong
reviews.text: Would come back to Paradisus! The hotel in beautiful, has a beautiful tropical ambience. The main area of the hotel can be a little warmer at times during the day, however the adult only reserve area is well air conditioned. The variety of food is great and quality is consistent. The pools and service are great. The beach is stunning, well maintained and clean. Great choices from a variety of chairs and day beds. The location is prime, with popular spots like Rosa Negra & Confessions across the street. Can’t wait to come back for my next Mexican vacation!

reviews.author: Brittany Buelow
reviews.text: Abraham, Karina  and jeremy at ginger bar . The best ! Excellent service and they are super fun!  We also had fantastic service from Alex at flora restaurant where the food was delicious. Our days were spent at the ocean, pool, and swim up bar where Julio did not disappoint.   Very friendly and a wonderful bartender. We had a blast !

reviews.author: Juliana Rodriguez
reviews.text: The Malva buffet had a great selection of food but what really made it special was the outstanding service provided by the servers especially ARMANDO BALAM and REYNALDO! They were so kind and attentive and took good care of our family every time. Will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Dan Sampsonis
reviews.text: We stayed there for 4 nights with my company. Our concierge Enrique was amazing. Helped up book all our restaurants right when we arrived which helped us be carefree the rest of the trip. Thanks again Enrique!

reviews.author: David Blender
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed for both work and vacation.
The entire experience was problem free with lots of friend staff.
We had the opportunity to stay in the adults only “the reserve” this added to the whole experience.
The pool side and Bali beds were our favourite place to relax.  A special appreciation to Miguel out on the pool side and restaurant.  He was attentive, always remembered day to day.  Fun to talk to and joke around with. Miguel is a true top performer.  Thank you so much!
So many great people who made the trip special.
Our concierge Jose was always helpful even on his day off.
David my “ tocayo” from the pool very friendly and helpful
We met Martin one afternoon at the buffet and his stories and service were hilarious
And Oscar from our front desk at the reserve was yet just another great professional.
Thank you so much , we would love to come back and stay again and hope to see all these amazing people again

reviews.author: Christian Szabo
reviews.text: Alberto was excellent and the resort as a whole is great service overall is perfe

reviews.author: Sondra' Rhodes
reviews.text: Cappella was a wonderful experience. The food satisfied our pallet for Italian. Our waiter Clasdio was attentive and provided great service. The cannoli was phenomenal. A must come see.

reviews.author: Paulina Chávez
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus for Valentine's Day weekend and had an amazing time. The food was phenomenal and the service was amazing in the Reserve. The upcharge was well worth it as a couple who did not want to deal with other people's kids on a romantic vacation. We met really cool people at the Reserve pool and ended up making close friends to keep in touch with. I hear they will close down to remodel soon, but we would definitely consider going back.

reviews.author: Maverick Tebbe
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at the resort with all the different restaurants each night. Thoroughly enjoyed the service from Claudio at Cappellas  with a beautiful view of the water. Jorge at Lemon Fish was also amazing with great recommendations and great service. Highly recommend the tomato soup at Cappellas and Mi Suspiro Limeno / Short rib at Lemon Fish!

reviews.author: Glenn Rowley
reviews.text: Martin and Cristina were great with the aqua therapy treatment. Carmen and Teresita gave us wonderful full body massages. We would definitely come back to the same team.

reviews.author: Alita Gideon
reviews.text:
We had so much fun at our stay in Paradisus! The service was great and all staff was very friendly. The food was some of the best we’ve had and the beach was unbelievable. A special shoutout to Oscar from the entertainment team! He was very enthusiastic and made sure that all activities ran smoothly and included everyone. He also took the time to help out with our bracelet making and ceramic painting. Also another shoutout to Valentina for the wonderful spin classes in the morning!
We would highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Jeffrey
reviews.text: Very good service from our waiter Rudi! All the food was amazing & he explained the preparation and flavor profile of everything so well. Also treated us to his own signature drink creations and helped us celebrate our anniversary with a unique dessert. Most definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: leslie robertson
reviews.text: Our vacation was the absolute best one we’ve ever had. My husband and I said repeatedly that we don’t deserve the amazing treatment we were given! This staff is nothing short of incredible, the food is the best that we’ve ever eaten, and the drinks were strong. Thank you so much to our concierge Jennifer and Violet for the vacation of our dreams ❤️

reviews.author: Trimi Chu
reviews.text: We had a fabulous dinner with great service at Capella! Our server, Jesus Canche was quick and gracious with our large party. The carpaccio and sea bass were our favorite.

reviews.author: Roberto Carreiro
reviews.text: Jesus from Capella restaurant was awesome. He was very kind and helped us choose some fabulous meals. Capella was one of our favourite restaurants at Melia Paradises resort. We came to this restaurant twice during our week.

reviews.author: Gabriela Serrano
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here. The resort itself is so gorgeous, We stayed on the Reserve side. The service was outstanding, all the servers and our Concierge, George were fantastic. George was really great at providing us with information on excursions and booked all of our spa and restaurant reservations promptly. I want to thank and recognize the ladies at the snack bar on the reserve side, Valeria and Gabriela were wonderful. Our servers outside by the cabanas that gave us such great service and kept our drinks coming, Josue, Miguel and Cesar were really sweet and gave attentive service. We appreciated all of them as they made our stay a great one. We can't wait to come back soon.

reviews.author: Yvonne
reviews.text:
Top notch! Beautiful hotel, clean, and you can tell they try very hard to maintain it. Our room was quiet. Staff is very friendly and always smiling. Food was tasty. Buffet and many restaurants to choose from. Aqua Marina restaurant was so good and friendly staff. I was very impressed. Sweeping beachfront!! Not a day we couldn’t find a chair in a shaded area. Also check out one of the cabanas at the Kanna beach club. It’s amazing!
Favorite resort so far for me in Cancun and I would definitely come back and recommend to others! Thank you to Jose May for being our family concierge and making our trip that much more wonderful and relaxing!

reviews.author: Ira Ozer
reviews.text: Jesus provided excellent service and the food was terrific at Kao!

reviews.author: Ivail Pacheco
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Cancún, and I'd like to leave a positive comment about some of the people who served me in the restaurants: Omar and Israel (Vibra) are truly special and very attentive; Rafael, who makes the pasta fresh at the buffet restaurant, is even better than the pasta at the Italian restaurant Capella. Furthermore, I especially want to highlight Armando and Alejandro from the breakfast restaurant; they are magnificent people, very attentive and helpful, and made our experience less frustrating. However, I'll comment on the unpleasant experience we had at check-in: I was literally called a liar by a poorly informed employee regarding a benefit I have as a member of the Melia Rewards club. They didn't listen to me when I arrived to discuss my request, they made light of my needs, and on top of that, I was considered a liar. In addition, the room service is not what it used to be; they leave things unreplenished, don't clean properly, etc., and this is because the hotel's capacity is at 30/40%. Another important point is that they offer you dishes in restaurants that are not included in the purchased package and they don't explain this to you, then after eating comes the surprise with the card machine! When I was here in 2022 I was amazed and that's why I signed up for the club the following year, but for me this network is finished…

reviews.author: Mariangel Garmendia
reviews.text:
Overall, an excellent experience; staying at The Reserve is absolutely worth it. We received outstanding service from our concierge, Rommel, and his colleague, Alejandro.

Joshua at reception was also very attentive and always ready to help us.
The spa was magnificent, and the therapists were incredibly helpful. We also appreciated the excellent service at Sante restaurant and the pool. Many thanks to Karla, Gemma, and especially Cinthia for all their kindness and wonderful service.

reviews.author: Denisse Jimenez
reviews.text:
The Mayan ceremony, the sunset activity, and the dance classes by the pool with Uriel were incredible. He's a guy with a great vibe; you can tell he loves his job and enjoys it, and that energy and good vibe is contagious.

Overall, I loved the hotel. It's super zen, but also peaceful, with a lot of friendliness. The customer service is outstanding, as are the food and drinks, which are far superior to other large resorts.
Ernesto the waiter, Víctor, Horacio, Laura, Israel, etc… were all very kind, understanding, and lovely.
Without a doubt, one of the best places to enjoy a relaxing yet fun and very comfortable vacation.
10/10 in everything. I loved it, and I've stayed in some pretty great hotels :)

reviews.author: ANDRES YEPES
reviews.text: My family and I loved Agua Marina restaurant. From the moment you walk in, you feel a lovely breeze, and the staff is incredibly friendly, offering excellent recommendations for the dishes. Everything was delicious, and our waiter, Jonathan, made the experience unforgettable. We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Diana Gomez
reviews.text: The Paradisiacal Cancun hotel is incredible! I visited the Kao restaurant and spoke with waiter David Rosales, who was super friendly, attentive, and provided outstanding service, always looking out for you. The manager, Boris, is an amazing person; they make you feel right at home! It was unreal—they celebrated my birthday and gave me complimentary items. Honestly, you won't find that kind of welcome anywhere else. Thank you so much because people like him make a hotel a quality place.

reviews.author: Juan Olivieri
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. Outstanding service, personalized attention from every employee in all areas. Excellent and varied meals in all restaurants and the buffet. The room was magnificent, and the cleanliness was exceptional. I must emphasize that Vianney, a waitress in the pool area, is charming, helpful, and incredibly attentive. Employees like her make the hotel a more enjoyable place, not forgetting Edgar, the supervisor. Paradisus Cancun is definitely a place to return to.

reviews.author: Elizet Huerta
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun was incredible, and a large part of that wonderful experience was thanks to Fernanda Trejo, our concierge.

From the very first moment, Fernanda was incredibly kind, professional, and always attentive to our needs. She made sure we had everything we needed to fully enjoy our stay. She always attended to us with a great attitude, a smile, and a tremendous willingness to help.

Something we really want to highlight is that she went far beyond our expectations. I asked her for help finding cosmetic treatments in Cancun, and she recommended one of the best specialists. She also recommended shopping spots and other places that turned out to be the best options.

Fernanda truly made us feel well taken care of, valued, and welcome. Her dedication, attention to detail, and excellent service made our experience even more special.

We recommend her 10000%. Paradisus Cancun is incredibly lucky to have such a dedicated, kind, and professional person on their team.
Just like everyone else who works at Paradisus, they were the best.

Thank you for everything, Fernanda! You made our stay so much more special.

reviews.author: Hogar Danisan
reviews.text: We spent a week at Paradisus Cancun. Our concierge, Joshua, was very attentive, friendly, and always ready to help. We loved the staff's service and were very happy with our experience. We will likely return in the future. It was spectacular; Joshua was an excellent host. Thank you so much for everything.

reviews.author: Brithany Gyssell
reviews.text:
We thoroughly enjoyed the restaurant; every meal was a wonderful experience, and the staff was always incredibly kind and attentive.

We especially want to thank Jair, who was attentive to every detail during our stay. In addition to his excellent recommendations and great attitude, he thoughtfully prepared a special decoration for us, which made our trip even more memorable. This kind of personalized attention truly makes all the difference and demonstrates the high level of service the hotel offers.

reviews.author: Georgina Gonzalez
reviews.text:
Our stay was perfect! Our concierge, Israel, made sure everything was just right! Whenever we needed something, he took care of it! He's amazing!
At the pool, Yeremi took care of us most days! His service is spectacular; he was always making sure we had full drinks and snacks when we needed them. It was fantastic!
The buffet food at breakfast, lunch, and dinner was delicious. At Blue Agave, Armando is a 15 out of 10! He always had a smile on his face. When my daughter's food arrived and the fries were spicy (because of the batter they were fried in), he took care of changing the whole plate! He made our evening very pleasant.

At Kao, Mario was very attentive, and his service was impeccable too!
At Cava, we received excellent service as well!
The ice cream was delicious!!!
At Kidsdom, Esmeralda is great; she has such a positive vibe with the children!
We left more than happy.

The only thing I would recommend is that you do something to control the mosquitoes. Every afternoon/evening we would come back and kill at least 3 to 5 mosquitoes, and I would still wake up covered in bites 😭 Oh, and another thing, the swim-up bar pool is way too deep! You can't walk around comfortably with a drink in your hand 😅

reviews.author: Ana Cristina Sánchez
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for a vacation to see the hotel's renovations. Everything was great. The first night, Cinthya served us at Aguamarina, providing excellent service. We had lunch at Blue Agave, where Armando served us—a very nice, friendly, and efficient person. We also had dinner at Vibra, where Jorge served us. It's a delicious restaurant with Latin American options.

We stayed at The Reserve, and as always, the service was excellent. Our concierge, Carolina, was outstanding—the best we've ever had. She was always attentive, made all our dinner reservations perfectly, sent us daily activity information, and was always on top of our needs. I highly recommend her. Julio was at the bar, providing impeccable service as always. At the Sante restaurant, Gemma, Javier, Cesar, Yamil, and Valeria served us breakfast—a great team, always very kind.

The pool concierges Victor and Horacio were incredibly friendly, and Jesús from the entertainment service provided excellent and original activities.
I injured my foot and received outstanding care; they were always attentive to my recovery. Diego, the manager of The Reserve, and Farideh from Guest Services were very helpful.
We appreciate the excellent service!

reviews.author: Paulina Boy Galindo
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Conciege service.
At Blue Agave, we received exceptional service with a great attitude, prompt attention, and extensive menu knowledge.
Alberto was an excellent waiter! Congratulations!

At Capelle, our waiter Jesús provided us with a fantastic service experience. Everything was delicious!

reviews.author: Sara Delgado
reviews.text:
Everything was amazing! This hotel has it all: a beautiful beach, comfortable and well-equipped rooms, delicious food, and a team that truly goes above and beyond in their attention and service. A special thank you to Manuel at reception for his kindness, advice, and for assigning us the best concierge, Alejandro, who took care of planning our entire stay so we could fully enjoy my birthday.
We will definitely be back soon.

reviews.author: Christina Stallinger
reviews.text:
Excellent service.
At Kao restaurant, Aurelio served us; he was very friendly, and the food was delicious.
The following night, we went to Capella, the Italian restaurant, and we loved it. The veal ossobuco is highly recommended 👌🏼👌🏼. We also received excellent service from our waiter, Edgar.

reviews.author: Mariana RC
reviews.text:
Our vacation at the Paradisus Hotel was wonderful.
We had a great culinary experience at several restaurants:
At Vibra Restaurant, the fish tacos were delicious, and Paolo's service was excellent.
Blue Agave Restaurant has delicious tacos, and some of their servers were very attentive.
The facilities are good, and there's a wide variety of restaurants! Plus, there are several pools and activities.

reviews.author: Yeremi Polanco
reviews.text: Honestly, an amazing hotel. The service was excellent, especially the incense ceremony with Jesús and Mauricio. It was fantastic; they are incredibly friendly and fun. It was one of the most wonderful stays I've ever had, and I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Generosa Gallego Montero
reviews.text:
Jesús was exceptionally kind. We knew nothing about Japanese cuisine, and he guided us step by step through each dish and each flavor, making us appreciate all the charms of this delicious cuisine.

At Cappella Restaurant, we enjoyed an excellent dinner. The best Italian cuisine fused with the best international cuisine. The combination of surf and turf was spectacular. Fernando and JJ make an unbeatable team, perfectly coordinating their knowledge and friendliness. Melvin was constantly attentive to our needs and was especially helpful. The preparation of the desserts tableside is fascinating; you can see how they incorporate the ingredients one by one. José offered us a delicious wine and explained the qualities of each sip. In short, a fantastic experience and an excellent team.

reviews.author: Javier Garita
reviews.text: Excellent experience at Paradisus The Reserve. Impeccable service, beautiful newly renovated rooms, a liquor selection that exceeded expectations, and an unbeatable location very close to the airport and the hotel zone with shopping centers and great nightlife. Highly recommended for its value, service, and location. Special mention to Ilse from Concierge, who made our stay very easy, always available to help and coordinate anything we needed.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: I stayed for 10 days and the service was absolutely incredible, so friendly, the dinners were amazing, and the activities were super fun. The best part was the Gastro Hall restaurant and its staff, especially Martin Kü Can, David Rodriguez, and Captain Nayeli. A really great place!

reviews.author: Laura Elvira
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is always a delight. The location near the airport and the hotel zone, the food, the activities available with Aquaworld, and above all, the service. Our stays are always remembered for the kindness and warmth of the staff. This stay was especially wonderful thanks to César and Yamil, who took such good care of us and pampered us at the pool and restaurant in the Reserve. Violeta, the chef, was fantastic with her food, especially for a pregnant woman craving all the delicious and fresh flavors of Mexican cuisine. At the end of our stay, we felt a pang of sadness at leaving, but also immense joy at having been able to rest, enjoy ourselves, and meet these wonderful people. They work incredibly hard, yet they always do it with love and a smile on their faces that fills the air with positivity. Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: cavosarquitectos1000 Salas
reviews.text:
We loved the hotel. From the moment we arrived, everyone treated us wonderfully. Venecia and Mario at the KAO restaurant were incredibly kind and helpful. The food was delicious and varied, and the hotel offered a wide range of activities.

We appreciated that the Kids Club was open practically all day with a variety of activities.

The rooms were very well-maintained, and the pillows were amazing.

The Kids Club service was fantastic. They were very friendly with the children, and Vianey, along with the entire Kids Club activities team, took excellent care of them.

I appreciated that they always kept the children entertained.

We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Yazmin Monroy
reviews.text: We just got back from our stay at Paradisus Cancun and we're absolutely in love! The hotel and its facilities are a dream, but the service is phenomenal. Our concierge, Sergio, made our vacation a dream come true. He sent us information every day, visited us during the day, and most importantly, made us feel right at home. Thanks to him, we'll be back soon!

reviews.author: JUTESA INCAT S.l
reviews.text: Overall, the hotel and service are excellent, with very attentive staff. They've recently reopened and everything is in excellent condition; highly recommended. We had dinner at the restaurant, enjoying traditional Peruvian cuisine. Jorge served us, and everything was perfect—the service was excellent, and all the staff were very helpful. Come and experience it for yourself!

reviews.author: José Heras García
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the bao buns, the pork ribs, and the sushi.
Ernesto was our waiter and recommended dishes that best suited our tastes. The service was excellent. I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Leah Smith
reviews.text: Armando and Fanny were wonderful. Their attentiveness and energy made our dinner even more enjoyable. The food was incredibly delicious!

reviews.author: Julia Bataglia
reviews.text: My partner and I had a wonderful time at this hotel. Check-in was a bit slow and disorganized, but Rommel's excellent service more than made up for it. He was attentive to everything, gave us a warm welcome, and helped us make reservations at the restaurants and spa. Special mention to Julio at Reserve Bar, who was the best part! We would definitely return.

reviews.author: Mauricio Marchant
reviews.text:
A truly excellent experience and a hotel that deserves all its stars. Special mention to those who took such good care of us every day: Karina, Flor, Humberto, and Javier from Ginger Bar; César and Julio from Sante; Josue, the bartender at Kanna; and Victoria, the bartender at Pool 2.

As areas for improvement, the room cleaning needs to be more thorough and done earlier, and the nightclub closes too early.

reviews.author: Victoria Odette Olvera Herrera
reviews.text:
We ate at Vibra restaurant in Paradisus Cancun. Norma, our waitress, was friendly, attentive, very pleasant, and helpful. Chef Irving delighted us with all his dishes; each one was deliciously flavorful. And with the ocean view, it was a truly enjoyable experience.

This hotel recently renovated its rooms, and regarding the changes, we noticed that its minimalist style isn't ideal for family trips. Most of the new furniture is aesthetically pleasing and would be better suited for business trips where people are traveling alone.

However, we always have a pleasant time at Paradisus Cancun. We've been members for over 20 years, and the staff treats us warmly, making us feel right at home. This includes the administrative staff, Ivette and Veronica, the concierge Martin and Rodolfo, and the staff at the restaurants, pools, and spa.

reviews.author: TORRES VILCHIS BRANDON HERIBERTO
reviews.text:
Blue Agave - Armando
This has been the best service of all the restaurants at the Paradisus Hotel. They were always attentive, even when our food wasn't ready, and they urged the chefs to get it out faster. Very pleasant and excellent service. The kind that brightens your evening.

reviews.author: Daniel Calderon
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was wonderful. The hotel, the beach, the service, and especially the ice cream shop made our stay very special. Alejandro, Norma, Alicia, Perla, and Rosalinda delighted us with delicious ice cream and cakes. Thank you so much for everything, and we hope to see you soon!

reviews.author: Braian Curiel
reviews.text:
The best thing about this place is its people!
Excellent service from the moment you arrive. Julián called me by name the first day I arrived and never forgot!
Faridhe at the Concierge helped me print a document, and her service and attitude were 10/10.
Miguel (Lucas)
Gerardo
Seferino
Manuel
Bernardo
Candelario
Everyone was 10/10 in service, attention, attitude, and friendliness!

But Paty and Lupita from the omelets deserve a 15/10!
Lupita's salsas are the best I've had in Cancun! The habanero salsa was delicious, and she even shared her recipe with me!

Thank you all so much!

reviews.author: Andres Galeano
reviews.text: A wonderful experience. A hotel to relax, enjoy delicious food, unwind on the beach, watch sunsets, and relax by the pools. Kao, the Japanese restaurant, was the best of all, thanks to José, who provided excellent service.

reviews.author: José Luciano Carmo
reviews.text: Uriel's Tabata class was excellent, very lively and functional. We're already ready for a super hearty breakfast after burning so many calories.

reviews.author: noemi juarez
reviews.text:
Arce and Daniel gave us spectacular service; the Japanese restaurant was delicious and highly recommended.
They gave us excellent recommendations for trying something different and exquisite.
Thank you so much!
We would definitely dine here again!

reviews.author: Abel Ainsa
reviews.text: The Nespresso Pyramid 3 coffee shop; the service is excellent and the food quality is great too; the staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Perla, Anahi, and Alejandro. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Daniela Hernández
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful 💚! My experience with the service has been excellent, especially with Mario from Kao, at the swim-up bar with Erick & Miguel, and at Vibra Mauricio... Overall, the stay has been good.

reviews.author: Liz Covarrubias
reviews.text:
Everything was perfect!!! The service was outstanding; Rodrigo, the waiter at the pool, and Armando, the waiter at Blue Agave restaurant, were all excellent. Gustavo, the waiter at Kao restaurant, made us feel very well taken care of. Congratulations!!!!

My only suggestion would be to make the pool water a little warmer, please!

reviews.author: Fer Morales
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent! Capella restaurant was very good, and Edgar provided excellent service. The tiramisu photo was 10/10.
Kao restaurant is also incredible (my favorite). Mario took wonderful care of us.

reviews.author: Sandra Perea morales
reviews.text: The hotel is in a good location, the rooms are clean and comfortable, and the staff is friendly, especially Rafael, who is always willing to help and provides excellent service. Furthermore, the facilities are very good and offer a peaceful environment for relaxation; it's a very good choice for accommodation.

reviews.author: Luis Aguilar
reviews.text: Excellent place and the food at Kanna Beach Club was delicious! The service from waiters Alberto and Luis was outstanding. I would gladly return; the entire cost is refunded towards your food and drinks. The place in general is very relaxed, the music is great, and everything is top-notch. 👌

reviews.author: Roberto Vaca
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jesús at Capella Italian Restaurant. The food was delicious, and Jesús always recommended great dishes. The tiramisu was simply de-li-cious!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Brenda Rodriguez Dominguez

reviews.text:
I just returned from my second stay at Paradisus Cancun – The Reserve, and I can confidently say it was even better than the first! From the moment we arrived, the service was absolutely exceptional. Every single staff member was warm, friendly, and truly made us feel like VIPs.

The biggest shout-out goes to Josué (Josh), our amazing waiter at the Balinese bed. He went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed, always with a smile. What really impressed us was his attention to detail: he remembered our names from one day to the next and made sure we were always comfortable. His service was, without a doubt, the best we've ever received at any resort!

Another team member who made our experience even more special was Miguel, one of our waiters, who was incredibly attentive and always remembered our drink orders, making sure we had exactly what we wanted without us even having to ask.

We also want to give a shout-out to Luis, our waiter at the cabana, who took wonderful care of us. She was always looking out for us, constantly checking if we needed anything and making sure our drinks were never empty. Her kindness and dedication truly made all the difference.

Our concierge, Rossana, was also amazing. She was so friendly and always ready to help us with anything we needed, ensuring our stay was perfect and worry-free. She truly elevated our experience and made us feel so well taken care of.

The resort remains as stunning as ever, but what truly made this trip unforgettable was the exceptional service from the incredible team. If you're looking for a luxurious, stress-free getaway with the most attentive staff, The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun is the place to be. We will definitely be back!
