reviews.text: Perfect location on the beaches of Cancun and excellent service from Armando at the Blue Agave restaurant!!! If you go there, be sure to ask him to serve you!!!

reviews.author: Estela Spehrs
reviews.text: Sal restaurant is excellent, the service is wonderful and the food is excellent. They just need to improve the desserts.

reviews.author: Edgar Gauna González
reviews.text: Excellent renovation, completely new rooms, Juan's service at the Aguamarina restaurant was excellent, always attentive

reviews.author: omar buenfil
reviews.text: The service was excellent; the waiters Emanuel and the manager Daniel were very attentive and helpful. I highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Mayte Sanchez
reviews.text: I loved it, the waiter Angel was super friendly, I loved the food.

reviews.author: Pamela Dariana Pérez Sosa
reviews.text: The service from waiter Gustavo at Kao restaurant was excellent, as was the service at Julio restaurant Vivra.

reviews.author: Wilson Dominguez
reviews.text: Excellent food and service at Lemon Fish. Waiters Jorge and Miguel did an exceptional job. Chefs Mario and Karen were fantastic with the green ceviche and ribs. And the drinks made by the bartender Carlos were amazing, each one better than the last.

reviews.author: Denilson Pereira
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancún Resort is simply enchanting!
Pleasant and beautifully scented surroundings.
We loved the food, and especially the service from the Malva restaurant team. Ivonn, Alberto, and Francisco always treated us wonderfully well; they were very kind and polite every day!
I wish them continued success!!!

reviews.author: Luis Gustavo Carlini Ribeiro Lopes
reviews.text: Edgar provided us with an incredible dinner at the Cappella restaurant.

reviews.author: Lenny Gonzalez
reviews.text: Armando was absolutely wonderful!!! All the food was delicious! Daniel, the entertainer, was awesome!

reviews.author: Elsa Segura
reviews.text: Wonderful staff! Thank you Alicia García for making our stay a great experience!!

reviews.author: Sabrina
reviews.text: We had a wonderful evening at Capella. The atmosphere was lovely and the food simply excellent; each dish was prepared with great care and flavor. We especially want to highlight the service from Melvin, who attended to us with immense kindness and professionalism. Thank you for such a special experience; we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Paola Maldonado Torres
reviews.text: The aqua aerobics activity with Uriel and Daniel was very fun and cool, the beach is beautiful

reviews.author: Hector Alvarez
reviews.text: The food was spectacular and the service incredible, thanks to Jesús who was always attentive to every detail.

reviews.author: Flor Aguirre
reviews.text: Excellent service from Mr. Edgar, very helpful and attentive at Capella Restaurant.

reviews.author: Paty M
reviews.text: Great experience at Zesty, and the best part besides the delicious food was the service from Estefanía and Jesús… Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Duckies smile
reviews.text: Excellent service from the kids club area, the activities were very educational. Special thanks to Neybi, Mafer, Alondra and Vianey

reviews.author: Gustavo Albano
reviews.text: Excellent experience, Maylin and Alondra were super fun with the entertainment for the children.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos Delgado
reviews.text: We love coming here, everything is delicious, especially the Tao restaurant and Aurelio's service.

reviews.author: Stephanie Medina
reviews.text:
The Blue Agave restaurant, with the waiter Atilano and his captain Mario, made the experience extraordinary. A huge thank you to Chef Arancely, who made me the best sudadero tacos I've ever had 😍

I forgot to mention the coffee masters Richer and Alex. I honestly don't know how they manage to have such amazing energy and enthusiasm, working 10 HOURS a day! They take care of every customer and personalize every experience. I'm always excited to come and find them at my cafe to have a chat with them. They're such sweethearts 💖

reviews.author: Lizbeth Uribe
reviews.text: Excellent food at Capella restaurant, and the waiter Edgar provided excellent service, super attentive 👌🏻

reviews.author: E W (大亮子)
reviews.text: The food was terrible, the service was bad, but the facilities were okay, just so-so.

reviews.author: Agustina Ramírez
reviews.text: Everything at Capella restaurant was wonderful, the food exquisite, and Jesús's service exceptional. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Joaquín Boymer
reviews.text: The food at Kao was delicious and Jesus' service was excellent!

reviews.author: Hugo Carbajal
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience we had celebrating my friend's birthday with my friends at Paradisus Cancun, especially at Malva Cenas. They made us feel right at home with excellent service and attention from Captain Guillermo, waiters Manuel and Felix, and hostess Patricia. We can't wait to return. A special mention also goes to Orlando and all the bar staff who always provide fantastic service, as well as the poolside waiters. Thank you for always making our stay spectacular. Thank you, Paradisus.

reviews.author: Veronica Hernández
reviews.text: Excellent, very personalized service at Nespresso, especially from Norma and Alejandro. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: ALMA DELIA GARCIA SAMANIEGO
reviews.text:
Wonderful. Moises's service at the "Cielo" restaurant was excellent. The food was delicious, and all the options were highly recommended. The portions were perfect... Excellent service.
At the AguaMarina restaurant, Carlos, Roberto, Nicolas, and Martin offer excellent service and very attentive staff. They are always attentive to your needs while you enjoy the exquisitely prepared food. Thank you so much for making our stay so special.

reviews.author: marilda silveria
reviews.text: Jorge, our waiter, with great skill, competence, politeness, and kindness, served us with great wisdom, professionalism, and dedication!!!! Jorge suggested the best dishes made by chef Marcos and Karen, which we thoroughly enjoyed!! It couldn't have been better!! Lemon Fish is the best option!! 😊😊😊😊 José, Malvi Adriana, and the great chef Cristian and also Cláudio from the incredible Capela restaurant at Paradisus Cancún!! Incredible and wonderful restaurant with a delicious and varied menu! Don't miss the opportunity to visit this restaurant!! Thank you friends!! A big hug to everyone!!

reviews.author: Marcela Castillo
reviews.text: Mr. Armando provides excellent service at the Blue Agave restaurant; the attention is outstanding.

reviews.author: juan rojas
reviews.text: Alejandro and Rafael at Gastro Hall are excellent, very good service, excellent attention, highly recommended

reviews.author: David M
reviews.text: Excellent in every aspect: location, service, food, and drinks. A small recommendation: Unfortunately, not everyone who works in customer service treats you courteously. There are some prejudiced people who, if you're not an international tourist, don't treat you with the same level of respect. I hope the management takes this into account and trains their staff, as these issues detract from the great work done by others, such as the warm and friendly service of Mr. Guillermo at the Malva Restaurant, Mr. Juan at the pool bar, and many more. Excellent service and friendliness.

reviews.author: Isaac S Zarama
reviews.text:
Our experience at Paradisus Cancun was unforgettable. Astrid and the entire team went out of their way to make our vacation truly special.

We want to especially thank Balthazar, Abraham, and Ginger at the bar; Cynthia and Fanny at Flora; and the amazing Agua Marina team, who made us feel right at home. As a family of 12, it was incredible to see the team's efforts to accommodate us and ensure we had enjoyable family moments.

A special thank you to Kanna, Itza, and Alfredo for their exceptional service. Their hospitality was outstanding and made all the difference.

Without a doubt, the service was excellent, and we highly recommend and will return for the grand reopening. Many thanks to everyone involved.

reviews.author: Carlos Morán
reviews.text: Excellent service from the staff, especially Mr. Moisés from Agua Marina.

reviews.author: Nathaly Robles
reviews.text: Everything was very pleasant, especially Edgar's service at the Capella restaurant.

reviews.author: Lily CR
reviews.text: We've been several times and we really like the service and the food in terms of quality and variety. However, the rooms are a bit old, the electrical outlets don't work, and the furniture isn't in perfect condition because it's quite old. I'm glad they're currently renovating because it's a great hotel and I think it will give it a big advantage over others.

reviews.author: agustin esquivel
reviews.text:
I recently went to Lemon Fish and it was truly an amazing experience. The food was exquisite, the atmosphere very pleasant, but what made all the difference was the service from our waiter, Jorge. From the very first moment, he was incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. He made us feel comfortable, recommended dishes with confidence and great taste, and was always attentive without being intrusive.

It's a pleasure to find people who love what they do and it shows. Thank you, Jorge, for making our dinner so special. I will definitely return and recommend it.

reviews.author: maritza munguia
reviews.text: Excellent service from the waitstaff, especially Atilano and Diego from Bistro Hall

reviews.author: Yvonne Fuentes
reviews.text: We just had a special dinner to celebrate my birthday. From the moment we arrived at La Cava, everything was excellent: the food, the drinks, the attention to detail, and the service. They truly know how to make guests feel valued. The dinner consisted of four courses, each paired with a specific wine. I can't imagine how they could have done it better. Thank you so much, and I highly recommend it. Yvonne

reviews.author: REBECA DE LA ROSA
reviews.text:
It's an incredible hotel in every way, but what truly earns it stars is the exceptional service from every single employee.
Some of the waiters treated us exceptionally well. Mr. Ramiro always served us at breakfast, Roberto at the seafood restaurant, and waiters David, Alberto, and Guillermo surprised us on our last night at the buffet with a lovely farewell gesture, wishing us a safe trip.
I 100% recommend this hotel; it's absolutely worth it!

reviews.author: JOSE JESUS BLANCO-DURAN
reviews.text: Excellent service everywhere but exceptional in Capella with the great Jesus who is a star.

reviews.author: PUCHURROS PUCHURRITOS
reviews.text: Excellent and wonderful service from the waiter Jesus,

reviews.author: Cristina Chávez Pérez Valdés
reviews.text:
Jorge's service, along with the menu he developed with Chef Mario and Karen at Lemon Fish, made for a wonderful dinner experience.
The tamarind mescaline was delicious.

I'll be back, 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Y B
reviews.text: Blessings 🙌✨ Excellent service from waiter Ernesto at Agua Marina Restaurant

reviews.author: Carolina Torres
reviews.text: This was my first time using Kanna's beach service and I loved it! The place is comfortable and very relaxing... special mention to Alfredo's service, the best of all!! Very kind and attentive, he took great care of us, and the drinks and food were delicious.

reviews.author: Fernando Irigoyen
reviews.text:
Our experience at the hotel was, overall, very good, especially regarding the service. The team at The Reserve is extremely friendly, but I want to give special thanks to Gabriela at Santé, who was extraordinarily attentive and professional. People like her truly make a difference and make you want to return.

Our concierge, Rossana, was very kind and attentive to our needs.

Regarding the facilities, it's good news to know that the hotel is undergoing renovations, as the rooms, especially, are in need of renovation due to their current condition.

In terms of food, our experience was mixed: the Santé restaurant offers excellent cuisine (even better than Sal for dinner), but the overall buffet left much to be desired. The Lemon Fish restaurant, on the other hand, was simply average and has room for improvement.

In short, the attention of The Reserve's staff is what stands out the most and elevates the experience, although there are areas for improvement in the facilities and the quality of the buffet.

reviews.author: Nadia Zippo
reviews.text:
Our experience at Lemon Fish was amazing the three times we visited. Jorge Miguel's service was exceptional with his suggestions and kindness. Chefs Mario and Karen are experts in haute cuisine and finesse, and we tried some incredible cocktails with Carlos, the hotel's top bartender. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for an unforgettable experience.
And the best part of the hotel was meeting such a special and pleasant person as Óscar (the host), who brought smiles to our faces at every turn.

reviews.author: Francisco
reviews.text: First-class service! Edgar treated us wonderfully at the Capela restaurant ♥️👌

reviews.author: Alejandra Tobón
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the entire hotel staff, excellent food, and excellent rooms. Our entire stay was excellent.
Excellent service at the pool from Didier, Jorge, Flor, and Baltazar. They were very attentive to us and always very helpful. You can relax by the pool and they will be super helpful.
Excellent service from Arce at the Lemon Fish restaurant. He treated us wonderfully, and the service is fantastic.
Alberto at the breakfast buffet is a lovely person, always attentive to everything and treating us excellently every day.
Shout out to Uriel, who was excellent to us and made the time at the pool a lot of fun.

reviews.author: Erick Ramos
reviews.text: Great service, Edgar took great care of us at Capela

reviews.author: RENATA LAMBARRI
reviews.text:
I stayed at this wonderful beachfront hotel, and the experience was unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, the service was impeccable; the staff was always friendly and willing to help. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, making every sunrise a delight. Furthermore, the cleanliness and maintenance of the facilities are excellent.

The location is unbeatable, with direct beach access, allowing us to enjoy the sea with complete ease. We shared some very pleasant and fun moments with an entertainment staff member named Selza, who made my experience even more incredible! The hotel also has several delicious dining options, and the atmosphere is very relaxing, ideal for unwinding.

Without a doubt, I would return to this paradise, where the combination of the beach, excellent service, and tranquility makes this hotel a perfect place to relax and enjoy the natural surroundings. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sophie Brouard
reviews.text:
A perfect 10 hotel! The restaurants and the hotel in general are superb, and the service is excellent, especially Diego, the Food & Beverage Manager, and his team, who made our stay unforgettable. We were celebrating our anniversary, and we couldn't have chosen a better place.

We also want to highlight the service from Jesús Canche and Francisco, who served us at the Cappella restaurant, as well as César, the pool and Balinese bartender, who was always attentive and acted with complete professionalism. Thanks to them all, we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Yetzenia Zambrano
reviews.text: Yesterday and today, we were looked after by Mr. Roberto Islas, Rodrigo Gorocica, and Ms. Leticia in the children's pool area. Their service was outstanding—from asking what we wanted to eat or drink to cleaning up after us. They were so kind and attentive to the children and to us. The place is a paradise, but receiving such wonderful service was the perfect complement to our vacation! Thank you so much! ☺️

reviews.author: Mita Mendez
reviews.text: We are delighted with the hotel service. I highly recommend the Flora restaurant. Cinthia and Fanny's service was wonderful; they surprised my parents with a lovely gift for their anniversary! Thank you for everything, we loved it!!

reviews.author: Alejandro Franco
reviews.text:
I stayed in February 2025.

This was my second time at Paradisus Cancun.

I arrived by car and Raúl very kindly greeted us and was always very friendly.

A young woman (I apologize, I didn't write down her name) kindly took us to check in at The Reserve; she was very friendly and courteous.

Check-in was a bit of a hassle, an area for improvement.

I had requested a dinner reservation before my arrival, but unfortunately, it wasn't made, which was a bit frustrating. Fortunately, we were welcomed without a reservation at Blue Agave, and I want to congratulate Atilano, who took wonderful care of us and had a very positive attitude that lifted my spirits that night. Thank you so much.

I also want to thank the butler, who was always helpful via WhatsApp, even though I never met him in person. He was very attentive.

Dinner at Sal Steak Cave was delicious, and Leo kindly made me a clericot even though it wasn't on the menu. The food was also delicious.

Jesús at Limón Fish also recommended a tropical drink with mezcal—yum, delicious!

I had a treatment at the spa, and everything was great, but what I liked most was the hydrotherapy circuit. Thanks, Ismael, for the attention.

At the pool, I never lacked anything thanks to Yamil, who was always attentive.

And of course, Mr. Guillermo at Malva was always very active during the hotel's peak hours, but very helpful and friendly at all times. Congratulations!

The room was fine but needs updating; I think they'll be renovating soon. The minibar in the room wasn't cooling, but since the Atrium at The Reserve has everything and is so convenient, it wasn't necessary.
The gym was good; the equipment was well-maintained. The hotel doesn't offer turndown service. However, the room had a spectacular view. A very positive experience, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Josué Castorena
reviews.text:
For Armando at Blueagave Restaurant.
A true gentleman. The service he provided to my wife, me, and especially my daughter was wonderful.
Very attentive, friendly, and helpful.
Always making sure everything was in order and that we had everything we needed.
Just because of his service, we returned to the restaurant more than three times during our stay.
Thank you, and 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Pedro Dos Santos
reviews.text:
Nestor, Manuel, and Gemma provided excellent service. They were always friendly and a lot of fun! They made our stay wonderful.

The hotel is a bit far from the shopping centers, but the food is very good, except for the desserts!

reviews.author: Melissa Hernandez
reviews.text: Atilano and Aracely, thank you so much for everything! The food is delicious. Especially the tacos with habanero sauce. The tequila too. The atmosphere is beautiful and the staff is amazing. 100% recommended. I'll be back :)

reviews.author: Santos Aguirre
reviews.text: Delicious, the service was excellent, highly recommended, everything was very tasty

reviews.author: Osvaldo Morales
reviews.text: We want to thank our concierge, Manuel. He treated us wonderfully, was very kind, and was a great help during our vacation. I highly recommend Paradisus Cancun; the entire staff welcomed us warmly. I recommend this hotel; we had a fantastic time, and the service was top-notch.

reviews.author: Miguel SNL
reviews.text: A highly recommended place, with excellent service and a warm and welcoming staff. The room was comfortable, the view was excellent, and the beach was beautiful. My favorite place to eat was Capella. And the Ginger bars were great for a pleasant time. I appreciate the hospitality of the captains Diego, Samantha, Gabriela, Adriana, and Daniel, the waitresses Karina and Gladys, and the mixologist Abraham. I will return for the grand reopening!

reviews.author: Pascal Pichaczek
reviews.text:
Fanny and her team are the best! Unfortunately, I haven't had the chance to meet the chef yet, but it's still a real treat!

I highly recommend the two soups!

The food is generally beautifully presented, so I can only recommend trying everything :)

reviews.author: Veronica Robelo
reviews.text:
Ernesto's service at the Lemon Fish restaurant was wonderful. We loved his suggestions, and we were amazed by his attentiveness and kindness. The food is delicious.

This is our second year here, and this time we had a very old and run-down room. The bathroom left much to be desired, and our room also had a lagoon view, so we were put in a room where we couldn't see anything. This time we were disappointed by the condition of the room. However, the entire staff is wonderful! Congratulations.

reviews.author: Beatriz De Freitas
reviews.text:
Writing a short review is impossible! I LOVE this place, the attention from the guys in the adult pool area, and my favorite restaurant, Santé! It was impeccable, I will definitely return to this hotel! It will be difficult to top this birthday! Thanks to Mr. Jose for helping us every minute with every reservation for all the activities!
Guys (Bernardo, Miguel, David, Yamil for my coffee, Jacob, Arnulfo, Pancho)—very grateful for your attention, I will miss you! ♥️

reviews.author: Arantza Muñoz
reviews.text: The entire service was delightful. Chef David accompanied us through all the restaurants, and thanks to him, we were able to try everything. The food and beverage manager, Diego, was also attentive to us at all times. Boris, in charge of the Japanese restaurant, and our waiter, Carlos, made sure we enjoyed a wonderful dinner. At the Sante pool, Victor always arranged for us to use the Balinese beds even though we hadn't reserved them. The staff at Sante were also excellent, but especially Cesar, Gabriela, and Carlos.

reviews.author: Lupita Gonzalez Psicóloga
reviews.text: Everything was excellent, Mohazyr from Blueagave, very good service.

reviews.author: kamylla caldeira
reviews.text:
My stay at the Hotel Paradisus Cancun was absolutely incredible! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with exceptional service that made our trip even more memorable.

The hotel's location is perfect, with stunning ocean views and direct access to the white sand beach and crystal-clear waters. The rooms were spacious and very comfortable, providing a relaxing night's sleep after a day full of activities.

The hotel staff deserves all possible praise. They are attentive, helpful, and always have a smile on their face. The service is impeccable in all the resort's restaurants and bars. The cuisine is of high quality, with an incredible variety of culinary options to please all tastes.

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.text: Jorge at Lemon Fish was excellent, the service was very good. Chef Mario and Karen's food was excellent. Thanks again, Jorge, for your hospitality and service!

reviews.author: Scirpus waveski
reviews.text:
A perfect place to relax and enjoy a drink after a long day. Excellent service and atmosphere!
I loved the hotel bar. With bartender Luis Herrera, who is very friendly and fun. Bar Sante!

reviews.author: Vania Estefania Navas Castillo
reviews.text:
Incredible, dreamy, they make you feel like you're in paradise. All the staff are very friendly and welcoming. The facilities are perfect for families, with safety and entertainment for both children and adults.

Regarding service, I'd like to highlight two employees who were angels during our stay: Armando from the Blueagave restaurant and Ms. Brenda Meneses. Excellent people with a heart of gold in their service ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: KATHRYN GABRIELA ORTEGA
reviews.text: Excellent service from the entire team, who were always attentive to our needs and guided us to enjoy a unique experience. Special mention to Alexito, who made our coffee daily, and Fernando at the buffet, who was always attentive to our every request. The service at the pool was ideal, especially the sun loungers. And the Circle team gave us exquisite treatment. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Dianela Rivera
reviews.text: The best service we received was from our favorite waitress, Gaby. She works at the sports bar (Ginger 2). We hope to return soon and see her again; she's very friendly and always attentive to our needs. Likewise, Jhonata, Enrique, and Salvador, the bartenders, were fantastic. They know how to make the best drinks. Thank you all for making our vacation unforgettable! 😊🫂❤️

reviews.author: Pablo Oswaldo García Medina
reviews.text:
Rodrigo and Didier provided excellent service overall at the pool...the drinks were very good.

At the Kidsdome, Dove provided great service, and I loved the piñata activity.

At Blueagave Antilano, he was always very friendly and helpful...very good here.

I would improve the service at the restaurants; they always seem to be rushing. In particular, at Malva, the service was very poor every time we went. Additionally, the variety at the breakfast buffet is very limited compared to lower-category hotels.

Specifically, they don't seem to be able to keep up with taking drink orders, and I don't see any self-service options unless you go to the bar yourself.

At the Capella restaurant, when we finally managed to get in after three days, it took approximately 30 minutes to take our order, in addition to the preparation time.

Thank you
